lines.content: 祖父母の家から帰る新幹線の中。
lines.translated: On the bullet train back from my grandparents' house.

lines.content: \n読んでいた小説から顔を上げ、窓の外を見る。
lines.translated: \nI look up from the novel I was reading and glance out the window.

lines.content: 列車は次の駅へ止まるために、減速を始めたところだった。
lines.translated: The train had started slowing down to stop at the next station.

lines.content: \nそのため、景色をはっきりと見ることができる。
lines.translated: \nBecause of that, I can see the scenery clearly.

lines.content: 暖色系に衣替えした山々。
lines.translated: Mountains dressed in warm autumn colors.

lines.content: \n今年は、いつもより色づくのが早いらしい。
lines.translated: \nApparently the leaves are changing earlier than usual this year.

lines.content: そのせいだろうか。シルバーウィークは終わったのに、
lines.translated: Maybe that's why -- Silver Week was already over, yet

lines.content: \n車内はほどほどに混んでいた。
新幹線が止まると、新たに人が乗車してくる。
lines.translated: When the train stopped, new passengers began boarding.

lines.content: \n降りるより、乗る人の方が多い。
lines.translated: \nMore people were getting on than getting off.

lines.content: そんな中、同じ年頃ぐらいの少女が乗車してくる。
lines.translated: Among them, a girl about my age stepped on board.

lines.content: \n大きなカートを引いてキョロキョロと席を探す。
lines.translated: \nShe dragged a large suitcase behind her, looking around for her seat.

lines.content: 隣の席は空いていたから、なんとなく居住まいを正す。
lines.translated: The seat next to me was empty, so I instinctively sat up a little straighter.

lines.content: 切符の番号と席の番号を見比べた少女は、
lines.translated: The girl compared the number on her ticket to the seat numbers,

lines.content: \n予想通り俺の隣の席までやってくる。
lines.translated: \nand, just as I expected, made her way to the seat right beside me.
"Okay. Let me just put my bag up top--\@

lines.content: 少女がカートを持ち上げようとしたところで、
lines.translated: Just as the girl tried to lift her suitcase,

lines.content: \n新幹線が動き出し、軽くバランスを崩す。
lines.translated: \nthe train started moving and she lost her balance a little.

lines.content: すぐバランスを取り戻したが、大きなカート。
lines.translated: She caught herself quickly, but it was a big suitcase.

lines.content: \n持ち上げるのは難儀しそうだ。
lines.translated: \nLifting it up looked like it'd be a real struggle.

lines.content: 「上げますよ。横に倒しても大丈夫ですか？」
lines.translated: "I'll get it. Is it okay if I lay it on its side?"

lines.content: 少女は一瞬ためらったが、押し問答しても周りに
lines.translated: The girl hesitated for a moment, but perhaps thinking that going back and forth

lines.content: \n迷惑になると思ったのか、素直に任せてくれた。
lines.translated: \nwould bother the people around us, she let me handle it without any more fuss.

lines.content: 俺が荷物を上げると、少女が丁寧に一礼する。
lines.translated: When I lifted her bag up, the girl gave a polite bow.

lines.content: \n長いポニーテールが動きに合わせて揺れた。
lines.translated: \nHer long ponytail swayed with the motion.

lines.content: 少女が座ると、それ以上会話はない。
lines.translated: Once she sat down, the conversation ended there.

lines.content: 別になんということもない。ただの隣り合った人として
lines.translated: Nothing unusual about it. We were just two strangers sitting next to each other,

lines.content: \n各々車内での時間を過ごすのみ。
lines.translated: \neach passing the time in our own way.
-- I felt a weight on my shoulder.
A pretty face, very close to mine.

lines.content: 少女は完全に寝息を立てている。
lines.translated: The girl was completely sound asleep.

lines.content: これだけしっかり寝ているのだから、疲れているのか。
lines.translated: She's sleeping this deeply -- she must be exhausted.

lines.content: 押しのけるのも悪い気がして、読んでいた小説に
lines.translated: It felt wrong to push her away, so I decided to go back
Back to my novel -- or so I --

lines.content: 心音がドキリと一段高くなる。
\n心臓から吹き出された血液が、熱く身体に広がっていく。
肩越しにどうしても感じる重みや、温もりに、
lines.translated: The weight and warmth pressing against my shoulder --

lines.content: \nどうしたってドキドキしてしまう。
lines.translated: \nI couldn't help but feel my heart racing.

lines.content: 文字を視線の端で追いながら、寝息を立てる少女を見る。
lines.translated: I tried to keep my eyes on the page, but they kept drifting to the sleeping girl.

lines.content: \nやはり俺と同じぐらいの年頃だろうか。
lines.translated: \nShe looked about the same age as me, I thought.

lines.content: とはいえ、寝顔はもっとあどけなく見えた。
lines.translated: Even so, her sleeping face looked a lot more childlike.

lines.content: 新幹線が減速を始める。もうすぐ次の駅へ着くのだろう。
lines.translated: The bullet train began to slow. We must be approaching the next station.

lines.content: そのわずかな変化で、浅く目覚めたのか、
lines.translated: Maybe the subtle change woke her slightly --

lines.content: 寝ぼけているのか、いやいやをするように、
lines.translated: Still half-asleep, as if refusing something in a dream,

lines.content: \nおでこを俺の肩にグリグリと擦りつけてくる。
lines.translated: \nshe rubbed her forehead back and forth against my shoulder.

lines.content: 艷やかな黒い前髪が揺れ、甘い香りがする。
lines.translated: Her glossy black bangs swayed, carrying a faint sweet scent.
\nThis is getting awkward. On multiple levels.

lines.content: あ、また寄りかかって寝た。
lines.translated: Oh -- she's leaning on me again, fast asleep.

lines.content: この状況はやはり問題が出てきそうだし、
lines.translated: This situation is bound to cause problems,

lines.content: \n寄りかかる頭をせめて別の場所に移せれば――
lines.translated: \nand if I could at least move her head somewhere else --

lines.content: 「駅、着きましたけど、大丈夫ですか？」
lines.translated: "We've arrived at the station. Are you okay?"

lines.content: 努めて平静な声を出す。
lines.translated: I kept my voice as calm as I could.
"I'm going to the end of the line, so..."

lines.content: まだ寝ぼけ眼で、ボソッと言った少女だったが、
lines.translated: Still bleary-eyed, the girl murmured softly,

lines.content: \n次第に目覚めてきたのか、瞳を二三度しばたかせて俺を見る。
lines.translated: \nbut as she gradually woke up, she blinked a few times and looked at me.

lines.content: 顔を見ていたと思われたくないので目をそらす。
lines.translated: I looked away so she wouldn't think I'd been staring at her face.

lines.content: \nとはいえ、少女は肩に寄りかかったまま。
lines.translated: \nShe was still leaning against my shoulder, though.

lines.content: 慌てて少女が顔を起こすと口元を拭う。
lines.translated: The girl quickly lifted her head and wiped the corner of her mouth.

lines.content: それ以上言う言葉もなく、俺は窓の外を見る。
lines.translated: With nothing more to say, I turned to look out the window.

lines.content: \n気配から察するに、おそらく少女は居住まいを正している。
lines.translated: \nFrom the sounds around me, I could tell the girl was straightening herself up.

lines.content: なんとなく、視線を感じる気がする。
lines.translated: I had a feeling she was looking at me.

lines.content: \n俺も、背筋を伸ばしてしまう。
lines.translated: \nI sat up a little straighter myself.

lines.content: 少女の声に思わず視線を向ければ、車内販売のお姉さんに
lines.translated: When I instinctively turned toward the girl's voice, it seemed she had called out

lines.content: 「ホットコーヒー、いただけますか？」
lines.translated: "Could I get a hot coffee, please?"

lines.content: 言った後で、俺にも視線を向けてくる。
lines.translated: After saying that, she glanced over at me too.

lines.content: 「その、ご迷惑かけたようなので」
lines.translated: "Well, it seems like I caused you some trouble, so..."

lines.content: 「でも、その方が私もスッキリしますし」
lines.translated: "But it would make me feel better too."

lines.content: 気が晴れるのならばと、提案に甘えることにした。
lines.translated: If it would put her at ease, I figured I'd take her up on the offer.

lines.content: 「はいっ。ブラック２つ、いただけますか？」
lines.translated: "Sure! Could we get two black coffees, please?"

lines.content: ぱっと笑顔を見せ、コーヒーを二つ買う。
lines.translated: She flashed a bright smile and bought two coffees,

lines.content: \nそして一つを俺に渡してくれる。
「いえ、熱いので気をつけてください」
lines.translated: "Not at all -- just be careful, it's hot."

lines.content: 受け取ったコーヒーを一口飲む。
lines.translated: I took a sip of the coffee she'd handed me.

lines.content: \n苦味と酸味の隙間から、ほのかな甘味を感じられた。
lines.translated: \nBetween the bitterness and the acidity, I caught a faint hint of sweetness.

lines.content: なんとなく視線を合わせる。
lines.translated: Our eyes met for a moment.

lines.content: 気まずいというほどではないものの、なんとも言えない
lines.translated: It wasn't exactly awkward, but there was a certain

lines.content: コーヒーは美味しいのに、味わいきれない緊張感
lines.translated: The coffee was good, but there was a tension that kept me from

lines.content: 「いえ……あ、はい……その、あまり慣れていないもので」
lines.translated: "No... ah, well... yes... I'm just not very used to this, I suppose."

lines.content: 棚の上に置かれたカートに少女が一瞬目をやる。
lines.translated: The girl glanced briefly at the luggage rack overhead.

lines.content: 白鷺市まで新幹線が通ったのは数年前だから、
lines.translated: The Shinkansen line to Shirasagi City only opened a few years ago,

lines.content: \n乗ったことがない人もいるかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nso there were probably people who'd never ridden it before.

lines.content: 「実はわたし、家出してきたんです」
「――なんて、言ったらどうします？」
lines.translated: "-- What would you do if I said that?"
If she'd run away from home -- huh.

lines.content: 「……出席日数のこと、心配します」
我ながら、パッと思いついたのは、
lines.translated: Even I had to admit, the first thing that came to mind

lines.content: \nずいぶん間の抜けた心配だった。
lines.translated: \nwas a pretty scatterbrained thing to worry about.

lines.content: ほら。案の定ぽかんとされた。
lines.translated: See -- sure enough, she was staring at me blankly.

lines.content: 「くっ、ふふっ、あはっ……そうですね。
lines.translated: "Heh -- haha, ahaha... you know what, you're right.

lines.content: \n確かにその心配、しちゃうかもしれませんね」
lines.translated: \nThat might actually be something I'd worry about too."

lines.content: 「いえ、俺は何を言ってるんだって感じです」
lines.translated: "No, I'm sitting here wondering what on earth I just said."

lines.content: 「そんなことないですよ。面白い考えだと思います」
lines.translated: "Don't be silly. I think it's a charming way to think."

lines.content: 少女が伸ばしていた背筋から、少し力を抜く。
lines.translated: The girl let some of the tension ease out of her straight-held back.

lines.content: \nふんわりと秋の太陽に似た香りがした。
lines.translated: \nA soft scent drifted over -- something like an autumn sun.

lines.content: 「ああ、やっぱり同い年なんですね。
lines.translated: "Oh, so we're the same age after all.

lines.content: \nそんなにかしこまらなくても大丈夫ですよ」
lines.translated: \nYou don't have to be so formal with me, you know."

lines.content: いくぶんリラックスした調子の提案に、
lines.translated: Her suggestion came in a noticeably more relaxed tone,
\nand I let my own shoulders loosen up too.

lines.content: 「……それじゃ、遠慮なく。君も話しやすい形にして欲しい」
lines.translated: "...Alright then, I'll take you up on that. Feel free to talk however's comfortable for you too."

lines.content: ここは押し問答するところでもないだろう。
lines.translated: There was no point in going back and forth about it.

lines.content: 「はい。と言っても、わたしはあまり、
\n変わらないかもしれませんが」
lines.translated: \nI'll sound all that different, to be honest."

lines.content: どうやら丁寧な物腰はいつものことらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, that polished way of speaking was just how she always was.

lines.content: 寝ている時はあどけなく見えた。
lines.translated: She'd looked so innocent while she was sleeping.

lines.content: でも、姿勢の良い今の姿は、
lines.translated: But now, sitting up straight like this,

lines.content: \n育ちの良さのようなものが垣間見える。
lines.translated: \nyou could catch a glimpse of something -- a well-bred grace, maybe.

lines.content: 「どちらまで行かれるのでしょうか？」
lines.translated: "Where are you headed, if you don't mind my asking?"

lines.content: 「終点の白鷺市まで。そこに住んでる」
lines.translated: "All the way to Shirasagi City, the last stop. That's where I live."

lines.content: 「それじゃ、降りるまでは一緒ですね。
lines.translated: "Then we'll be together until you get off.

lines.content: \nわたしは乗り換えて、もうちょっと行きます」
lines.translated: \nI'm transferring and going a little further."

lines.content: 「そりゃ、ずいぶん遠い家出だ」
\n一大決心して、出てきましたから」
lines.translated: \nI made a big decision to leave, after all."

lines.content: 彼女の言った『家出』を話題に使ってみたが乗ってくれた。
lines.translated: I'd tried bringing up the "runaway" thing she'd mentioned, and she played right along.

lines.content: 「一大決心なら、いっそ遠出した方が良いわけだ」
lines.translated: "If it's a big decision, you might as well go far."

lines.content: 「ええ、『宝探し』をしに行くんです」
lines.translated: "Yes -- I'm going on a treasure hunt."

lines.content: 「オタカラ狙っていざ行かん……そういうことです」
lines.translated: "Off in search of hidden treasure... that's the idea."

lines.content: 清楚な雰囲気だが、そんなイタズラっぽい表情もする。
lines.translated: She had this refined, graceful air about her, but she could make a mischievous face like that too.

lines.content: \n印象というのは、存外アテにならないものだ。
「どうでしょう。そこへ行くのは初めてですし……
lines.translated: "Who knows. It's my first time going there...

lines.content: \n『家出』も初めて。初めてづくしですから」
lines.translated: \nand my first time running away from home. It's all firsts for me."

lines.content: 俺を――いやすぐ脇にある窓から遠くを見つめる。
lines.translated: She gazed past me -- or rather, through the window right beside us, into the distance.

lines.content: \n相変わらず紅葉の景色が流れている。
lines.translated: \nThe autumn foliage kept streaming by, same as before.
"But I want to see it through..."

lines.content: 冗談かもしれない。でも真に迫った言葉のようにも聞こえた。
lines.translated: It might have been a joke. But it also sounded like words that came from somewhere real.

lines.content: 「初めてづくしの中で『初めての家出』ができたわけだし。
lines.translated: "You managed to pull off your 'first runaway from home' in the middle of all these firsts.
\nI'm sure you can see it through."

lines.content: 「新幹線で隣の人と話すのも、その人にコーヒーを
lines.translated: "Talking to the person sitting next to me on the Shinkansen, and treating them

lines.content: \nご馳走したのも初めてです。けっこうできるものですね」
lines.translated: \nto a coffee -- both firsts. Turns out I can manage more than I thought."

lines.content: 「その色々な『初めて』を、辛いとか嫌とか
lines.translated: "As long as none of those firsts felt painful

lines.content: かっこつけた物言いだという自覚はある。
lines.translated: I knew full well I was trying too hard to sound cool.

lines.content: その証拠に、胸から突き上がる気恥ずかしさで、
lines.translated: The proof was the embarrassment welling up in my chest,

lines.content: でも、少女は瞳を細め、嬉しそうに言ってくれる。
lines.translated: But the girl narrowed her eyes and said it with a smile.

lines.content: 「ま、オタカラ探しを悲観的にやることもないと思う」
lines.translated: "Well, I don't think there's any reason to go treasure hunting with a gloomy attitude."

lines.content: 「……はい。わたし、一歩前進できたんですね」
lines.translated: "...Yes. I've taken a step forward, haven't I."

lines.content: 頷くと、また一口コーヒーを飲んだ。
lines.translated: I nodded, then took another sip of coffee.

lines.content: 終点の白鷺市で降りて、二人で駅前まで歩く。
lines.translated: We reached the last stop, Shirasagi City, got off, and walked together to the station plaza.

lines.content: 「それでは、わたしはこちらですので」
lines.translated: "Well then, my way is over here, so..."

lines.content: 『白鷺市からもうちょっと行く』と言っていたから、
lines.translated: She'd said she was going "a little further past Shirasagi City,"

lines.content: 改札を出たってことは、私鉄なんだろう。
lines.translated: Since she came through the ticket gate, she must be taking a private rail line.

lines.content: 名乗り合ってもいない。連絡先はもっと知らない。
lines.translated: We hadn't even exchanged names. Contact info was out of the question.

lines.content: \nでも、このなんとなくの出会いに『また』と言ってしまった。
lines.translated: \nAnd yet, I'd said "next time" to someone I'd met purely by chance.

lines.content: 「次に逢ったら、コーヒーのお礼もしないといけない」
lines.translated: "If we meet again, you'll have to let me return the favor for the coffee."

lines.content: 「わたしのお詫びなんですから、お礼はおかしいです」
lines.translated: "It was my apology to you, so there's nothing to return."

lines.content: 「じゃ、楽しい旅の時間へのお礼……なんて、どうだろう？」
lines.translated: "Then... how about as thanks for a pleasant journey? Would that work?"

lines.content: 肩をすくめて、おどけてみせる。
lines.translated: I shrugged and played it off with a grin.

lines.content: \n我ながら、今日は調子のいいことを言いすぎだ。
lines.translated: \nI had to admit, I'd been saying way too many smooth things today.

lines.content: 「それでしたら、いただきます。\@
lines.translated: "In that case, I'll gladly accept it.\@

lines.content: 次に逢えるとしたら、偶然しかない。
lines.translated: If we ever did meet again, it could only be by chance.

lines.content: \nでも、連絡先を聞くのはこの出会いに水を差す。
lines.translated: \nBut asking for her contact info would spoil what this encounter had been.

lines.content: お互い、そんな気持ちなんだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe we both felt the same way about that.

lines.translated: Heh, that's a vague thing to say."

lines.content: くすぐったそうに笑われる。
lines.translated: She laughed like she was a little tickled by it.

lines.content: 「でも、そういう『曖昧さ』は悪くないと思います」
lines.translated: "Still, I don't think that kind of 'vagueness' is a bad thing."

lines.content: 彼女にとっても、このくらいの温度がちょうどいいんだろう。
lines.translated: This kind of distance probably felt just right to her, too.

lines.content: 一期一会の相手とそのくらいの『可能性』を残して別れる。
lines.translated: Parting from someone you'd only meet once, leaving just enough 'possibility' between you.

lines.content: \nその楽しさを共感してくれてる。
うん、良い偶然の出会いだ。
lines.translated: Yeah -- this was a good chance encounter.

lines.content: 丁寧に一礼すると、カートを引いて去っていく。
lines.translated: She gave a polite bow, then walked away pulling her suitcase behind her.

lines.content: それを見送り、こちらも家路につく。
lines.translated: I watched her go, then turned and headed home myself.

lines.content: \n家までは、ここから歩いて２０分ほどだ。
lines.translated: \nHome was about a twenty-minute walk from here.

lines.content: 川沿いに出ると、景色が変わり古い町並みが現れる。
lines.translated: When I reached the riverside, the scenery changed and an old townscape came into view.

lines.content: 自分の住む家がある通りだ。
lines.translated: This is the street where my home is.

lines.content: 古くから茶屋街として栄えている場所。
lines.translated: A place that has flourished as a tea-house district since long ago.

lines.content: \nただし、我が家は暖簾を下ろして家の維持管理を続けるのみ。
lines.translated: \nThough our family has closed up shop and now only maintains the house.

lines.content: 我が家よりも、先に向かうのは、
lines.translated: Before heading home, there's somewhere else I need to go first --

lines.content: \n隣の[紅殻格子/べんがらごうし]が特徴的な店――
lines.translated: \nthe shop next door, distinguished by its bengara-goshi lattice windows --

lines.content: パッと笑顔を見せてくれたのは[蔦町/つたまち]ちとせ
lines.translated: The one who flashed me a bright smile was Tsutamachi Chitose --

lines.content: \n――昔から隣に住む『姉』のような人だ。
lines.translated: \n-- the 'older sister' figure who has lived next door since we were kids.

lines.content: ちょうどお客さんもいなかったので、
lines.translated: Since there weren't any customers around at the moment,

lines.content: \n紙袋にまとめたお土産を渡す。
lines.translated: \nI handed her the bag of souvenirs I'd packed together.

lines.content: 「ご希望だったお蕎麦と七味。こっちは
lines.translated: "The soba and shichimi you wanted. And this one

lines.content: \n俺からの土産で栗かの子。みんなで食べて」
lines.translated: \nis from me -- kuri-kanoko. Share it with everyone."

lines.content: 姉さんが抱きついてくるのは、いつものこと。
lines.translated: Her throwing her arms around me is nothing new.

lines.content: 頭を撫でてくるのもいつものこと。
lines.translated: Her patting me on the head is nothing new either.

lines.content: 俺より背の低い『姉』は、頭を撫でるために俺の頭を抱える。
lines.translated: My 'older sister,' who is shorter than me, pulls my head in close to pat it.

lines.content: ……そうなると、胸が顔に押し付けられてしまう。
lines.translated: Which means my face ends up pressed against her chest.

lines.content: 柔らかい上に、ほのかにミルクのような甘い香りが
lines.translated: It's soft, and a faint sweet scent, almost like milk,

lines.content: 慣れることができない感触に、
lines.translated: The sensation is something I can never get used to --

lines.content: この歳で、姉に抱きしめられる……
lines.translated: Getting hugged by my 'big sister' at this age...

lines.content: \nそんなの、恥ずかしさしかない。

lines.translated: "I see. Well then, tell me what you'd like for dinner tonight --

lines.content: 「そう言うと思って昆布〆を買ってきてあるの！

今日まで泊まりで外出していたから、戸締まりはしたはず。

lines.content: さらに、玄関に見慣れない靴がある。

lines.content: しかも、俺の部屋から物音もしている。
lines.translated: And there's a sound coming from my room, too.

lines.content: 両親が久しぶりにこっちに来たのか？

lines.content: \n――いや、泥棒なら、綺麗に靴を並べて置くか？
lines.translated: \n-- No, would a burglar neatly line up their shoes?

lines.translated: Long black hair and a cool, composed gaze.

-- A girl I've never seen before.

\nthey all look completely out of place in the room.

lines.content: いや、浮いて見えて当然だ。

lines.translated: \nThere's a girl I've never seen before in my room!

The girl's eyes pierce right through me --

lines.content: こともなげに、一言――って。
lines.translated: Just one word, cool as you please -- wait.

lines.content: 「[氷見山/ひみやま][玲/れい]です」
俺の動揺を気にした様子もなく、淡々と少女は言う。
lines.translated: Without seeming to care about my shock, she states it matter-of-factly.

lines.content: 説明は十分とでも思ったのか。
lines.translated: As if she figured that was explanation enough.

lines.content: \nまたヘッドホンをつけ、鍵盤を叩き始める。
lines.translated: \nShe puts her headphones back on and starts playing the keys again.

lines.content: 「待て待て待て、名前を言われたところで――」
lines.translated: "Hold on, hold on, hold on -- just telling me your name doesn't--"
"I'm pretty sure we've never met before."

lines.content: 「たぶん、そうだと思います。でも、氷見山です」

母の旧姓が『氷見山』……だったはず。

lines.content: 母方の親戚とは、あまり交流はない。
lines.translated: I haven't had much contact with my mom's side of the family.

lines.content: \nでも、叔父に同じ年頃の子がいると聞いたことがある。

lines.translated: That said, calling my cousin by her last name feels kind of weird, so

lines.translated: "I took the train and walked. I unlocked the door and came in."

lines.content: 「いや、そういう意味じゃなくて――え？
lines.translated: "No, that's not what I meant-- wait, huh?

lines.content: 「おばさんからもらいました。

lines.translated: "Your mom said she would let you know, but..."

lines.translated: As you can tell from how hands-off she is with her own son,

lines.translated: \nboth my mom and dad are a little careless like that.

lines.translated: She might as well have said, "So what?"

lines.translated: \nDoes she have no thoughts about that at all?

"I'm going to make a quick call."

lines.translated: "'Well, just take good care of her... and besides, you're not

あの子――玲のことを話さないと――

lines.translated: Tonight, since we're short on time, it's instant ramen.

lines.content: もちろん、それだけだと寂しいので、上に乗せる肉野菜炒めを
lines.translated: Of course, that alone would be a bit sad, so I'm cutting vegetables
\nto make a stir-fried meat and veggie topping to go on it.

lines.content: 「いえ、そういうことでしたら」
lines.translated: "No, if that's the reason, then it's fine."

lines.content: 夕飯ができるまでのつなぎとして、余りご飯で作った
lines.translated: As something to tide her over until dinner is ready, I hand Rei

lines.content: \nおにぎりを玲に渡せば、もそもそ食べている。
lines.translated: \nan onigiri made from leftover rice, and she nibbles at it quietly.

lines.content: 台所はカウンター型になっているので、
lines.translated: The kitchen has a counter-style layout,

lines.content: \n流し台越しの廊下に玲が立っていることになる。
lines.translated: \nso Rei is standing in the hallway on the other side of the sink.

lines.content: 「玲はゆっくりしてていいよ」
立って見られているのも、落ち着かない。
lines.translated: Having her stand there watching me makes me a little uneasy.

lines.content: \nそう伝えたが、玲はその場でじっと俺を見続ける。
lines.translated: \nI told her as much, but Rei just keeps standing there, staring at me.

lines.content: 周りに興味がない子……そう思いきや、
lines.translated: I thought she wasn't interested in the people around her, but

lines.content: \n玲は妙に距離が近いことがある。
lines.translated: \nRei has a strange habit of getting unusually close.

lines.content: 今もそうだし、同じ部屋で暮らしていること自体もそうだ。
lines.translated: Like right now -- and the fact that we're living in the same room is another example.

lines.content: 何か意図があるんだろうか……？
lines.translated: Is there some kind of intention behind it...?

lines.content: 「玲は、嫌いな食べ物ってある？」
lines.translated: "Rei, is there any food you don't like?"

lines.content: せっかくなので料理をしながら話しかけることにする。
lines.translated: Since we're here, I decide to make conversation while I cook.

lines.content: まだまだ、この従妹をわかってないので知りたい。
lines.translated: I still don't know this cousin of mine very well, and I want to change that.

lines.content: 「そうそう、家の裏は近道があるけど、夜はかなり
lines.translated: "Oh, right -- there's a shortcut behind the house, but it gets pretty

lines.content: \n暗くなるから気をつけてくれ」

lines.translated: "What time did you get back today?"

lines.content: 「それじゃ、まっすぐ帰ってきたんだ」
淡々と、ひと言で返される。
lines.translated: She replies with a single, matter-of-fact word.

lines.content: その表情から、会話をどう思っているのかは読めない。
lines.translated: I can't read from her expression what she thinks of the conversation.

lines.content: \n嫌ではない……そう、思いたいが。
lines.translated: \nShe doesn't dislike it... at least, that's what I want to believe.

lines.content: 「そうそう、家にあるものはなんでも自由に
lines.translated: "Oh, and feel free to use anything in the house

lines.content: 「食べ物とか石けんとか……生活に必要なものがあったら、
lines.translated: "Food, soap, anything you need for daily life --

lines.content: \n買ってきた後レシートくれれば、そのお金は出すし」
lines.translated: \njust give me the receipt after you buy it and I'll cover the cost."

lines.content: 昨日の夜、もう一度両親に電話をして、
lines.translated: Last night, I called my parents again

lines.content: \n生活費については話をつけてある。
lines.translated: \nand sorted out the living expenses situation.

lines.content: 毎月渡してくれる生活費に、玲の分も上乗せしてくれる
lines.translated: They said they'd add Rei's share on top of the monthly
\nliving allowance they give me, so it's no problem.

lines.content: 「俺がいないときでも適当にすぐ食べられるもの、
lines.translated: "When I'm not around, it might be a good idea to pick up
\nsome things you can eat right away."

lines.content: 「確かに……私もお茶ぐらいは淹れられますし」\@

lines.content: 「お茶ならそっちの戸棚にセットで置いてある」
lines.translated: "There's a tea set in that cupboard over there."

lines.content: 戸棚を指差すと、玲がそこに向かい中身を確認。
lines.translated: I point to the cupboard, and Rei walks over to check what's inside.

lines.content: 確認して俺の前に戻ってくる。
lines.translated: She confirms it and comes back to stand in front of me.

lines.content: \n相変わらずのほどほどに近い距離だ。
lines.translated: \nSame as always -- that moderately close distance.

lines.content: 「生活で困ってることはないか？」
lines.translated: "Is there anything you're having trouble with around the house?"

lines.content: 「今のところは、食事ぐらいですね」
lines.translated: "For now, meals are about the only thing."

lines.content: さっきのお腹の音を聞けばよくわかる。
lines.translated: That stomach rumble from earlier made that pretty clear.

lines.content: 「私が作ればいいのかもしれませんが」
lines.translated: "Maybe I should be the one cooking."

lines.content: 「ちなみに……玲が作るとなったら？」
lines.translated: "So, hypothetically... if you were to cook?"

lines.content: 「スプラッター映画の実写をご所望でしたら、します」
lines.translated: "If you'd like a live-action splatter film, then sure."

lines.content: 冗談か本気かわからないこと言って、またおにぎりをひと口。\@
lines.translated: She says something that I can't tell is a joke or serious, then takes another bite of her onigiri.\@

lines.content: 淡々と言っているが、包丁は持たせてはいけないな。
lines.translated: She says it so matter-of-factly, but I definitely cannot let her near a knife.

lines.content: そんなことを思いつつ、こちらは切った野菜を炒めていく。
lines.translated: Thinking that, I go back to stir-frying the chopped vegetables.

lines.content: \n炒め終われば、並行して茹でていた麺と合わせて出来上がり。
lines.translated: \nOnce that's done, I combine them with the noodles I've been boiling at the same time, and it's finished.

lines.content: 玲は、相変わらず、おにぎりを食べながら見ている。
lines.translated: Rei, as always, watches while eating her onigiri.

lines.content: 「……ま。すぐにとは言わないけど、実家みたいな気分で
lines.translated: "...Well. I'm not saying right away, but just think of this place

lines.content: \n暮らしてくれればいいから」
lines.translated: \nas your own home and make yourself comfortable."

lines.content: ずっと気を張るようなことがあっても辛いだけだし、
lines.translated: It would be exhausting to stay on edge all the time,

lines.content: \nリラックスして過ごして欲しい。
lines.translated: \nso I want her to be able to relax here.

lines.content: そう言った後も、俺の前に立つのは変わらず。
lines.translated: Even after saying that, she still stood in front of me, unchanged.

lines.content: \nあまりリラックスしているようには見えなかった。
ラーメンを作り終わる頃に、
lines.translated: Just as I finished making the ramen,

lines.content: \nちょうど姉さんもやってきて三人で夕飯をとる。
lines.translated: \nSis showed up right on cue, and the three of us had dinner together.

lines.content: 「急いで作ったけど、ラーメンどうだ？」
lines.translated: "I threw this together in a hurry, but how's the ramen?"

lines.content: 急いで作ったものなので、美味しいと断言されると
lines.translated: Since I'd rushed to make it, being told outright that it's delicious

lines.content: 「うん、ラーメンは、君の方が得意だよねぇ……
lines.translated: "Yeah, you're definitely better at ramen than me...

lines.content: \n私、即席麺って茹で過ぎちゃうの」\@
「麺の硬さ、このくらいがいいですね」\@
「そうそう、麺はかためが一番！」\@
幼馴染と、従妹が頷き合う。

lines.content: 食べ物に関してはこの従妹はけっこうわかりやすい……
lines.translated: When it comes to food, this cousin of mine is actually pretty easy to read...

lines.content: スープに浮いていたもやしまでしっかり食べ終わると、
lines.translated: Once she'd finished eating everything, right down to the bean sprouts floating in the broth,

lines.content: 「空腹の時はひもじさで生きている実感がありましたが、
lines.translated: "When I was hungry, the pangs of hunger made me feel alive,

lines.content: \n今は、満腹の胃の重さで生きている実感があります」
lines.translated: \nbut now, the heaviness of a full stomach makes me feel alive."
"I'll take the bath first, if that's alright."

lines.content: そのまま居間を出ていった。
lines.translated: And with that, she left the living room.

lines.content: 「玲ちゃんって面白いこと言うね」
lines.translated: "Rei-chan says some interesting things, doesn't she?"
"That's pretty much how she is, from what I can tell."

lines.content: 今のは玲なりの冗談だったのかもしれないが……。
lines.translated: That might have been Rei's version of a joke just now, but...

lines.content: だとしたら、しっかり馴染もうとして
lines.translated: If so, does that mean she's actually trying to fit in
"She seems to march to her own beat, but...

lines.content: \n何か気になるようなことがあれば、相談するよ」
lines.translated: \nif anything about her starts to worry me, I'll come to you."

lines.content: 「そうね。同じ家の同じ部屋で生活してるんだし。
lines.translated: "Sure. You two do live in the same house -- the same room, even.

lines.content: 「もちろん、従兄――お兄さんなわけだし」
lines.translated: "Well, you are her cousin -- her older brother figure, after all."

lines.content: いつも姉さんの『弟』だったので、
\nそう言われると新鮮だった。
lines.translated: \nso hearing it the other way around felt strangely fresh.

lines.content: 姉さんも家に戻り、俺も風呂から上がれば、
lines.translated: After Sis headed home and I got out of the bath,

lines.content: \n玲がまた、ピアノを弾いていた。
とはいえ、ヘッドホンを付けているので音はしない。
lines.translated: Though, since she had headphones on, there was no sound.

lines.content: 相変わらず、俺以外がいる部屋に入るのは少し戸惑う。
lines.translated: I still wasn't used to walking into my own room with someone else in it.
(If I'm the "big brother," then Rei would be the "little sister," huh...)

lines.content: 姉さんが言ってたけど、なんとも実感の湧かない話だ。
lines.translated: Sis had said as much, but it still didn't feel real.

lines.content: 俺の視線に気づいたのか、玲がこちらを見る。
lines.translated: Maybe sensing my gaze, Rei looked over at me.

lines.content: ピアノは玲がわざわざ実家から持ってきたものだ。
lines.translated: The piano was something Rei had gone out of her way to bring from her family home.

lines.content: \nそれに知識のない俺でも、値の張るものなのはわかる。
lines.translated: \nAnd even I, with no real knowledge of these things, could tell it was expensive.

lines.content: 『別に』で買う代物ではないと思うし、
lines.translated: It wasn't the kind of thing you'd buy on a "not particularly" basis,

lines.content: \n『ピアノを弾く』自体、練習しなければ無理なことだ。
lines.translated: \nand playing the piano itself requires practice -- you can't just do it out of nowhere.

lines.content: 「音楽を聞いてる時って暇になります。
lines.translated: "Just listening to music leaves me with nothing to do.

lines.content: \nですから、自分で弾いたほうが合理的かつ効率的です」
lines.translated: \nSo it's more rational and efficient to play it myself."

lines.content: 俺の疑問顔に気づいたのか、玲がそう答えてくれる。
lines.translated: She must have noticed my puzzled expression, because Rei answered me.

lines.content: 「ええ、音楽を聞いている間、音楽を奏でることが
lines.translated: "Yes. Because while I'm listening to music,
\nI can also be the one producing it."

lines.content: わかるようなわからないような……。
lines.translated: I kind of understood, and kind of didn't...

lines.content: また、曲を奏で始めていく。
気のせいかもしれないが、ピアノを弾いている時の玲は、
lines.translated: It might have been my imagination, but Rei looked more relaxed

lines.content: \n普段よりもリラックスしてるようにも見える。
lines.translated: \nwhen she was playing the piano than usual.

lines.content: 俺が音楽を聞いてるときと似たような感じだ。
lines.translated: It reminded me of how I feel when I'm listening to music.

lines.content: 音楽を聞くことに集中したいから、自分で奏でる。
lines.translated: She wants to focus on listening to music, so she plays it herself.

lines.content: \nそういうことなんだろうか。
lines.translated: \nWas that what it came down to?
"What kind of songs do you play?"

lines.content: 玲の指が止まったところで聞いてみる。
lines.translated: I asked when Rei's fingers came to a stop.

lines.content: 曲が聞きたいと言うより、玲がどんな曲に興味があるか、
lines.translated: It was less that I wanted to hear the song, and more that I wanted to know
\nwhat kind of music Rei was interested in.
Had I pushed a little too far?

lines.content: 「……今日はここまでにするので」
そう言ってピアノを片付ける。
lines.translated: She said that and put the piano away.

lines.content: 『いや』とも『いい』とも言わないのは……遠慮なのか、
lines.translated: She didn't say "no" or "sure" either -- was she holding back,

lines.content: 血の繋がりがあっても、まだまだ『他人』か……。
lines.translated: Even with a blood connection, we were still basically "strangers"...
"Well then, I'm turning off the lights."

lines.content: 夜も更けたので、電気を消して床につく。
lines.translated: The night had grown late, so I switched off the lights and got into bed.

lines.content: まだ短い付き合いだが、妙なところで真面目だ。
lines.translated: We hadn't known each other long, but she was oddly earnest in her own way.

lines.content: やっぱりしっかり答えてくれた。
lines.translated: She gave me a proper reply, just as I expected.

lines.content: \nマイペースだけど、我が道を行くわけではないらしい。
lines.translated: \nShe marched to her own beat, but it didn't seem like she was shutting everyone out.

lines.content: いつもより少し早く目を覚ませば、玲はまだ寝ていた。
lines.translated: I woke up a little earlier than usual, and Rei was still asleep.

lines.content: すやすや寝ている玲は、いつもの大人びた様子と違って、
lines.translated: Sleeping soundly like that, Rei looked nothing like her usual mature self --
\nshe came across much more like the younger girl she actually was.

lines.content: 「……寝顔を見るのはどうなんだ」
lines.translated: "...is it okay to be watching her sleep like this?"

lines.content: 女の子だろうが妹だろうが失礼だ。
lines.translated: Whether she's a girl or a little sister, it's still rude.

lines.content: \nそう自分にツッコミを入れ、着替えて外へ。
lines.translated: \nI gave myself that mental scolding, then got changed and headed outside.

lines.content: 外に出れば、姉さんもすでに起きて掃除をしている。

lines.content: 「おはよう。俺、あっちから掃いてくる」
俺も竹箒を持ってきて、表通りの落ち葉を掃き清める。
lines.translated: I grabbed a bamboo broom and started clearing the fallen leaves from the main street.

lines.content: 「いや、先週会ったばかりですよ」
lines.translated: "We just saw each other last week, you know."

lines.content: 俺や姉さん以外にも、通りでは掃除をしている人が
lines.translated: Besides me and Chitose, a few other people were out
\ncleaning along the street, so we exchanged greetings.

lines.content: ながれ茶屋街は観光地でもあるため、
lines.translated: Since Nagare Chayagai is a tourist area,

この時期の紅葉は綺麗だが、滑りやすいし、濡れれば
lines.translated: The autumn leaves are beautiful this time of year, but they get slippery, and once wet

lines.translated: \nthey stick to the stone pavement and make a mess, so regular sweeping is a must.

lines.content: 軽快に掃除をする姉さんは楽しげ。
lines.translated: Chitose swept with a light, cheerful energy, looking like she was having fun.

lines.content: 姉さんは、料理にしろ掃除にしろ、

lines.translated: \nChitose apparently just enjoys housework in general.

lines.content: 「姉さん、こっちにまとめるから」
lines.translated: "Sis, I'll pile them up over here."

lines.content: ちりとりを差し出せば、まとめた落ち葉を入れてくれる。
lines.translated: I held out the dustpan and she swept the pile right in.

lines.content: \n取りこぼし無し。見事なお手前だ。
lines.translated: \nNot a single leaf missed. Impressive technique.
"Alright, let's get the back clean too!"

lines.content: 細い路地を通り、そこも掃きつつ裏手に出る。
lines.translated: We passed through a narrow alley, sweeping as we went, and came out around the back.

lines.content: 「やっぱりここは、朝でもちょっと薄暗いね」
lines.translated: "It really is a little dim back here, even in the morning."

lines.content: 裏手から、さらに奥へと伸びる階段手前で、
lines.translated: At the foot of the stairs stretching further into the back,

lines.content: 「でも涼しい……まだちょっと暑い日もあるからありがたいね」
lines.translated: "But it's cool... there are still some warm days, so that's actually nice."

lines.content: その名の通り、いつでも薄暗く、夜には真っ暗に
lines.translated: True to its name, it's always dim, and at night it becomes

lines.content: \nなってしまう場所からついた名前だ。
lines.translated: \ncompletely pitch black -- that's where the name comes from.

lines.content: 大通りに出るにはこっちの方が近道なので、
lines.translated: It's actually a shortcut to the main street from here,

lines.content: \n時間がない時はたまに通ったりする。
lines.translated: \nso I cut through it sometimes when I'm in a hurry.

lines.content: 「こっちは路地裏だから、すぐゴミが溜まっちゃう」
lines.translated: "It's a back alley, so trash just piles up so fast."

lines.content: 細い路地なので風の通り道になっており、
lines.translated: Being a narrow alley, it acts as a wind channel,

lines.content: \n自然とゴミの吹き溜まりができてしまうのだ。
だから、ここはより丁寧に掃いていく。
lines.translated: So we made sure to sweep this area extra carefully.

lines.content: 「くらやみ坂って言えば、昔、肝試ししたことあったね」
lines.translated: "Speaking of Kurayami Slope, remember when we did that courage test here as kids?"

lines.content: 「ああ、あった。懐かしいなぁ……ホタルを見たんだっけ」
lines.translated: "Oh yeah, we did. That takes me back... wasn't it fireflies we saw?"

lines.content: ――あれは１０年前ぐらいだったろうか。
lines.translated: -- That was about ten years ago, I think.

lines.content: くらやみ坂に、おばけが出ると聞いて、
lines.translated: We'd heard there was a ghost on Kurayami Slope,

lines.content: \n夜に二人でこっそり観に行ったのだ。
lines.translated: \nso the two of us snuck out at night to go see.

lines.content: そこで『光る何か』を見た。
今思えば、ホタルだったんだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Looking back now, it was probably fireflies, but...

lines.content: 「怖くて動けなくなったんだっけ？
lines.translated: "We got so scared we couldn't move, right?

lines.content: \nうわ、恥ずかしいこと思い出した」
よく覚えていないが、暗がりで姉さんと
lines.translated: I don't remember it that well, but I have this memory of

lines.content: \nしばらく固まって動けなかった記憶がある。
lines.translated: \nbeing frozen in the dark with sis for a while, unable to move.

lines.content: 「――ふふ、そうね。怖くて動けなくて……
lines.translated: "--hehe, yeah. We were too scared to move...

lines.content: 無事に掃除を終えて、表に戻ってくる。
lines.translated: We finished the cleaning without a hitch and headed back to the front.

lines.content: すると、玲が外に出てきた。
玲の視線が、俺たちの手――箒へと向かう。
lines.translated: Rei's gaze drifted toward our hands -- the brooms.

lines.translated: "This area's a tourist spot, so there are days when
\nthe locals all pitch in to clean."

lines.content: 掃除の説明はしてなかった。
lines.translated: I hadn't explained the cleaning to her.

lines.content: 「でしたら、次からは私もします」
「別に気にしなくていいぞ。朝早いし、うちは俺が出るし」
lines.translated: "You don't have to worry about it. It's early in the morning, and I'm the one who handles it for our place."

『気にするな』という意味で言ったつもりだったが、
lines.translated: I'd meant it as "don't worry about it,"

lines.translated: "Like your own home... that's what you said.

lines.content: \nでしたら、私も役割を持つべきです」
lines.translated: \nIf so, then I should have a role too."

玲との距離感を、まだ『他人』だと思い、

lines.translated: \nand without realizing it, I'd probably been treating her that way.

lines.content: 「うん！　話がまとまったなら、朝ごはんにしましょ♪」

lines.translated: Sis said it with a smile,

lines.content: \n暗くなりそうだった空気も明るくなる。
lines.translated: \nand the mood that had been about to turn heavy brightened right up.

lines.content: 玲も頷いて家に入っていく。
昨日『実家のように過ごしてくれてかまわない』
lines.translated: Yesterday I'd said, "feel free to treat this place like home" --

lines.content: リラックスしてくれという意味だったが、
lines.translated: I'd meant it as "please relax and make yourself comfortable," but

lines.content: \n実家なら『お手伝い』も入ってくる。
lines.translated: \nif it were your own home, you'd pitch in and help out.

lines.content: 玲は、ちゃんとその言葉通りしようとしてくれた。
lines.translated: Rei had taken those words to heart and tried to do exactly that.

lines.content: 周りに興味がないように見えて、
lines.translated: She might seem indifferent to the world around her,

lines.content: \nしっかり気遣いができている。
「まったく……印象だけじゃなくて、
lines.translated: "Geez... I can't just go by first impressions.

lines.content: \nちゃんと知らないと、ダメだよな」
lines.translated: \nI need to actually get to know her."

lines.content: 自分の頭を軽く叩いて、二人を追って家に入った。

lines.content: 食事を終えた玲が、早々に席を立つ。
lines.translated: Rei finished eating and quickly got up from her seat.

lines.content: 玲が出て行ってしまった。

lines.content: 昨日の俺たちを見て、今日は遠慮をしたのか、
lines.translated: Maybe seeing us yesterday made her want to give us space,

lines.content: \nそれとも単に、干渉されたくないのか……。
lines.translated: \nor maybe she just doesn't want anyone interfering with her...

lines.content: でも『実家』として生活しようとしているみたいだから、
lines.translated: But since she seems to be settling in here as her "home,"

lines.content: \n俺たちを拒絶しているわけではないと思う。
lines.translated: \nI don't think she's pushing us away.

lines.content: （あれこれ考えるより、まずは『知る』ことか）
lines.translated: (Rather than overthinking it, I should focus on getting to "know" her first.)

lines.content: 綺麗に包んだ弁当袋が三つ、台所のカウンターに
lines.translated: Three neatly wrapped lunch bags were sitting on the kitchen counter,

lines.content: 「今日もあるとは思ってなかったのかも」
lines.translated: "She probably didn't expect one again today."

lines.content: 「ちゃんと伝えておけば良かったね」

lines.content: けど、玲は今出たばかりだから――
「追いつけるかも。持っていくよ」
lines.translated: "I might be able to catch up. I'll bring it to her."

lines.content: 言ったものの、やっぱりちょっと恥ずかしい。

lines.content: \n玲と登校してみるのも良いかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nWalking to school with Rei might not be a bad idea.

lines.content: （[お客さん/いとこ]のこと、知りたいし）
lines.translated: (I do want to get to know my "guest" -- my cousin -- better.)

lines.content: 「そっかぁ♪　うん、よろしくね。お兄ちゃん！」\@

lines.content: 姉さんは察してくれたのか、いつものように笑ってくれる。
lines.translated: Chitose seemed to pick up on it, and gave me her usual smile.

lines.content: \n長年『姉』でいる人の余裕なのかもしれなかった。
lines.translated: \nMaybe that was just the composure that comes from years of being an older sister.

lines.content: 外に出て見回しても、当然、玲はいない。
lines.translated: I stepped outside and looked around, but of course, Rei was nowhere in sight.

lines.content: 大通りルートで行ったのなら、近道のくらやみ坂を通れば
lines.translated: If she took the main road, cutting through Kurayami Slope might let me

lines.translated: Thinking that, I headed toward Kurayami Slope,

lines.translated: \nand found Rei crouching in front of the stone Jizo statue.

lines.content: 地蔵をじっと見ていた玲が、こっちを向いて立ち上がる。
lines.translated: Rei, who had been staring at the Jizo, turned to look at me and stood up.

lines.content: 「お茶の時間は、良いのですか？」
「ああ、ほら、弁当を忘れてたろ」
lines.translated: "Oh, right -- look, you forgot your lunch."
I held out the lunch bag.

lines.content: しげしげとお弁当袋と俺の顔を見比べる。
lines.translated: She looked back and forth between the lunch bag and my face.

lines.content: 「せっかく姉さんが作ってくれたわけだし。

lines.translated: \nI'd be happy if you took it with you."

lines.translated: It's less about waste and more that I just wanted to walk with Rei.

lines.content: \n玲は一人頷き、受け取ってくれる。

「ここが暗い坂だから、危なくないように、

lines.translated: \nso people wouldn't get hurt -- or something like that."

lines.content: 「ほう……では、坂より後なんですね」

lines.content: 「たぶんね。子供の遊び場になってるし、
\nその辺の安全を見て欲しいのかも」
lines.translated: \nso maybe it's meant to watch over them."

lines.content: お地蔵さんといえば、子どもの守り神と聞いたことがある。
lines.translated: I'd heard that Jizo statues are guardian deities of children.

lines.content: \n意外とこういうものに興味があるらしい。
lines.translated: \nSeems she's surprisingly interested in things like this.

lines.translated: "Are you sure you don't want to go back and finish your tea?"

lines.content: 「蔦町先輩が話していました。

lines.content: 「まだ時間はあると思いますし、戻ったほうが良いと思います」
lines.translated: "There should still be time, so I think you should go back."

lines.content: 姉さんの言葉を覚えており、気にしてくれている。

\nYeah... she really is a good kid.

lines.content: 「今日はこのまま学園に行くよ」
「では、私にお弁当を渡すために早く出た、

lines.translated: \nin order to bring me my lunch?"

lines.translated: "I left early because I wanted to walk to school with you."

lines.content: 玲の言葉は事実だけど、こちらの事実も伝える。

lines.content: \nそれは、おかしなことじゃないと思う」
その言い方は、やや誤解を招きそうだが。
lines.translated: The way she put it could be a little misleading, but.

lines.translated: The only time I'd seen Rei outside the house was up on the rooftop.

lines.content: \n普段のこの子がどうしているか、興味はある。
lines.translated: \nI am curious about what she's like in her day-to-day life.

lines.content: 頷くと玲が歩き始める。
lines.translated: She gave a nod and started walking.

lines.translated: I decided to follow after Rei.

lines.content: 道に落ちた、色づいた紅葉をつまみ上げて、

lines.translated: She didn't seem to mind that I was with her.

lines.content: \nということは、普段からこんな風に登校してるんだろうか。
lines.translated: \nDid that mean she always walked to school like this?

lines.content: 俺の視線に気づいたのか、玲が振り返る。

lines.translated: "No... I was just thinking you sure take your time getting to school."

lines.content: 「家を出たのが早いですから。

lines.translated: \nSo I have time to spare, and I'm making good use of it."

lines.translated: This wandering, stroll-like commute was, for Rei, what she'd call

lines.translated: Rei, enjoying her time at her own pace.

それだったら何も、寝るのも一緒である必要はない。

lines.content: 「楽しいことは、別になかったと思いますが……」
lines.translated: "I don't think anything particularly enjoyable happened, though..."

疑問は疑問としても、玲のことが少しわかったのだから、
lines.translated: Questions aside, I'd learned a little more about Rei,

lines.content: \nそれは、楽しいと言っていい。
lines.translated: \nand that was reason enough to call it fun.

lines.content: 「『私が楽しい』と『あなたが楽しい』には、
\n因果がありません。それは、非合理的です」
「……まぁ、暇でないのなら良いと思いますけど」
lines.translated: "...Well, as long as you weren't bored, I suppose that's fine."

lines.translated: "And the thank-you... I still don't get that."

lines.translated: My cousin stood there with a question mark practically floating over her head,

案外、この従妹はクールに見えて『楽しい』のかもしれない。
lines.translated: Surprisingly, this cousin of mine -- cool as she seemed -- might actually be "fun" to be around.

戸惑っているクラスメートたちに、笑顔で挨拶している辺り、
lines.translated: The way she greeted her bewildered classmates with a smile said a lot --

昨日まったく連絡が取れなかった転校生が堂々といるのだから、

lines.translated: "Looks like she really is the transfer student."

lines.translated: "Well, people tend to come together when they have a common enemy."

lines.content: 昨日いなかったことなど、もう誰も気にしてはいない。

lines.content: 色々手続きがあった――さっき黒姫さんはそう言っていたけど。
lines.translated: There were various procedures to take care of -- that's what Kurohime-san said earlier.

lines.content: （ま……昨日の言葉は冗談の一環か）

「朝までは一番仲良しだったのが、女子たちに

lines.content: 一応元気づけようとしているのか、それともいつものノリか。

lines.translated: Lunch break started, and the classroom filled with its usual lively chatter.

lines.content: ――かと思ったが、皆が教室の入口に注目している。

lines.translated: \nActually, dozens of times wouldn't even cover it.

lines.translated: \nMeaning there's more sugar than flour... it gets more puzzling by the minute."

lines.content: 「これでは、生姜せんべいというより生姜飴なのでは……」
lines.translated: "At this point, wouldn't it be more accurate to call it ginger candy than ginger senbei...?"

lines.content: 「それだと、クレープも生クリームとバナナの小麦巻きに
lines.translated: "By that logic, a crepe would just be
\nwhipped cream and banana wrapped in wheat flour."

lines.content: 「なるほど、それは盲点でした」
lines.translated: "I see. I hadn't thought of that."

lines.content: 適当に言ったのに、納得されてしまった。

lines.translated: "Ginger and sweet senbei shouldn't go together... or rather,

lines.translated: \nif they do, I should rationally investigate why."

lines.content: 噛み砕いて言えば『美味しいから味わって食べます』と
lines.translated: In plain terms, that's basically her saying "It's good, so I want to savor it properly" --

lines.content: あれだけ食べる前に抗弁していたので、
lines.translated: She argued so strongly against it before even trying it,

lines.content: \n素直に認められないのかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nso maybe she just can't bring herself to admit it outright.

lines.content: 確かに今、俺は笑っているのを自覚している。
lines.translated: I'm aware that I'm smiling right now.

lines.content: \n玲からすれば、ニヤついていると思われても仕方ない。
lines.translated: \nFrom Rei's perspective, it's no wonder she thinks I'm smirking.

lines.content: でも、こちらから見れば、今の玲は素直になれなくて、
lines.translated: But from where I'm standing, the Rei right now looks like she just can't be honest with herself,

lines.content: \n照れ隠しをしているようにも見えてしまう。
lines.translated: \nand is trying to hide her embarrassment.

lines.content: 「いや……また一つ発見があったってだけ」
lines.translated: "No... I just made another little discovery, that's all."

lines.content: また玲が俺をじっと見て来る。
「あなたは……よく、わかりません」
「私は……いえ、結果としては良いのですが。
lines.translated: "I... well, the outcome is fine, I suppose.

lines.content: \n従兄というのは、こういうものなんでしょうか？」\@
lines.translated: \nIs this just what cousins are like?"\@

lines.content: その言葉は、何か含むものがあるような……？
lines.translated: That word feels like it carries some kind of deeper meaning...
"Never mind. I was talking to myself."

lines.content: 玲がそっぽを向いてしまう。
「従兄かどうかは俺もわからない」
lines.translated: "I don't really know what a cousin is supposed to be like either."

lines.content: 「そうかもしれないけど、俺もどういうのが従兄として
lines.translated: "Maybe, but I don't know what the right way

lines.content: \n正しいか、なんてわからない」
lines.translated: \nto be a cousin even looks like."

lines.content: 「年下の子と一緒に生活するのなんて初めてだから」
lines.translated: "This is the first time I've ever lived with someone younger than me."

lines.content: こうやって考えると、俺も玲も今の立場は
lines.translated: Come to think of it, maybe neither of us really knows
\nhow to handle the position we're in right now.

lines.content: 俺だけでなく、玲も今の『距離感』をどうするか、
lines.translated: Not just me -- maybe Rei is also struggling with

lines.content: 「……ま、そろそろ帰ろうか。お腹も減ってきたし」
lines.translated: "...Well, we should probably head back soon. I'm getting hungry."

lines.content: 「ですね。今日の夕飯は何でしょう？」
lines.translated: "You're right. I wonder what's for dinner tonight?"

lines.content: ぽつりぽつりと話しつつ、帰路につく。
lines.translated: We chat in bits and pieces as we make our way home.

lines.content: わからない部分も多いけど。
lines.translated: There's still a lot I don't understand.

lines.content: 少なくとも、この空気は悪くない……そう思えた。
lines.translated: But at least... the atmosphere between us isn't bad. That's what I felt.

lines.content: 夕飯が終わり、玲は風呂へ。
lines.translated: Dinner was over, and Rei had gone to take a bath.

lines.content: \n俺たちは後片付けをしていたら、元気な声。
lines.translated: \nWe were cleaning up when we heard an energetic voice.

lines.content: 「母さん？　おかえり。珍しいね」
浮かれた声に出迎えれば、普段は駅の近くに住んでいる
lines.translated: I went to greet the cheerful voice, and there she was -- Mom, who normally lives near the station,

lines.content: 酒くさい……これは帰りに呑んできたな。
lines.translated: She smells like booze... she must've had a few on the way home.

lines.content: 「まーねー。たまには、可愛いちとせちゃんと息子の
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. Every once in a while I wanna see my cute little Chitose-chan and my son's

lines.content: 息子よりも、姉さんへの愛が大きいのもいつものこと。
lines.translated: That she cares more about Sis than her own son -- also par for the course.

lines.content: 「おおー、ちとせちゃーんっ、いつもコイツのこと、
lines.translated: "Ohh, Chitose-chaan! Thanks so much for always looking after this guy,

lines.content: 「はぐ～♪　ふふ、おばさんもお疲れさまです」\@
lines.translated: "Huug~♪ Hehe, you must be tired too, Auntie."\@

lines.content: 酔っ払って抱きつくのは、昔からなので、
lines.translated: Her drunkenly throwing her arms around people has been a thing since forever,
\nso Sis is used to it by now.

lines.content: 「ん～……お茶漬け的なもの、たべたーい」
lines.translated: "Hmm~... I kinda want something like ochazuke..."

lines.content: 「わかりました。ちょっと待っててくださいね」
lines.translated: "Got it. Just wait a moment, okay?"

lines.content: 姉さんが素早く残りご飯を取り出して、
lines.translated: Sis quickly pulled out the leftover rice

lines.content: \nお茶漬けの準備を始めてくれる。
「あ、風呂は今、玲が入ってるから」
lines.translated: "Oh, Rei's in the bath right now, just so you know."

lines.content: 「うん、シャワーの音したからわかってる」
lines.translated: "Yeah, I could hear the shower, so I figured."

lines.content: 言いつつ、冷蔵庫に入れっぱなしの缶ビールを取り出し、
lines.translated: As she said that, she pulled out a can of beer that had been sitting in the fridge
"Didn't you already drink on the way home?"
"Hair of the dog, hair of the dog."

lines.content: 「それは二日酔いの時……というか、
\nそもそも、身体に悪いんじゃなかったっけ」
lines.translated: \nisn't it bad for you in the first place?"

lines.content: 「酔わないとやってられない日もあるのよ、息子ー」
lines.translated: "Some days you just can't cope without a drink, son."

lines.content: バシッと背中を叩かれる。
lines.translated: She slaps me hard on the back.

lines.content: とはいえ、いつものことなので、すでに諦めの境地だ。
lines.translated: That said, since this is nothing new, I've already resigned myself to it.

lines.content: 「それで？　玲ちゃんとは仲良くやってる？」
lines.translated: "So? Are you getting along with Rei-chan?"

lines.content: 「そっかぁ……心配してたけど大丈夫みたいね」
lines.translated: "I see... I was worried, but it sounds like things are fine."

lines.content: 「そりゃ、姪っ子を預かってるんだから当然よ」
lines.translated: "Well, of course -- we're looking after my niece."

lines.content: 「無関心の極みだったのに、言うね」
lines.translated: "You were the picture of total indifference, and now you say that."

lines.content: 「アンタたちに任せりゃ問題ないって信じてるのよ。
lines.translated: "I trust you two to handle it without any problems.

lines.content: \nあ、でも、同じ部屋で暮らしてるんだっけ？」
lines.translated: \nOh, but wait -- you're sharing a room, right?"

lines.content: 姉さんと母さんは連絡先を知っているので、
lines.translated: Since Sis and Mom have each other's contact info,

lines.content: \n情報が流れていても不思議はない。
lines.translated: \nit's no surprise that information gets passed along.

lines.content: 「姉さんに聞いた？　心配なら俺と玲が同じ部屋なのに
lines.translated: "Did you hear that from Sis? If you were worried, the fact that you said nothing about me and Rei sharing a room --

lines.content: \n何も言わないってのも、伯母としてどうなんだ？」
lines.translated: \nwhat kind of aunt does that make you?"
"What? You planning to make a move?"

lines.content: 「いや、そういうのはないけど」
「そうです。従妹相手にありえませんよ、お兄ちゃんです」
lines.translated: "That's right. He would never do that to his cousin -- he's her big brother."

lines.content: お茶漬けを持ってきた姉さんも断言してくれる。
lines.translated: Sis, who had brought over the ochazuke, backed that up without hesitation.

lines.content: 「そっかぁ、お兄ちゃんなら大丈夫か」
lines.translated: "Oh, if it's her big brother, then I guess it's fine."

lines.content: 姉さんが言うと母さんも納得する。
lines.translated: When Sis says it, Mom accepts it without question.

lines.content: \nでも、それは一般的に大丈夫という理由になるんだろうか。
lines.translated: \nBut does "big brother" really count as a valid reason to not worry, generally speaking?

lines.content: 「玲ちゃんだからこその心配もあったけど……
lines.translated: "I did have some worries specific to Rei-chan, though...

lines.content: 「出汁をちょっと入れたので」
lines.translated: "I added a little dashi to it."

lines.content: 「うん、ちとせちゃんの料理はやっぱ、
「玲だからこその心配って何が？」
lines.translated: "What kind of worries specific to Rei?"

lines.content: 流されそうになった聞き捨てならない言葉を訊く。
lines.translated: I ask about the words that almost slipped by -- words I couldn't just let go.

lines.content: 「うーん、ほら、あの子、ちょっとマイペースと言うか、
lines.translated: "Hmm, well, you know -- she's a bit of a free spirit, or rather,

lines.content: \n自分の世界を大切にしているタイプでしょ」
lines.translated: \nshe's the type who really values her own world."

lines.content: ここ数日でよくわかったことだ。
lines.translated: It's something I've come to understand well over the past few days.

lines.content: 「元々一人っ子だし……あんまり他の人と生活する～って
lines.translated: "She's always been an only child, so... she never really seemed like the type

lines.content: 「だから、ウチに居候したいって聞いた時、
lines.translated: "So when I heard she wanted to stay with us,

lines.content: \nびっくりしたのよ。うまくいくのかなーって」
lines.translated: \nI was surprised. I wondered if it would even work out."

lines.content: 「一人っ子が同年代の子と生活するってことは、
lines.translated: "For an only child to live with someone her own age --

lines.content: \n今までと勝手が違うから、戸惑うと思うの」
lines.translated: \nit's a whole different dynamic than what she's used to, so I figured she'd struggle."

lines.content: 「でも、同じ部屋なのよね……慣れるために
lines.translated: "But they're sharing a room, right... maybe it's like

lines.content: \n荒療治でもしてるのかしらね」
そうか……一人っ子の玲にとって、今の生活は、
lines.translated: I see... for Rei, who's always been an only child, life right now might be

lines.content: \n俺が想像する以上に、様変わりした世界なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: \na completely different world than anything I could imagine.

lines.content: 「玲、いい子だし、今のところ大丈夫だと思う」
lines.translated: "Rei's a good kid, and I think things are fine so far."

lines.content: 「ええ、ご飯も残さず食べてくれるし」\@
lines.translated: "Yes, she always finishes everything on her plate, too."\@

lines.content: 「そっかぁ……ま、今のところうまくいってるみたいだし、
lines.translated: "I see... well, it sounds like things are going well for now,

lines.content: \nあたしの心配しすぎかもね……うん、仲良くお願いね」
lines.translated: \nmaybe I was just worrying too much... yeah, please get along, you two."
The two of us nod without thinking.

lines.content: 母さんの言う通り、玲は独立独歩の気質が強く、
lines.translated: Just like Mom said, Rei has a strong streak of independence,

lines.content: \n独りの方が気楽そうにみえる。
lines.translated: \nand she always seems more at ease on her own.

lines.content: その割にこうして、同じ部屋にいるし、
lines.translated: And yet, here she is, sharing a room with me,

lines.content: \n色々と手伝いも申し出てくれる。
lines.translated: \nand she's even offered to help out with various things.

lines.content: 共同生活を合理的に進めるには、役割を持ったほうがいい――
lines.translated: She said it herself -- that having defined roles makes shared living run more smoothly --

lines.content: \n本人は言っていたし、そういうことなんだろうけど。
lines.translated: \nand I suppose that's all there is to it.

lines.content: （本当に『それだけ』なんだろうか？）
役割分担を持つ、というだけなら、何も同じ部屋にいる
lines.translated: If it were only about dividing up responsibilities, there'd be no need
\nto share the same room at all.

lines.content: 何故、玲は同じ部屋にいるのか……疑問はそこに集約される。
lines.translated: Why is Rei in the same room as me...? That's where all my questions keep coming back to.

lines.content: あれこれ考えていると、いつのまにか玲が俺を見ていた。
lines.translated: Lost in thought, I realized Rei had been watching me at some point without my noticing.

lines.content: 「あ、いや……そろそろ寝ようかと思ったから」
lines.translated: "Oh, no... I was just thinking it's about time to sleep."
"I see. I'll go to sleep too."

lines.content: いつものように、電気を消して隣り合って布団に入る。
lines.translated: Like always, we turn off the lights and slip into our futons side by side.

lines.content: あっという間に、玲の寝息が聞こえる。
lines.translated: In no time at all, I can hear Rei's quiet breathing.

lines.content: そう。玲がこの部屋にいることの理由は、
lines.translated: Right. The reason Rei gave for being in this room --

lines.content: \n『一番合理的だから』と言っていた。
lines.translated: \nshe said it was "the most rational option."

lines.content: ハウスダストに弱いと言っていたから、綺麗な場所にいたいと
lines.translated: She mentioned she's sensitive to house dust, so wanting to be somewhere clean

lines.content: でも、俺が別の部屋に行くことは避けようとした。
lines.translated: But she also tried to avoid having me move to a different room.

lines.content: 追い出す形になるのが良くない……玲はそう言っていたけど、
lines.translated: She said it wouldn't sit right to make me feel like I was being kicked out... but

lines.content: \n『俺と一緒の部屋にいたかった』と考えることもできる。
lines.translated: \nyou could also read it as her wanting to stay in the same room as me.
And then there's what Mom was guessing...

lines.content: 『俺といたい』……そこまで自意識過剰になれない。
lines.translated: "She wants to be with me"... I can't let myself get that full of myself.

lines.content: でも、俺といることに『合理的』なものが、あるとしたら？
lines.translated: But what if there is something "rational" about being with me?

lines.content: （一人っ子の玲が、俺の側にいる……）
lines.translated: (Rei, an only child, staying by my side...)

lines.content: ふと浮かんだその仮説。
lines.translated: That hypothesis that suddenly crossed my mind.

lines.content: 深く考えるよりも前に、睡魔が襲ってきて、
lines.translated: Before I could think any deeper, sleep came for me,
\nand it faded away into the dark of the night.

lines.content: 暗闇の中でも、さすがにだいたいの位置は覚えている。
lines.translated: Even in the dark, I've got a general sense of where things are by now.

lines.content: ひとまず、覚えるぐらいは馴染んだということ。
lines.translated: At least I've gotten used to it enough to remember the layout.

lines.content: トイレから戻ってくる。
lines.translated: I come back from the bathroom.

lines.content: 布団に入る前にふと隣を見れば、従兄が寝息を立てている。
lines.translated: Before getting back into my futon, I glance over and see my cousin sleeping soundly.
This too... I've gotten a little used to.

lines.content: そっと少し近くまで寄る。
lines.translated: I quietly scoot a little closer.

lines.content: 抱き合って眠っていた。
lines.translated: The two of them had slept in each other's arms.

lines.content: そして、普段も仲がいい……家族のように。
lines.translated: And they're close in everyday life too... like family.

lines.content: 障子越しの月明かりに映し出された寝顔を見つめる。
lines.translated: I gaze at the sleeping face cast in moonlight through the shoji screen.

lines.content: こうして夜も一緒だけでなく、今日は朝も夕方も一緒だった。
lines.translated: Not only are we together at night like this, but today we were together in the morning and evening too.

lines.content: もっと面倒になるかと思っていたけど。
lines.translated: I thought it would feel more suffocating, but

lines.content: \n私の自由にさせてくれている。
lines.translated: \nhe lets me do as I please.

lines.content: ズカズカと踏み込んでくるわけじゃない。
lines.translated: He doesn't come barging into my space.

lines.content: （父さんとも、母さんとも、違う……これが、従兄？）
lines.translated: (Different from Dad, different from Mom... is this what a cousin is like?)

lines.content: それとも、蔦町先輩が言っていた関係？
lines.translated: Or is it the kind of relationship Tsutamachi-senpai was talking about?

lines.content: 「私の考えていた合理性と……違う……」
lines.translated: "It's different from the rationality I had in mind..."

lines.content: [この部屋にいる意図/・・・・・・・・・]と、ズレ始めている。
lines.translated: It's starting to drift from my 'reason for being in this room.'

lines.content: 「うん、おばさん、今日早いって言ってたから。
lines.translated: "Yeah, your mom said\nshe had to head out early today.

lines.content: \n先に朝ごはん、作ろうと思って」
lines.translated: \nSo I figured I'd get breakfast started first."

lines.content: いつものように進む授業中。受けながらふと隣を見る。
lines.translated: Class was moving along as usual. While listening, I glanced over at the person next to me.

lines.content: 隣の黒姫さんは普通に授業を受けている。
lines.translated: Kurohime-san next to me was following the lesson normally.

lines.content: 内容を理解しようとしているのか、たまにシャーペンの
lines.translated: Maybe she was trying to work through the material -- every so often she'd press the eraser end of her mechanical pencil

lines.content: \nお尻を唇に当てて考えている。
そう言えば黒姫さんも、玲と同じく
lines.translated: Come to think of it, Kurohime-san had said she was an only child,

lines.content: ホーセンは確か、男兄弟の兄で、
lines.translated: Hosen was the older of two brothers, if I remembered right,

lines.content: 俺も『姉』がいるので、一人っ子の感覚はわからない――
lines.translated: I have a "big sister" of sorts myself, so I can't really understand what it's like to be an only child --

lines.content: 振り向いたホーセンが慌てた声を出して――
lines.translated: Hosen turned around and said something in a panicked voice --

lines.content: 顔を黒板に向けると、歴史教師の困った顔。
lines.translated: I turned to face the blackboard and found the history teacher looking at me with an exasperated expression.

lines.content: 慌てて立ち上がったものの、聞いてなかったから、
lines.translated: I hurriedly stood up, but since I hadn't been listening,
\nthere was no way I could answer.

lines.content: ここは聞いてなかった俺が悪い。
lines.translated: This was my fault for not paying attention.

lines.content: 「ん……まぁ、あんまりボヤッとしてるなよー」
lines.translated: "Well... try not to zone out so much, alright?"

lines.content: 小言を言われたが、そのまま授業が続けられる。
lines.translated: I got a mild scolding, but class continued on from there.

lines.content: 「しー」と人差し指を唇に当てて微笑むと、黒姫さんは
lines.translated: Kurohime-san put her index finger to her lips with a small smile, then

lines.content: 「どうしたんですか、ぼんやりして」
lines.translated: "What's on your mind? You seemed out of it."

lines.content: よほど俺が普段と違ったのか、授業が終わると、
lines.translated: I must have seemed unusually distracted, because when class ended,

lines.content: \n黒姫さんが声をかけてきた。
lines.translated: \nKurohime-san came over to talk to me.

lines.content: 「ちょっと考えごとしてたんだ」
「ほら、黒姫さん前に一人っ子って言ってただろ」
lines.translated: "Well, you mentioned before that you're an only child, right?"

lines.content: 「参考までに、一人っ子の意見を聞きたいんだ」
lines.translated: "I wanted to hear your take on it, as an only child -- just for reference."

lines.content: \n急な話題だから当たり前かもしれない。
lines.translated: \nWhich made sense, given how out of nowhere the topic was.

lines.content: 「この前から、俺の家に従妹が居候してるんだ。
lines.translated: "So, a cousin of mine has been staying at my place lately.

lines.content: \n一つ下で、この学園に通ってる」
lines.translated: \nShe's a year younger and goes to this school."

lines.content: 「従妹って言っても、親戚で交流があまりなかったから、
lines.translated: "She's my cousin, but we didn't really keep in touch with that side of the family,

lines.content: \nほとんど初対面なんだけど」
lines.translated: \nso it's almost like meeting a stranger."

lines.content: 「一人っ子として、いざそうやって知らない人と
lines.translated: "I was wondering -- as an only child, if you suddenly started living

lines.content: \n暮らし始めたら、どう思うんだろう？」
lines.translated: \nwith someone you barely knew like that, how would you feel?"

lines.content: さすがに同じ部屋に暮らしているとは言えなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't exactly tell her we were sharing the same room.

lines.content: 難しい質問だったのだろうか。黒姫さんが迷っている。
lines.translated: Was it too difficult a question? Kurohime-san seemed to be at a loss.

lines.content: 「一つ聞いていいでしょうか？」
「わたし、テレビをあまり見ないのですが、
「いや、俺自身に起こってる実話」
lines.translated: "No, this is something actually happening to me."

lines.content: 「……そ、そうですか……えっと、その従妹さんは、
lines.translated: "...O-oh, I see... um, so your cousin is
