lines.translated: Seeing Rei look so proud of herself puts me in a warm mood.

lines.content: 玲の言うとおり、玲に対して思う感情は、母さんや父さん、
lines.translated: Just as Rei said, the feelings I have for her are different from those I have for Mom, Dad,

lines.content: 今までの『家族』にはない感情だ。
lines.translated: It's a feeling that didn't exist in my "family" before.

lines.content: 家族ではなく『妹』――玲の考えは俺にとっても、
lines.translated: Not family, but "little sister" -- Rei's way of thinking was, for me too,

lines.content: 休みの日というのは、気楽なもの。
lines.translated: Days off are a relaxing thing.

lines.content: \nこのまま二度寝をしてしまおうか……。
lines.translated: \nMaybe I should just go back to sleep...

lines.content: ぼんやり思いつつ、隣を見れば玲がいない。
lines.translated: I was idly thinking that when I glanced to the side -- Rei wasn't there.

lines.content: そのまま、まどろんでいたが、なかなか戻ってこない。
lines.translated: I lay there in a drowsy haze, but she didn't come back for a while.

lines.content: 部屋から出ると、洗面所から物音がする。
lines.translated: I stepped out of the room and heard sounds coming from the bathroom.

lines.content: 洗面所……着替えてるとか、そういうことじゃないよな。
lines.translated: The bathroom... she's not just changing or anything like that, right?

lines.content: 警戒しつつ、声をかける。
淡々とした玲の言葉に、そっと洗面所に入る。
lines.translated: At Rei's calm reply, I quietly stepped into the bathroom.
"Good morning... wait, are you doing laundry?"

lines.content: 「はい、着替えはありますが、そろそろ洗濯をと、
lines.translated: "Yes, I still have clean clothes, but I thought it was about time

lines.content: 洗濯は３日に１度ぐらいのペースでやっていたけど、
lines.translated: I'd been doing laundry about once every three days, but

lines.content: \n玲もいるなら、もっとペースをあげていい。
lines.translated: \nnow that Rei's here too, I should probably do it more often.

lines.content: 「この家のものは、自由に使って良いという話でしたし」
lines.translated: "You did say I was free to use anything in the house."

lines.content: 「もちろん。気づかないでごめん」
lines.translated: "Of course. Sorry for not thinking of it myself."

lines.content: 「いえ、ついでに他の洗濯物も、
lines.translated: "No, it's fine. While I'm at it, would it be alright if I washed

lines.content: \n洗ってしまっていいですか？」

lines.translated: "I should be the one thanking you for that..."

lines.content: 玲がポンポン洗濯物を洗濯機の中に入れていく。
lines.translated: Rei tossed the laundry into the washing machine one piece at a time.

lines.content: 「洗濯用ネットはありますか？」
ネットを受け取ると、そのまま薄布を入れる。
lines.translated: She took the net and put a thin piece of fabric inside.

lines.content: 今の見覚えがある布はもしかして下着……？
lines.translated: That piece of fabric I just recognized -- was that underwear...?

lines.content: そうか……洗濯なんだから、下着を洗うに決まっている。
lines.translated: Right... it's laundry, so of course she'd be washing underwear.

lines.content: \nこれは玲にやってもらった方が――
lines.translated: \nMaybe I should let Rei handle this --

lines.content: 下着は俺のだってあるはず――
lines.translated: My underwear has to be in there too --

lines.content: \nネットに入れたほうがいいですか？」

lines.translated: "Uh, um, no... just leave it as is."

lines.content: 「わかりました。ふむ、男性はこういう形なんですね。
lines.translated: "Understood. Hmm, so this is what men's look like.

lines.content: \nボクサーパンツ、でしたっけ？」
なんだかすごく恥ずかしい！！
パンツを掴んだまま、玲が首をひねる。
lines.translated: Rei tilted her head, still holding my boxers.
"O-on second thought, I'll do it myself!"

lines.content: 「私が一人でやったほうが効率的です。
lines.translated: "It's more efficient if I handle it on my own.

lines.content: \n兄さんは朝食の支度をしてください」
「だったらずっと持ってないで、すぐ洗ってくれ……」
lines.translated: "Then stop holding onto them and just wash them already..."

lines.content: 何が問題なのかわかってないらしい。
lines.translated: She didn't seem to understand what the problem was.

lines.content: 「俺の下着を、玲がずっと持ってるのは、恥ずかしいんだ」
lines.translated: "It's embarrassing, okay? Having you hold onto my underwear like that."

lines.content: 「いや、玲は恥ずかしくないのか？」
「布ですよ。何を恥ずかしがれば……？
lines.translated: "It's just fabric. What is there to be embarrassed about...?

lines.content: \n服屋に行けば、普通に置いてあります」
lines.translated: \nThey sell these at any clothing store."

lines.content: 「そうだけど！　そうかもしれないけど！
\nそれでも、恥ずかしいものは恥ずかしいんだ！」
「……非合理的ですが、わかりました」
ようやく玲が下着を洗濯機に入れてくれた。
lines.translated: Rei finally put the underwear into the washing machine.

lines.content: 良かった……いや、何が良いのかまったくわからないけど。
lines.translated: Thank goodness... though I have no idea what exactly I'm relieved about.

lines.content: ここまで淡々としているのは、
lines.translated: The reason she's so matter-of-fact about all this --

lines.content: \nやはり『兄』と思ってくれたからなのか？
lines.translated: \nis it because she thinks of me as her "big brother"?

lines.content: 確かに俺の前で下着姿になったこともあったから、
lines.translated: She did change in front of me once, so
\nmaybe she just doesn't have any reservations to begin with...
\nYou okay? Want me to pat your head?"

lines.content: やってきた姉さんに心配そうな顔をされてしまう。
lines.translated: Chitose came in and gave me a worried look.

lines.content: ついでに、頭もナデナデされた。
lines.translated: And then she went ahead and patted my head anyway.

lines.content: 「おはよう……いや、なんでもないよ」
「そう？　平気ならいいけど、玲ちゃんは？」
lines.translated: "Yeah? As long as you're fine. What about Rei-chan?"
"Oh really. Hehe... what a good girl."

lines.content: 「……まぁ、姉さんも別に気にしないか」
lines.translated: "...Well, I guess you wouldn't mind either, Sis."

lines.content: 考えてみれば、この姉も洗濯に関しては、
lines.translated: Come to think of it, this 'big sister' of mine has always done my laundry

lines.content: \n特にためらいなく洗ってくれている。
もしかして、女性は『洗濯物』として分けて
lines.translated: Maybe women are able to separate things out

lines.content: それとも俺の周りがたまたまそうなのか……。
lines.translated: Or maybe the people around me just happen to be like that...

lines.content: 朝から悩みが尽きなかった。
lines.translated: My worries were endless, and it wasn't even noon yet.

lines.content: 朝食後のお茶の時間も、いつも以上にゆったりと
lines.translated: Even the tea time after breakfast feels more relaxed than usual,
\nand I can enjoy it at my own pace.

lines.content: 「玲ちゃんも一緒にどうかしら？」
lines.translated: "Would you like to join us, Rei-chan?"

lines.content: その言葉に、姉さんがお茶を淹れる準備をする。
lines.translated: With that, Chitose begins preparing to brew the tea.

lines.content: テーブルには俺と姉さんの湯呑みと、
lines.translated: On the table, my teacup and Chitose's teacup are set out,
"How do you like the new teacup?"

lines.content: さらりとした答えだったが、それだけで姉さんは満足気だ。
lines.translated: It was a simple answer, but that alone seemed to satisfy Chitose.

lines.content: 「休日のお茶請けは、こんなものにしてみました～♪」\@
lines.translated: "For our day-off tea snacks, I went with these~♪"\@

lines.content: 姉さんが取り出したのは、きんつばと生姜せんべい。
lines.translated: What Chitose pulled out were kintsuba and ginger crackers.

lines.content: 玲の目が光った……ように見えた。
lines.translated: Rei's eyes lit up... or so it seemed.

lines.content: 玲がさっそく生姜せんべいに手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: Rei immediately reaches for a ginger cracker.

lines.content: しなやかな動きだから、我慢できずに取ったというよりも、
lines.translated: Her movement was so graceful that it looked less like she couldn't hold back,

lines.content: \n言われて一枚とったように見えた。
lines.translated: \nand more like she simply took one when told to.

lines.content: 「今日の午前中、玲ちゃんは何か予定ある？」\@
lines.translated: "Do you have any plans this morning, Rei-chan?"\@

lines.content: 「特にありません。何か、あるんですか？」
lines.translated: "Nothing in particular. Is there something going on?"
"I was thinking of doing some cleaning."

lines.content: 頷くと、生姜せんべいを食べ始める。
lines.translated: She nods, then starts eating the ginger cracker.

lines.content: 「大掃除になるのは、２階かしら？」
lines.translated: "The big cleanup would be on the second floor, right?"

lines.content: 「うん、北側の部屋を空けようかと思ってる。
lines.translated: "Yeah, I was thinking of clearing out the room on the north side.

lines.content: \n通りに面してるから、開放感あるし」
lines.translated: \nIt faces the street, so it has a nice open feel."

lines.content: 玲と同じ部屋で過ごしていたが、やはり部屋は
lines.translated: We had been sharing a room, but it's probably better if we each

lines.content: \nそれぞれあった方が良いだろう。
同じ部屋で過ごす意味――玲と俺の距離感についても
lines.translated: The reason we shared a room -- we'd reached a conclusion about

lines.content: \n結論が出たし、良いタイミングだ。
lines.translated: \nthe distance between Rei and me, so the timing felt right.

lines.content: あそこって今、何が置いてあるの？」
「冬物とか、もらった食器とか、本とか……
lines.translated: "Winter clothes, some dishes we received as gifts, books...

lines.content: \n昨日見たけど数はそんなにない」
lines.translated: \nI checked yesterday and there isn't that much."

lines.content: 「それじゃ、その荷物は奥の部屋に引っ越そうか」
lines.translated: "Then let's move all that stuff to the back room."

lines.content: 「玲はハウスダストにアレルギーがあるらしいから、
\n風呂掃除をしてもらおうかなと思ってる」
lines.translated: \nso I was thinking of having her clean the bathroom instead."

lines.content: 「それじゃ、荷物は君に運んでもらうとして……
lines.translated: "Alright, I'll have you carry the boxes then...

lines.content: \n部屋の掃除はお姉ちゃんにおまかせね」
lines.translated: \nand leave the room cleaning to big sis."

lines.content: \n俺は、廊下や階段の掃除をすることにするよ」
lines.translated: \nI'll take care of the hallway and staircase."
"You're always such a big help, Sis."

lines.content: 「いいのいいの。掃除好きだし♪」
lines.translated: "Oh, don't mention it. I love cleaning anyway♪"

lines.content: 「よしっ、それじゃ、お茶を飲んだらお掃除開始ね！」
lines.translated: "Alright then, once we finish our tea, let's get started!"

lines.content: 「私も生姜せんべい食べよー……\@
lines.translated: "I'm going to have a ginger cracker too...\@

lines.content: 山盛りにあった生姜せんべいが、無くなっている。
lines.translated: The pile of ginger crackers that had been heaped up is gone.

lines.content: まさか話している間に……？
lines.translated: Don't tell me... while we were talking...?

lines.content: 無表情で目をそらされる。
ただし、口元からパリッと、
lines.translated: Except -- from the corner of her mouth comes a crisp,

lines.content: マスクをしていても咳き込むほどのホコリの量だ。
lines.translated: There's enough dust in here to make you cough even through a mask.

lines.content: 「はー……外の空気が入ると、ちょっとはマシね。
lines.translated: "Ahh... getting some fresh air in helps a little.\n How long has it been since we last cleaned?

lines.content: \n掃除を最後にしたのはいつだっけ？」
「えっと……俺が学園に入るぐらい？」
lines.translated: "Umm... around when I started at the academy?"
"Geez. You can't be so lazy about these things~"

lines.content: 「ふふっ、掃除しがいもあるけどね」
lines.translated: "Hehe, at least it makes cleaning feel worthwhile."

lines.content: \n俺も、廊下や階段の掃除に向かう。
lines.translated: \nI head off to clean the hallway and staircase.

lines.content: 廊下から、姉さんの動きが見える。
lines.translated: I can see sis moving around from the hallway.

lines.content: まずはハタキで壁や天井、
lines.translated: First she uses a duster on the walls and ceiling,

lines.content: \n上の出っ張った場所のホコリを落とす。
lines.translated: \nknocking the dust off the raised spots up above.

lines.content: それが終われば、床の掃除。箒で掃いた後は、
lines.translated: Once that's done, she moves on to the floor. After sweeping with a broom,

lines.content: \nお茶の出がらしを使ってさらに掃く。
lines.translated: \nshe sweeps again using spent tea leaves.

lines.content: 見事な動きとともに、みるみる部屋が綺麗になっていく。
lines.translated: With impressive, fluid movements, the room becomes spotless before my eyes.

lines.content: \n家庭科部だからというわけでもないだろうが、楽しそうだ。
lines.translated: \nMaybe it's because she's in the home ec club, or maybe not -- either way, she looks like she's having fun.

lines.content: 俺も負けてられないな。
黙々と２時間ほど掃除に没頭。
lines.translated: We spent about two hours absorbed in cleaning without a word.

lines.content: すっかりピカピカになった２階から姉さんが降りてくる。
lines.translated: Sis comes downstairs from the second floor, now completely sparkling clean.

lines.content: 「こっちも終わり。お疲れさま」
lines.translated: "Done on my end too. Good work."

lines.content: 麦茶を冷やしておいたので、姉さんにも渡す。
lines.translated: I had barley tea chilling, so I hand some to sis as well.

lines.content: ひと口飲んで、姉さんがひと息つく。
lines.translated: Sis takes a sip and lets out a long breath.

lines.content: \nちょうど風が吹き、汗の滲んだ肌を涼しく撫で上げる。
lines.translated: \nJust then a breeze blows through, cooling the sweat-dampened skin.

lines.content: 「ふふ、あの部屋。掃除してたら、
lines.translated: "Hehe, that room. While I was cleaning it,

lines.content: \nすっごく懐かしい気持ちになっちゃった」
「ああ、昔は俺の部屋だったから？」
lines.translated: "Oh, because it used to be my room?"

lines.content: 「あそこでお絵かきしたり、本を読んだり、
lines.translated: "We used to draw pictures in there, read books,
"Oh, and remember how we'd stick our heads out the window

lines.content: \n夜にこっそり話したこともあったよね」

lines.translated: "Now that you mention it, yeah we did..."

lines.content: 軽く近くの壁を叩いてみせる。
lines.translated: I give the nearby wall a light knock.

lines.content: 「この音がしたら、窓越しに話そうって合図だったよな」
lines.translated: "That knock was our signal to talk through the window, right?"

lines.content: 「うふふ……覚えてたんだ。本当に懐かしいなぁ」
姉さんの部屋も２階だから、そんなこともできた。
lines.translated: Sis's room was on the second floor too, so we could do things like that.

lines.content: 「広かったのにね。今見たら狭く感じちゃった」
lines.translated: "It was so spacious back then. Looking at it now, it felt so small."
"It's been years, so that's just how it goes."

lines.content: 「思い出すなぁ……夏休みの時は、
lines.translated: "I remember it so well... during summer break,

lines.content: \n毎日あの部屋で遊んで、お昼寝して……」
lines.translated: \nwe'd play in that room every day, take naps..."

lines.content: 「起きたら、プールから上がった後みたいに
lines.translated: "And when we woke up, it was like getting out of the pool --

lines.content: \nぽかぽかして、良かったよね」
lines.translated: \nall warm and cozy. That was nice, wasn't it?"

lines.content: 姉さんが近寄ってくると手を広げ――
lines.translated: Sis comes closer and spreads her arms --

lines.content: 「――え？　ちょっと姉さん。なんで抱きつくんだ？」
lines.translated: "-- Huh? Wait, sis. Why are you hugging me?"

lines.content: 「はーい！　ただいま、おうかがいいたします♪」
lines.translated: "Coming right away~! Welcome, how can I help you♪"

lines.content: 午後から姉さんは緋衣亭のお手伝い。
lines.translated: From the afternoon, sis was helping out at Higoromotei.

lines.content: \n俺も手が空いていたので、カウンターに入っている。
lines.translated: \nSince I had some free time too, I was working behind the counter.

lines.content: ――入ってきたのは、黒姫さんだった。
lines.translated: -- The one who walked in was Kurohime-san.

lines.content: 「いらっしゃいませー♪　あら、結灯ちゃん！
「では、カウンターにごあんなーい♪」
「美味しいコーヒーを飲みに来た……じゃ、不満でしょうか？」
lines.translated: "I came for a good cup of coffee... is that not a good enough reason?"

lines.content: 「まさか。ご来店ありがとうございます」
lines.translated: "Not at all. Thank you for coming in."

lines.content: 小さく微笑むと早速メニューを確認する。
lines.translated: She gave a small smile and immediately started looking over the menu.

lines.content: 「う～ん……あっ、ケーキセットいいですね。
lines.translated: "Hmm... oh, the cake set looks nice.

lines.content: \n……チョコケーキでお願いします」
「もちろん、コーヒーでお願いします。
\nそれを飲みに来たんですから」
lines.translated: \nThat's what I came here for, after all."

lines.content: 「かしこまりました。しばらくお待ち下さい」
黒姫さんの笑みに俺も笑い返して、
lines.translated: I smiled back at Kurohime-san's smile,

lines.content: \nさっそく注文の準備を始める。
lines.translated: \nand got started on preparing her order right away.

lines.content: 注文をした黒姫さんが、外を見たかと思えば、
lines.translated: Kurohime-san, who had just placed her order, glanced outside,

lines.content: 「どうかした？　椅子がおかしい？」
「いえ……店の前で立ってる女性がいたんです。
lines.translated: "No... there's a woman standing in front of the shop.

lines.content: \nどうしてかなと、疑問になりまして……」
lines.translated: \nI was just wondering why, that's all..."

lines.content: 外を見れば、確かに人影がある。
lines.translated: Looking outside, there was indeed a figure there.

lines.content: 外へ出れば、玲がすぐに気づいてこちらを向く。
lines.translated: When I stepped outside, Rei noticed me right away and turned to face me.

lines.content: 「いえ、喫茶店にです。入ったことがないので」
lines.translated: "No, about the cafe. I've never been inside one before."

lines.content: そういえば玲はまだ、緋衣亭に来たことがなかった。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, Rei had never been to Higoromotei before.

lines.content: 学園１年生ぐらいだと、こういった場所は
lines.translated: Plenty of first-years at the academy

lines.content: \n馴染みがない人も多いかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nprobably aren't used to places like this.

lines.content: 「興味あるなら、どうぞ。お茶ぐらいおごるよ」
lines.translated: "If you're curious, come on in. I'll treat you to some tea."

lines.content: 「それはいけません。お客である以上払います。
lines.translated: "That won't do. As a customer, I'll pay.

lines.content: \nそうしないと癖になりますよ、私」
lines.translated: \nOtherwise it'll become a habit for me."

lines.content: 素直に言う妹に苦笑してしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but chuckle at my little sister's blunt honesty.

lines.content: 「自分で断言する辺り大丈夫そうだけど。
lines.translated: "The fact that you can say that yourself is reassuring, I guess.

lines.content: \nわかったよ。いらっしゃいませ、お嬢さま」
芝居がかった口調で言ってみれば、
lines.translated: I tried saying it in a theatrical tone,
\nand Rei gave me a short reply in kind.

lines.content: 「あ……やっぱりお客さまだったんですか？」
lines.translated: "Oh... so she was a customer after all?"

lines.content: 「ああ、喫茶店に興味があるらしいから。
lines.translated: "Yeah, apparently she was curious about the cafe.

lines.content: \n黒姫さん、この子は俺の従妹の氷見山玲」
lines.translated: \nKurohime-san, this is my cousin, Himiyama Rei."

lines.content: 「いとこ……えっ、それじゃ、ドラマのかた？」\@
lines.translated: "Cousin... wait, so she's from a drama?"\@

lines.content: 黒姫さんの驚きに、玲が淡々とツッコミを入れる。
lines.translated: Rei calmly retorts to Kurohime-san's surprised reaction.

lines.content: 疑ってたというより半信半疑だったんだろう。
lines.translated: It wasn't so much that she doubted me -- she was probably just on the fence about it.

lines.content: 俺だって、今の状況を客観的に聞いたら、
lines.translated: Even I, if I heard the situation described objectively,

lines.content: \nドラマの話だと思ってしまう。
lines.translated: \nwould probably think it sounded like something out of a drama.

lines.content: 「玲。この人は俺のクラスメートの黒姫結灯さん。
lines.translated: "Rei. This is Kurohime Yuuhi-san, my classmate.

lines.content: 「はじめまして黒姫結灯です」\@
lines.translated: "Nice to meet you, I'm Kurohime Yuuhi."\@

lines.content: 黒姫さんの挨拶に、玲もペコリと頭を下げる。
lines.translated: In response to Kurohime-san's greeting, Rei gives a small bow.

lines.content: 挨拶も終わったので、黒姫さんの隣に座ってもらう。
lines.translated: With introductions out of the way, I have her sit down next to Kurohime-san.

lines.content: 「さて、お客さま。何にいたしましょう」
lines.translated: "Now then, what can I get for you, miss?"

lines.content: 「お客さま、当店は初めてですよ」
lines.translated: "I'm afraid this is your first time at our establishment, miss."

lines.content: 「なるほど、ドラマのようにはいかない……
lines.translated: "I see, so it doesn't work like it does in dramas...

lines.content: 一人納得したように頷いている。
lines.translated: She nods to herself as if she's figured something out.

lines.content: \n使いづらさが問題ではないと思うけど。
lines.translated: \nI don't think inconvenience is really the issue here.

lines.content: 「ブレンドコーヒーをお願いします」
「ケーキのセットなどもお得になっておりますが」
lines.translated: "We also have a cake set available at a great value."

lines.content: では、生姜せんべいをください」
lines.translated: In that case, I'll have the ginger senbei."

lines.content: メニューの端に書いてあった文字を
lines.translated: She'd spotted the text written in the corner of the menu

lines.content: \n目ざとく見つけて頼んでくる。

一緒に添えたミルクと、カウンターに置いてある

今度は調整がうまくいったようで、

lines.content: 玲は素っ気ないが、嫌なときは嫌という子だ。
lines.translated: Rei can be indifferent, but she's the type to speak up when she doesn't want something.

lines.content: 今日は姉さんと玲と、のんびりお茶を楽しんだ後、
lines.translated: Today, after enjoying a relaxed cup of tea with sis and Rei,
\nthe three of us head to school together.

lines.content: シロシロ――文化祭を来月に控えているものの、

\nthis is a tough obstacle standing in the way.

lines.content: \n色々あっても変わらず時は進むのだ。
lines.translated: \nEven with everything going on, time keeps moving forward without a care.

lines.content: 「玲はテスト勉強どうなんだ？」
以前、俺が一緒に登校した時と同じように、
lines.translated: Just like the last time I walked to school with her,

lines.content: \n落ち葉を拾って眺めていた玲が振り返る。
lines.translated: \nRei turns around, having been picking up fallen leaves to look at them.

lines.content: 「テスト勉強、はかどってるのかなーと思って」
lines.translated: "I was wondering if your studying was coming along well."

lines.content: 「学園でやっています。その方が効率的ですし」
lines.translated: "I study at school. It's more efficient that way."

lines.content: 「わかる！　学校だと周りの誘惑が少ないし、
lines.translated: "I get that! There are fewer distractions at school,

lines.content: \n友だちと勉強できるから、身が入るよねー」
lines.translated: \nand you can study with friends, so it's easier to focus."

lines.content: 「誰かと勉強はわかりませんが……周りに誘惑はありませんね」
lines.translated: "I wouldn't know about studying with others, but... there are no distractions around me."

lines.content: 「そっか……学園と家で勉強三昧はすごいな」
lines.translated: "I see... studying hard both at school and at home is impressive."

lines.content: かなり勤勉なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: She might be quite the diligent student.

lines.content: 学園で勉強したところで、下校時間もあるし、
lines.translated: Even if she studies at school, there's still a time to go home,

lines.content: \nそんなに長時間勉強できそうにないけど。
lines.translated: \nso it doesn't seem like she could study for that long.

lines.content: 「何故ダメなのですか？　テストは今まで学んだ内容と、

lines.content: \nその応用からしか出ません」
「授業と復習をしっかりすれば、困ることはありません」
lines.translated: "As long as you keep up with lessons and review properly, there's nothing to worry about."

lines.content: 「そうよ。継続は力なりって言うし」
姉さんも毎日コツコツやるタイプなので同意しかないのだろう。
lines.translated: Sis is the type to chip away at things every day, so of course she'd agree.
(Ugh... I'm the odd one out here.)

lines.content: 玲は姉さん側のタイプか……いや、喜ばしいことだけど。
lines.translated: So Rei is the same type as sis, huh... well, that's a good thing, I suppose.

lines.content: （黒姫さんはどうなんだろうな……）
前にスラスラと問題を解いたところから察するに、
lines.translated: Judging from how she breezed through problems before,
\nI have a feeling she's pretty capable.

lines.content: （仲間だからありがたいかと問われれば、

lines.translated: \nto have her in the same boat as me...)

lines.content: 教室に入れば、黒姫さんはまだ来てない。
lines.translated: When I walk into the classroom, Kurohime-san isn't here yet.

lines.content: \n俺より早く来てることが多かったのだけど。
「おはよう。黒姫さん、まだ来てないんだ」
「そういや、この時間に来てないのは珍しいな」
lines.translated: "Now that you mention it, it's unusual for her not to be here by now."

lines.content: 珍しいと言っても黒姫さんが引っ越してきて、
lines.translated: Unusual as it may be, it hasn't been that many days

lines.content: \nそこまで日数は経ってない。
今日はたまたま遅いのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe she's just running late today.

lines.content: ――でも、朝のＨＲになっても黒姫さんは来なかった。
lines.translated: -- But Kurohime-san still hadn't shown up by morning homeroom.

lines.translated: It seemed like none of our classmates knew either.

lines.content: 「どうしたんだろうねー、黒姫さん」
「休み前は元気だったと思うけど……」
lines.translated: "She seemed fine before the break, though..."

lines.content: ひそひそとクラスメートたちも話している。
lines.translated: The classmates are whispering among themselves.

lines.content: 昨日会った時も、別に体調が悪そうには見えなかった。
lines.translated: When I saw her yesterday, she didn't seem to be feeling unwell at all.

lines.content: 黒姫さんが『転校』するはずだった日――
lines.translated: The day Kurohime-san was supposed to "transfer" --
\nshe didn't show up that day either.

lines.translated: \nbut to me, she asked, "Why do you think that is?"

lines.content: （だとしたら――前回と一緒の理由で休んでいる……？）
lines.translated: (If that's the case -- is she absent for the same reason as last time...?)

lines.translated: \nand now you're telling me to use my head instead..."

lines.translated: I'm not exactly great at studying myself,

lines.content: \n好きでもないから、気持ちはわかる。
lines.translated: \nand I don't enjoy it either, so I get how he feels.

lines.translated: "Come on, I'm here helping you out, so get your hand moving.

lines.content: \nあと少しやったら今日は終わりにしてやっぞー」
lines.translated: \nJust a little more and we'll call it a day."

lines.content: 意外と言えば失礼だが、ホーセンは勉強ができる。
lines.translated: It might be rude to say "surprisingly," but Hosen is actually good at studying.

lines.content: \nテスト前は教えてもらうことが多い。
lines.translated: \nBefore tests, I end up having him tutor me a lot.

lines.content: 「テスト前の一夜漬けの方が邪悪だと思うがねぇ。オレは」
lines.translated: "I'd say pulling an all-nighter right before a test is way more evil, personally."

lines.content: 「しっかし黒姫さん、結局お休みだったね」
lines.translated: "Still, Kurohime-san ended up being absent all day, huh."

lines.content: 「そうねぇ……何かあったのかなぁ？」
「手続きで電話できない状態って前は言ってたけど……
lines.translated: "She said before that she was in a situation where she couldn't call because of some paperwork...

lines.content: 「あー、こんなことなら連絡先、
lines.translated: "Ugh, if I'd known it'd come to this,

lines.content: \n今持ってない』って聞きそびれたよー」
lines.translated: \nso she doesn't have it on her right now,' and I never got the chance to ask again."

lines.content: 「このご時世に、スマホを持ち歩かないなんて、
lines.translated: "In this day and age, not carrying your smartphone around --

lines.content: 近くで勉強していた女子たちが、そんな話をしている。
lines.translated: The girls who had been studying nearby were having that kind of conversation.

lines.content: \n皆が心配するぐらい馴染んだということだろう。
lines.translated: \nI suppose it means she'd fit in well enough that everyone was worried about her.

lines.content: （でも、誰も連絡先……知らないんだな）
前に感じた『壁』のようなものを、俺だけでなく、
lines.translated: That "wall" I sensed before -- it's not just with me,
\nshe's put it up with the other girls too...?
There's no reason for her to do that.

lines.content: 『皆の役に立ちたい』と黒姫さんは言っていた。
lines.translated: Kurohime-san said she "wants to be useful to everyone."

lines.content: \nつまり仲良くなりたいということだ。
lines.translated: \nMeaning she wants to get along with people.

lines.content: なぜ、連絡先を教えてないのか……。
lines.translated: So why hasn't she given anyone her contact info...

lines.content: \nたまたまなのか、何か理由があるのか。
lines.translated: \nIs it just a coincidence, or is there some reason behind it?

lines.content: （黒姫さんが秘密にする……理由……）
「おーい、ペンを動かさないと、いつまで経っても
lines.translated: "Hey, if you don't get your pen moving, we're never

lines.content: 黒姫さんへの思考は脇に寄せ、ノートと向かい合った。
lines.translated: I pushed my thoughts about Kurohime-san aside and turned back to my notebook.

lines.content: 「よし、今日はこのくらいにしておくか」
lines.translated: "Alright, I think that's enough for today."

lines.content: 「ありがとーございましたー。さ、帰ろう帰ろう」
lines.translated: "Thank youuu. Okay, let's head home, let's head home."

lines.content: 一瞬たりとも見たくないのか、そそくさと
lines.translated: Like he couldn't stand the sight of them for even a second, Futchi

lines.translated: \nquickly stuffed his textbooks and notebooks into his bag.

lines.content: 「身体を動かす部活よりも、頭使う方が腹減る気がするよ」
lines.translated: "Somehow, using my head makes me hungrier than club practice does."

lines.content: 「普段使わねぇ部分を使ったら、そんなもんかもなー」
lines.translated: "Makes sense -- if you're working parts you don't normally use, that's just how it goes."

lines.content: 「使ってないところを動かすと筋肉痛になるからね」
lines.translated: "When you work muscles you haven't used in a while, you get sore, after all."

lines.content: 廊下へ出ると、校舎全体が茜色に染まっていた。
lines.translated: When we stepped out into the hallway, the whole school building was bathed in a deep amber glow.

lines.content: \nまだ、他のクラスには学生が残っているのか、声が聞こえる。
lines.translated: \nOther classes still had students in them -- I could hear their voices.

lines.content: ――もし、これが無人になったら？
lines.translated: -- But what if this place were completely empty?

lines.content: 「なんか食ってから帰るか。どうする？」
lines.translated: "Want to grab something to eat before heading home? What do you think?"

lines.content: 「いや、俺は図書館へ寄ってから帰るよ」
lines.translated: "Nah, I'm going to stop by the library first."

lines.content: 一つ、可能性が浮かんだ。
lines.translated: One possibility had surfaced in my mind.

lines.content: 「うわー……まだ勉強するのかい？　熱心なものだねぇ」
lines.translated: "Whoa... you're still going to study? You're really dedicated, huh."

lines.content: 「あんまり根を詰めても、能率は良くねぇんだけど……
lines.translated: "Pushing yourself too hard isn't great for efficiency, but...

lines.content: \nま、やる気のある時にやったほうがいいかもな」
lines.translated: \nwell, it's probably better to do it while you're motivated."

lines.content: 「そうしてくれ、そんじゃなー」
――確信、というほどではなかった。
ただ『あるいは』『もしかしたら』という思いが、
lines.translated: It was more of a "maybe" or "what if" feeling that had,

lines.content: \nそのまま、行動になっている。
図書館へ向かい、小一時間ほど勉強してから、
lines.translated: I headed to the library, studied for about an hour,
\nthen made my way back to the classroom.

lines.content: 少し前の喧騒が嘘のように学内は静かだ。
lines.translated: The school was silent, as if the noise from just a little while ago had been a lie.
The situation was the same as that day.

lines.content: 黒姫さんは俺に、休んだ理由を『どうしてなんでしょう』と
lines.translated: Kurohime-san had asked me, as if genuinely puzzled, "Why do you think that is?"

lines.content: 教師に言った理由ではなく、その言葉通り、
lines.translated: If the reason wasn't what she'd told the teacher, but something else entirely --

lines.content: 誰もいなくなったはずの教室へ入る。
lines.translated: I stepped into the classroom that should have been empty.

lines.content: 自分の席の隣――黒姫さんの席を見る。
lines.translated: I looked at the seat next to mine -- Kurohime-san's seat.

lines.content: あの日と同じように、机につっぷしている人物。
lines.translated: Someone slumped over a desk, just like that day.

lines.content: \n特徴的な長いポニーテールが、揺れている。
lines.translated: \nThat distinctive long ponytail was swaying gently.

lines.content: 予想通りであっても、本当にいるとなると、
lines.translated: Even though I'd expected it, actually finding her here --

lines.content: 緊張でこわばった筋肉を深呼吸で無理やり弛緩させ、
lines.translated: I forced my tension-stiffened muscles to relax with a deep breath

lines.content: 黒姫さんの顔を覗き込めば、やはり寝ていた。
lines.translated: Peering at Kurohime-san's face, she was indeed asleep.

lines.content: \n整った顔から規則正しい寝息が漏れている。
lines.translated: \nSteady, quiet breathing escaped from her composed features.

lines.content: 一体、何の理由でこうしているんだ？
lines.translated: Just what reason could she possibly have for doing this?

lines.content: 気配を察したのだろうか。
\n黒姫さんが身じろぎすると、うっすら瞳を開ける。
lines.translated: \nKurohime-san stirred and slowly opened her eyes.

lines.content: 寝ぼけ眼が、俺を映し出す。
俺を見て驚いたのか、何度かまばたきをする。
lines.translated: She seemed startled to see me, blinking several times.

lines.content: でも、すぐにいつもの微笑みを見せると、身体を起こす。
lines.translated: But she quickly showed me her usual smile and sat up.

lines.content: 「わたしがいるの、わかったんですか？」
「予想はしたけど、まさか本当にいるとは思わなかった」
lines.translated: "I had a feeling, but I didn't actually think you'd be here."

lines.content: 「ですか……わたしは予想しやすいんでしょうか？」
lines.translated: "Really... am I that easy to predict?"

lines.content: 「まさか。まったくわからない……『どうしてなんだ？』」
lines.translated: "Not at all. I have no idea... 'Why do you think that is?'"

lines.content: イタズラっぽい問いかけなのも変わらない。
lines.translated: The playful way she asked it hadn't changed either.

lines.content: \n箒がかなりヘタれてきています」
lines.translated: \nthe broom is getting pretty worn out."

lines.content: 「あ、それじゃ買い換えないと」
「箒の売ってる場所、わかるか？」
lines.translated: "Do you know where they sell brooms?"

lines.content: 「ええ、商店街を歩き回っていましたから」
lines.translated: "Yes, I walked around the shopping district quite a bit, so I know."

lines.content: 「なるほど、あの散策もしっかり役に立ってたわけだ」
lines.translated: "Ah, so all that wandering around actually came in handy."

lines.content: 「無論です。合理的だからしてました」\@
lines.translated: "Of course. I only did it because it was practical."\@

lines.content: 「はは、なるほど。それもそうだ」\@
lines.translated: "Haha, fair enough. You've got a point."\@

lines.content: 少し後ろを歩いていた姉さんが、玲の言葉に首を振る。
lines.translated: Sis, who had been walking a little behind us, shook her head at Rei's words.

lines.content: 「何も……二人とも、仲良くなったなぁって
lines.translated: "Nothing, just... you two have really gotten close,

lines.content: 「というか、姉さんだって玲とはすごく仲いいと
lines.translated: "I mean, I think you and Rei\nget along really well

lines.content: 「まぁ、姉さまだと思っていますからね」
lines.translated: "Well, she's my Nee-sama, as far as I'm concerned."

lines.content: 姉さんが思い切り玲を抱きしめ、また玲が
lines.translated: Sis hugged Rei with all her might, and since Rei was

lines.content: \n呼吸困難に陥るので、慌てて引き剥がす。
lines.translated: \nabout to suffocate again, I hurried to pry them apart.

lines.content: 「はぁ……玲ちゃん、可愛いなぁ……玲ちゃんみたいな、
lines.translated: "Haah... Rei-chan is so adorable... with a little sister

lines.content: \n魅力のある妹だったら……ほっとかないよね」\@
lines.translated: \nas charming as Rei-chan... you couldn't just leave her be, right?"\@

lines.content: 確かに玲は魅力的だと思うけど、それは別に
lines.translated: I do think Rei is charming, but it doesn't quite feel like
\nthe charm of a "little sister" to me...
"I knew it... so that's how it is."

lines.content: そんなことを考えている俺をよそに、
lines.translated: While I was lost in those thoughts,

lines.content: \n姉さんは神妙な面持ちで頷いていた。
lines.translated: \nSis was nodding with a strangely serious look on her face.

lines.content: 昼休みに、中庭にいる姉さんを見つける。
lines.translated: During lunch break, I spotted Sis out in the courtyard.

lines.content: 俺を見た姉さんは、小さく咳払いして――
lines.translated: Sis saw me and gave a small cough, then--

lines.content: 「私は、ここでお茶をしてたところです。
lines.translated: "I was just having some tea here.

lines.content: な、なんだ……姉さんの声が硬いし、
lines.translated: W-what's going on... Sis sounds so stiff,

lines.content: \nやけに丁寧……いや、そもそも兄さん？
lines.translated: \nand weirdly formal... wait, did she just call me "Nii-san"?

lines.content: 涼しげな顔をしていた姉さんが、真っ赤になって固まる。
lines.translated: Sis, who had been keeping such a cool expression, turned bright red and froze.

lines.content: 「たったひと言で、こんなにも衝撃が……\@
lines.translated: "Just one word, and it hits me this hard...\@

lines.content: 「いや、兄さんって……もしかして玲のマネ？」
lines.translated: "Hold on, 'Nii-san'... are you copying Rei or something?"

lines.content: 「違います。妹になったんです」

lines.translated: She says it like it's a fact.

lines.content: 「だって、妹の方が話しやすそうだったし……」
lines.translated: "Because you seemed to find a little sister easier to talk to..."

lines.content: 「えっ、そんなことはないってっ！」
「でも、玲ちゃんと仲良く話してた……」
lines.translated: "But you were talking so easily with Rei-chan..."

lines.content: 「そうかもしれないけど、姉さんとだって、
lines.translated: "Maybe, but I talk just as easily with you,

lines.content: 「もちろん、俺を一番わかってるのは姉さんだ！」
lines.translated: "Of course -- you're the one who understands me best, Sis!"

lines.content: 「姉さんだって、俺のこと一番わかってくれてるだろ？」
lines.translated: "You understand me better than anyone, don't you, Sis?"

lines.content: 姉さんが、目を見開いて俺を見つめ――
lines.translated: Sis's eyes went wide as she stared at me--

lines.content: 俺、今……かなり大胆なことを言ったような？
lines.translated: Did I just... say something pretty bold?

lines.content: でも、俺の本心だ。否定する必要もない。
lines.translated: But it's how I honestly feel. No reason to take it back.

lines.content: 「だから、姉さんは姉さんのままでいてくれ」
lines.translated: "So please, just stay as my Sis."

lines.content: 「ごめん、そうだね……玲ちゃんの真似をしても、
「妹になったって、仕方ないんだから……」
lines.translated: "There's no point in becoming a little sister anyway..."

lines.content: 妹になったって仕方ないのは当たり前だ。
lines.translated: Of course there's no point in becoming a little sister.

lines.content: \nでも、もっと違う意味があると思う。
lines.translated: \nBut I think there's more to it than that.

lines.content: （あるいは、俺がそう信じたいだけなのか……）
lines.translated: (Or maybe I just want to believe that...)

lines.content: 「今日の夕飯……何にしようかしら……」
lines.translated: "What should I make for dinner tonight...?"

lines.content: 昼休み、中庭でお茶を飲みながら考える。
lines.translated: During lunch break, I think it over while drinking tea in the courtyard.

lines.content: 「俺こそ。いつも夕飯作ってくれてありがとう」
lines.translated: "I should be thanking you. You always make dinner for us."

lines.content: 夕食後、皿洗いを終えて居間に戻り、姉さんへお礼を言う。
lines.translated: After dinner, I finished washing the dishes, returned to the living room, and thanked Sis.
"Yeah... oh, in that case... how about a reward?

lines.content: 姉さんがそんな提案をするなんて珍しい。
lines.translated: It was unusual for Sis to suggest something like that.

lines.content: 「いいよ。俺のできる範囲になっちゃうけど」
lines.translated: "Sure. It'll have to be something within my abilities, though."

lines.content: 「うん……大丈夫、難しいことじゃないから」
そう言った姉さんが膝をポンと叩いてみせる。
lines.translated: With that, Sis gave her lap a little pat.
"I want you to let me give you a lap pillow...♪"

lines.content: やっぱり柔らかくて……以前よりもドキドキするのは、
lines.translated: It's just as soft as ever... but I'm more nervous than before.

lines.content: \nただの『姉さん』じゃなくなったからだろうか？
lines.translated: \nIs it because she's no longer just "Sis" to me?

lines.content: 「どっちかっていうと、俺がご褒美をもらってる
lines.translated: "If anything, it feels like I'm the one\n getting the reward here...

lines.content: 「ふふ……それならますます、膝枕……いいね」
lines.translated: "Hehe... in that case, the lap pillow is even better, isn't it."

lines.content: そう言いながら、頭を撫でてくる。
lines.translated: As she says that, she strokes my head.

lines.content: やっぱりこういう時の姉さんは、俺を弟扱い
lines.translated: At times like this, I wonder if Sis still sees me

lines.content: 「やったっ♪　それじゃ、さっそくするね」
lines.translated: "Yay♪ Okay, I'll get started right away."

lines.content: 嬉しそうに姉さんが、耳かき棒を手にする。
lines.translated: Sis happily picks up the ear pick.

lines.content: 耳かき棒が優しく耳に入ってくる。
lines.translated: The ear pick gently enters my ear.

lines.content: 「ん……こしこし……痛かったら、言ってね……♪」
lines.translated: "Mm... scritch scritch... tell me if it hurts, okay...♪"

lines.content: 姉さんが、また頭をそっと撫でる。
lines.translated: Sis gently strokes my head again.

lines.content: 「……姉さんは、変わらないんだな」
「膝枕してドキドキしてるとか、なさそうだし」
lines.translated: "Like, you don't seem nervous at all giving me a lap pillow."
"...I am nervous. My heart is pounding."

lines.content: 「それを確かめたくて、膝枕をしたのかも……」
lines.translated: "Maybe that's why I offered you my lap -- to find out for sure..."

lines.content: 「うん、やっぱり……すごく照れるよね……
lines.translated: "Yeah, and sure enough... this is really embarrassing...
"...But, it makes sense to be embarrassed."

lines.content: 「ほら、動かないで……取れるから」
lines.translated: "Now hold still... I'll get it out."

lines.content: 姉さんが囁きながら、耳かき棒を動かす。
lines.translated: Sis whispers as she moves the ear pick.

lines.content: コシコシと耳の中が擦られていく。
lines.translated: The inside of my ear is gently scraped.

lines.content: \nこそばゆいような、照れくさいような感触。
「……私、自分のこういう気持ちに気付けて、
lines.translated: "...I'm glad I was able to notice these feelings of mine,

lines.content: 俺に言うというより、何かを確認するような言葉。
lines.translated: It sounds less like she's talking to me and more like she's confirming something to herself.

lines.content: 朝の掃除の時間、姉さんとばったり顔を合わせる。
lines.translated: During the morning cleaning, I run into sis by chance.

lines.content: いや、姉さんだって普段から表の掃除をしているのだから
lines.translated: Well, she always sweeps out front anyway,

lines.content: 「俺、向こうから掃いてくるよ」
そう、いつものように掃除を始めたけれど――
lines.translated: And so we started cleaning, same as always -- but...

lines.content: 視線を感じて姉さんを見れば。
lines.translated: I feel her gaze and look over at sis.

lines.content: お互い、曖昧な笑いを浮かべるしかない。
lines.translated: All we can do is share an awkward laugh.

lines.content: 姉さんに俺の想いを伝えたい――でも。
lines.translated: I want to tell sis how I feel -- but...

lines.content: （姉さんにとって、俺はやっぱり『弟』なんだろうか）
lines.translated: (Am I still just her "little brother" to her?)

lines.content: そばにいて欲しい――そう言ってくれたけれど。
lines.translated: She said she wants me close -- but...

lines.content: それはやっぱり姉弟として？
lines.translated: Does she mean that as siblings?

lines.content: 「ちょっと話が、あるんだけど」
lines.translated: "There's something I... want to talk to you about."

lines.content: \nその顔から、姉さんの困惑や躊躇いが見えてしまう。
lines.translated: \nI can see the confusion and hesitation on her face.

lines.content: 長年の付き合いだ。俺が『踏み出す』行為をすることに
lines.translated: We've known each other for years. Maybe she realized
\nthat I was about to take a step forward.

lines.content: 微笑んでくれる『姉さん』。
その笑顔を曇らせてしまうかもしれない――そう考えると、
lines.translated: Thinking that I might cloud that smile of hers --

lines.content: \n今はまだ、踏み出す勇気が足りなかった。
lines.translated: \nI just didn't have the courage to take that step yet.

lines.content: 廊下で姉さんを見かけて声をかけると、
lines.translated: I spotted Sis in the hallway and called out to her,

lines.content: \n姉さんの身体が強張るのがわかった。
lines.translated: \nand I could tell her body tensed up.

lines.content: まだ、踏み出すのは難しそうだった。
lines.translated: Taking that step forward still looked like it was going to be hard.

lines.content: 家に帰ってくると、姉さんが緋衣亭の前で荷物運び中。
lines.translated: When I got home, sis was in the middle of hauling luggage in front of Higoromotei.

lines.content: 「ただいま。今日はずいぶん多いね」
lines.translated: "I'm home. That's quite a lot today."

lines.content: 「ええ、頼んでいた品物が一気に来ちゃってね。
lines.translated: "Yeah, all the stuff I ordered came in at once.

lines.content: \nこのままにしておくわけにもいかないから」
lines.translated: \nI can't just leave it sitting out here."

lines.content: 姉さんがバランスを崩したところを慌てて支える。
lines.translated: I rush over to catch sis as she loses her balance.

lines.content: 「……ふぅ。危なかったぁ……ありがと」\@
せっせと運んでいるが、いかんせん量が多い。
lines.translated: She's been hustling away at it, but there's just too much to carry.

lines.content: 「このくらいなら、なんてこと無いよ。
\nこっちのダンボールを持っていけばいいのかな」
lines.translated: \nShould I just take these cardboard boxes over?"

lines.content: 置かれたダンボールを、２個、まとめて持ち上げる。
lines.translated: I pick up two of the cardboard boxes sitting there and carry them both at once.
"I'll take these to the back door!"

lines.content: これなら三往復もすれば、終わるかな。
lines.translated: At this rate, maybe three trips will do it.

lines.content: 最後のダンボールを持ち上げ聞いてみる。
lines.translated: I lift the last cardboard box and ask.

lines.content: 「うん……あっという間だったねぇ……」

lines.translated: "Well, we had two people on the job."

lines.content: 「ほとんど君にお任せだったと思うけど……♪」
lines.translated: "I think you did most of it, though...♪"

lines.content: 「ほら、力は有り余ってるんで」
「うふふ～……男の子だねぇ……偉い偉い♪」\@
lines.translated: "Ufufu~... Such a strong boy... Good job, good job♪"\@

lines.content: 姉さんが背伸びをして頭を撫でてくる。
lines.translated: Sis stands on her tiptoes and pats me on the head.

lines.content: 両手がふさがっているので、こちらは頭を撫でられるがまま。
lines.translated: With both hands full, I can't do anything but let her pat away.

lines.content: いつものことではあるけれど、やっぱり恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: It's nothing new, but it's still embarrassing.

lines.content: 「でもいいなぁ……身体も大きくなって……
lines.translated: "Still, I'm a little jealous... You've gotten so big...

lines.content: \n荷物もたくさん持てるし、高いところにも手が届くし」
lines.translated: \nYou can carry tons of stuff and reach high places too."

lines.content: 「私ももう少し大きくなりたいなぁ……」
lines.translated: "I wish I could've grown a little bigger too..."

lines.content: 「うんっ！　身体も力も、もっと大きくなれば、
lines.translated: "Yeah! If I had a bigger body and more strength,

lines.content: \n今日の荷物だってスイスイ～っと持っていけるでしょ？」
lines.translated: \nI could've carried today's load no problem, right?"

lines.content: 姉さんはけっこう抱きついてくるし、
\nそしてその時は容赦なく力いっぱいだ。
lines.translated: \nand when she does, she always squeezes with full force.

lines.content: 昼休みに入り、昼食を食べようとかばんを
lines.translated: Lunch break started, and I went to grab my bag to eat,

lines.content: 隅にでも行ってしまったのかとくまなく探したが、
lines.translated: I searched every corner thinking it might have slipped to the side,

lines.content: \n弁当箱は影も形も見当たらなかった。
lines.translated: \nbut there was no sign of my lunchbox anywhere.
"Nah, looks like I forgot my lunch..."

lines.content: 「えっ、じゃあ、君は今日、一体何の楽しみがあって
lines.translated: "What? So then, what exactly did you even come to school for

lines.content: 「いや一応、昼飯以外にも、理由があって来てるけど……」
lines.translated: "I mean, I do have other reasons for being here besides lunch, you know..."

lines.content: 夕食後に、姉さんが持ってきたものを見て、
lines.translated: After dinner, Chitose brought something out, and

lines.translated: "That's what it looks like, right... but this is dorayaki!
"Yes, just the outer shell... isn't it."

lines.content: 「そう、家庭科部の調理実習で作ったの……\@
lines.translated: "Yep, I made them in home ec club cooking practice...\@

lines.translated: "I've got red bean paste and whipped cream ready too, so put in as much as you like

lines.translated: Rei immediately reached for one of the dorayaki skins
\nand sandwiched some red bean paste inside.

lines.content: 「生クリームを加えるのは、この次にします……\@
lines.translated: "I'll try adding whipped cream the next time...\@

lines.content: 「自分で組み合わせて作れるのは、楽しいよね。
lines.translated: "Being able to mix and match your own combinations is fun, isn't it.

lines.content: \n私は……生クリームとあんこを組み合わせて――」
lines.translated: \nI'm going to... put red bean paste and whipped cream together--"

lines.content: 姉さんが、器用にあんこと生クリームを
lines.translated: Chitose skillfully layered the red bean paste and whipped cream

lines.content: うん、見事な生クリームどら焼きだ。
lines.translated: Yep, a perfect whipped cream dorayaki.

lines.content: 「姉さん、１番にパスタセットよろしく」
lines.translated: "Sis, one pasta set for table one, please."

lines.content: \nこっちの注文も、準備よろしくー♪」
lines.translated: \nAnd get the other order ready too, okay? ♪"

lines.content: 姉さんが、軽やかに料理を持っていくのを見ながら、
lines.translated: Watching Sis glide off with the dishes,
\nI get back to work in the kitchen.

lines.content: 「パスタセットお持ちしました～っ♪」
「あ、はーい。少々お待ち下さいね」
戻ってきた姉さんに水差しを渡す。
lines.translated: I hand her the water pitcher when she comes back.

lines.content: 姉さんは受け取るとすぐにテーブルへ向かって、
lines.translated: Sis takes it and heads straight to the table

lines.content: 「うふふ～、ありがとう。よくわかったねぇ」\@
lines.translated: "Ufufu~, thank you. How did you know?"\@

lines.content: 「一緒に手伝いして、何年にもなるからね」
lines.translated: "We've been working together for years now."

lines.content: 姉さんが嬉しそうに俺に手を伸ばすので、
lines.translated: Sis reaches out toward me with a happy look on her face,

lines.content: \n俺もつい、頭を軽く下げてしまう。
lines.translated: \nand before I know it, I've lowered my head a little.

lines.content: 笑顔で姉さんが頭を撫でてくる。
lines.translated: She pats my head with a smile.

lines.content: 恥ずかしいけど、ついつい身体が動いてしまうのは、
lines.translated: It's a little embarrassing, but my body just moves on its own --

lines.content: \nそういう『慣れ』なんだろうか？
lines.translated: \nis that what you'd call being 'used to it'?

lines.content: （ま……姉さんとの関係ってこういう形だよな……）
lines.translated: (Well... I guess this is just how things are between me and Sis...)

lines.content: 多分これから先、俺がどう変わろうとも、
lines.translated: No matter how much I change going forward,

lines.content: \n姉さんはずっと『姉』なんだろう。
それが当たり前になってしまっているので、

lines.translated: \nthere's nothing good or bad about it.

lines.content: 玲が居候したり、黒姫さんが引っ越してきたり、
lines.translated: Rei moving in, Kurohime-san relocating here --

lines.content: （こうして、変わらないこともあるよなぁ……）
中間テストも無事終わり、赤点も無事回避。
lines.translated: The midterms are over, and I managed to avoid failing grades.

lines.content: 当面の問題はクリアできたので、後は文化祭の準備に
lines.translated: With that immediate problem out of the way, all that's left is to push forward

lines.content: 放課後、文化祭の買い出しのため昇降口へ向かっていると、
lines.translated: After school, on my way to the entrance to go shopping for the culture festival,

lines.content: \n姉さんと副部長が話していた。
lines.translated: \nI spotted Sis talking with the Vice President.

lines.content: 目が合ったので挨拶すれば、姉さんが寄ってくる。
lines.translated: Our eyes met, so I said hi, and Sis came over to me.

lines.content: そして、俺の頭を撫でてきた。
lines.translated: Then she started patting me on the head.
"...What's gotten into you all of a sudden?"

lines.content: 「私の弟は、ちゃんと挨拶できる良い子だなぁって思って」
lines.translated: "I was just thinking what a good boy my little brother is, greeting people properly like that."

lines.content: 「それは普通のような……なんかあったんですか？」
lines.translated: "That's pretty normal, though... Did something happen?"

lines.content: 「さっき友だちがさ。同じ学園に弟がいるんだけど、
lines.translated: "A friend of mine was just complaining that her brother goes to the same school,

lines.content: \n会ってもスルーされるって嘆いてたのよ」
lines.translated: \nbut whenever they run into each other, he completely ignores her."
"Siblings can have complicated dynamics, I guess."

lines.content: 俺だって姉さんの行動は照れくさい。
lines.translated: I mean, even I find Sis's behavior embarrassing sometimes.

lines.content: \nずっとこの調子だったから慣れてしまっただけだ。
lines.translated: \nI've just gotten used to it because she's always been like this.

lines.content: わずかに覚醒し、まどろみを楽しんでいると、
lines.translated: I wake up just a little, enjoying the drowsy haze between sleep and consciousness,
\nwhen I notice it's warmer than usual.

lines.content: これからどんどん寒くなっていく時期に、このあたたかさ。
lines.translated: With the cold season just around the corner, this warmth is...

lines.content: そして、この甘く優しい香り――
lines.translated: And then there's this sweet, gentle scent--

lines.content: 目を開ければ、同じ布団の中で姉さんが微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: I open my eyes to find Sis smiling at me from inside the same futon.

lines.content: 文化祭の準備をしていたら、すっかり
lines.translated: I got so caught up with the school festival preparations that

lines.content: \n日が沈む時間になってしまった。
lines.translated: \nbefore I knew it, the sun had already set.

lines.content: 「もうちょっとやってくよ。今のうちに使った領収書
lines.translated: "I'm gonna stay a bit longer. I want to get the receipts
\nwe used sorted out while I have the chance."

lines.content: 「あんまり根を詰めてやるなよ」
「家に帰ったらやらないから問題ない」
lines.translated: "I won't do it at home, so it's fine."

lines.content: 「そっか、それじゃよろしくな」
lines.translated: "Fair enough. I'll leave it to you then."

lines.content: 「サンキュー、そこまで遅くはならないよ」
ホーセンに手を振って、残りの作業を続ける。
lines.translated: I wave to Hosen and get back to the remaining work.

lines.content: 終わる頃にはすっかり日が暮れてしまった。
lines.translated: By the time I finish, it's completely dark outside.

lines.content: 今日は遅くなると事前に姉さんや玲に
lines.translated: I'd already told Sis and Rei ahead of time
\nthat I'd be late today, so it's fine.

lines.content: とはいえ、遅くなればその分心配もされるから、
lines.translated: That said, the later I am, the more they'll worry,

lines.content: \nさっさと帰ることにしよう。
中庭を挟んで向かいに見える管理・技術棟を見れば
lines.translated: Looking across the courtyard at the administration and technical building,
\nI can see a light on inside.

lines.content: 「あら、まだ帰ってなかったの？」
家庭科室に入れば、顔を上げた姉さんが目を丸くする。
lines.translated: I step into the home ec room and Sis looks up, eyes wide.

lines.content: 「姉さんこそ、遅くまで文化祭の準備？」
lines.translated: "You're one to talk -- staying late for the school festival too?"

lines.content: 「準備もあったけど、今は別のこと。\@
lines.translated: "There was some of that, but I'm doing something else now.\@

lines.content: 手にしていた布を掲げてみせる。
lines.translated: She holds up the fabric she had in her hands.

lines.content: 「うん、端切れがたくさん余ってたから、
lines.translated: "Yep, there were a lot of fabric scraps left over,

lines.content: \nパッチワークで作ってたの」
lines.translated: \nso I was making some patchwork ones."
-- Something I said when I was little.

lines.content: くらやみ坂に『おばけが出る』と聞いて、姉さんと
lines.translated: We'd heard that Kurayami Slope was "haunted," so Sis and I

lines.content: ――正確にはホタルだったんだろう。
lines.translated: -- It was probably just fireflies, looking back.

lines.content: \nでも、その頃は本当におばけだと思い驚いた。
lines.translated: \nBut at the time, we really thought it was a ghost, and we were terrified.

lines.content: その拍子に姉さんが腰を抜かしてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: That's when Sis's legs gave out from under her.
Pitch black, just the two of us.

lines.content: 大人を呼んでこようと立ち上がると、姉さんが、
lines.translated: I stood up to go get an adult, and that's when Sis

lines.content: いつも優しくて頼りになる、完全無欠のお姉さん。
lines.translated: Sis -- always kind, always reliable, the perfect big sister.

lines.content: そう思っていた姉さんの姿に、何よりも先に驚いてしまった。
lines.translated: Seeing her like that surprised me more than anything else.

lines.content: でも、それなら今度は俺の番――そう思った。
lines.translated: But if that was the case, then it was my turn now -- that's what I thought.

lines.content: 姉さんの手を握り、落ち着くのを待つ。
lines.translated: I held Sis's hand and waited for her to calm down.

lines.content: 静かで真っ暗で怖いけど。
lines.translated: It was quiet and dark and scary.

lines.content: \n姉さんのぬくもりに俺も安心した。
lines.translated: \nBut her warmth put me at ease too.

lines.content: 「こわく、ない……だいじょうぶ、きっとだいじょうぶ……」
lines.translated: "It's not scary... it's okay, it'll be okay..."

lines.content: 何度も謝りながら、俺のことを気遣ってくれた。
lines.translated: She kept apologizing, all while worrying about me.

lines.content: 今思えば滑稽なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Looking back, it might seem a little funny.

lines.content: 腰を抜かして動けないのは本人なのに、
lines.translated: She was the one whose legs had given out and couldn't move,
\nand yet she was the one worrying about me.

lines.content: でも、今だからこそわかる。
lines.translated: But I understand it now, looking back.

lines.content: 自分が申し訳ないと思っているからこそ、あの時、
lines.translated: It was precisely because she felt so bad about it that she tried so hard

lines.content: \n姉さんは懸命に俺を心配してくれたのだ。
「いっしょだから、こわくない」
「……おねえちゃんといっしょだから、こわくない」
lines.translated: "...I'm not scared because I'm with you, sis."

lines.content: だからだろうか。そう伝えて姉さんの頭を撫でた。
lines.translated: Maybe that's why. I told her that and patted her on the head.

lines.content: 「おねえちゃんも、こわくない？」
姉さんも、小さく笑ってくれた。
lines.translated: Sis gave a small smile, too.

lines.content: ――あの時、感じた感情はなんだろう。
lines.translated: -- What was it I felt back then, I wonder.
I don't think it was love.

lines.content: ただ、姉さんも一人の『女の子』だということ。
lines.translated: Just the realization that Sis was a "girl" too.

lines.content: \nそして、その彼女を守らなければという気持ちがあった。
lines.translated: \nAnd a feeling that I had to protect her.

lines.content: でも、それ以降は何があるということもなく、
lines.translated: But after that, nothing more came of it,

lines.content: \nいつしか今までどおりの『姉弟』に戻った。
lines.translated: \nand before long we went back to being the same old "brother and sister."

lines.content: 姉弟に戻った――そのはずだ。
lines.translated: We went back to being siblings -- or so I thought.

lines.content: 懐かしいことを思い出した。
lines.translated: I found myself lost in old memories.

lines.content: 「ふふ、大きなアクビ。おはよう！」
lines.translated: "Hehe, what a big yawn. Good morning!"

lines.content: ながれ茶屋街の朝の掃除をしていると、
lines.translated: I was doing the morning sweep of the Nagare Chayagai when

lines.content: 「おはよう、姉さん。身体の調子は大丈夫？」
「問題なし！　玲ちゃんもおはよー♪」
lines.translated: "Right as rain! Good morning to you too, Rei-chan!"

lines.content: 黙々と石畳を掃いている玲にも声をかけている。
lines.translated: She even called out to Rei, who was silently sweeping the cobblestones.

lines.content: （そっか。あの時、怖がってたのは姉さんか……）
lines.translated: (Oh, right. Back then, it was sis who was scared...)

lines.content: 腰を抜かした時の反応が昔の姉さんと重なったからだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe it was because her reaction when she collapsed reminded me of how sis used to be.

lines.content: \nあの時のことをしっかりと思い出せた。
lines.translated: \nIt brought that memory back to me clearly.

lines.content: それで姉を見る目が変わるわけでもない。
lines.translated: It's not like it changed the way I see Sis.

lines.content: \n思い出せてよかった。そのくらいの気分のはず。
lines.translated: \nI was just glad I could remember it. That's all it should have been.

lines.content: \nすっきりしない気持ちが残り、胸に渦巻いていた。
lines.translated: \nSomething unsettled lingered inside me, swirling in my chest.

lines.content: 昨日のことは、大きな事件だった。
lines.translated: Yesterday had been a major incident.

lines.content: かと言って日常に大きな変化があるわけでもない。
lines.translated: That said, it didn't mean anything in my daily life had changed dramatically.

lines.content: 「おはよーっす。昨日はお疲れなー」
いつものように、友人たちへ挨拶しながら席へ着く。
lines.translated: I greeted my friends as usual and took my seat.

lines.content: 隣の席の黒姫さんにも挨拶し、机に入れっぱなしに
lines.translated: I said good morning to Kurohime-san in the next seat over, then reached into my desk to pull out

lines.content: \nしていた教科書やノートを取り出す。
lines.translated: \nthe textbooks and notebooks I'd left inside.

lines.content: 教科書とノートの間から何かが落ちる。
lines.translated: Something fell out from between the textbook and notebook.

lines.content: 黒姫さんが拾い上げてくれる。\@
lines.translated: Kurohime-san picked it up for me.\@

lines.content: 封筒？　見覚えがないぞ。
lines.translated: An envelope? I don't recognize it.
"Hehe, you're quite the dark horse, aren't you."

lines.content: 小さく笑った黒姫さんが、丁寧に俺へ返してくる。
lines.translated: Kurohime-san gave a small laugh and handed it back to me politely.

lines.content: 雑談していたホーセンとフッチーも、
lines.translated: Hosen and Futchi, who had been chatting nearby,

lines.content: \n俺の手の中にある封筒を見る。
lines.translated: \nboth looked at the envelope in my hand.

lines.content: 「お……これは、どう見ても手紙だね」
lines.translated: "Oh... this is clearly a letter, no matter how you look at it."

lines.content: 「しかもなかなか可愛らしい装丁だな」
lines.translated: "And it's got a pretty cute design, too."

lines.content: 友人二人が結論づける。
lines.translated: My two friends reached their conclusion.

lines.content: 「いや、そうと決まったわけじゃないだろ」
lines.translated: "Come on, that's not necessarily what it is."

lines.content: 「でもコレを見て、そうじゃないってのは無理筋だぜ」
lines.translated: "But looking at this thing and saying it's not? That's a stretch, man."

lines.content: 「蔦町先輩に引き続いて、フラグを立てたのかい？
lines.translated: "Following right after Tsutamachi-senpai, you've gone and raised another flag, huh?

lines.content: 助けを求めて隣の黒姫さんを見てしまう。
lines.translated: I found myself looking to Kurohime-san next to me for help.

lines.content: ごもっともな返答が返ってきた。
「ですけど、ラブレターなんて初めて見ました」
lines.translated: "But I've never seen a love letter before in real life."

lines.content: 「都会なのに、とても古風な方法で……
lines.translated: "Even in the city, what an old-fashioned way to do it...

lines.content: \nお話の中みたいな出来事ですね」
lines.translated: \nIt's like something out of a story."

lines.content: 妙な感動をされてしまった。
lines.translated: She seemed strangely moved by it.

lines.content: とはいえ、黒姫さんは純粋そうな印象があるので、
lines.translated: Then again, Kurohime-san gave off a genuinely innocent impression, so

lines.content: \n乙女な反応をしても驚きは無いのだけど。
lines.translated: \nit's no surprise she'd react like a starry-eyed girl.

lines.content: 困り果てていると、教師が来たので一旦机の中にしまう。
lines.translated: I was at a loss, but the teacher arrived, so I tucked it into my desk for the time being.

lines.content: 「開けろ開けろ」という友人たちから逃れ、
lines.translated: Escaping from my friends and their "open it, open it" chants,

lines.content: \n中庭で改めて手紙を見つめる。
lines.translated: \nI took another look at the letter in the courtyard.

lines.content: 二人が言うように、とても綺麗な封筒だ。
lines.translated: Just like those two said, it really is a beautiful envelope.

lines.content: \n冗談やイタズラにしては凝りすぎている。
lines.translated: \nToo elaborate to be a prank or a joke.

lines.content: だが、困ったことに封筒を見ても、何も書いていない。
lines.translated: But the frustrating thing was, there was nothing written on the envelope at all.

lines.content: （せめて宛名でもわかればなぁ……）
lines.translated: (If only I at least knew who it was addressed to...)

lines.content: 「誰かのイタズラ……いやでも、誰が？」
開いてみればわかるし、むしろ冗談やドッキリなら、
lines.translated: If I just opened it, I'd find out -- and if it really was a joke or a prank,

lines.content: \n笑って済ませられる部分もある。
lines.translated: \nthere's a part of me that could just laugh it off.

lines.content: だが、逆にラブレターだとしたら、どうするのだろう？
lines.translated: But on the other hand, what if it really was a love letter? What would I do then?

lines.content: （いや、なんで姉さんが出てくる？）
lines.translated: (Wait, why am I thinking about sis?)

lines.content: 姉さんに遠慮しているのか？
lines.translated: Am I holding back because of her?

lines.content: \nいや、それこそ意味がわからない。
姉さんを支えたいし守りたい……そんな気持ちはある。
lines.translated: I want to support her, to protect her... those feelings are real.

lines.content: 姉弟の愛情であって、恋情じゃない。
lines.translated: It's the love between siblings -- not romantic love.

lines.content: 「……開いてから考えればいいか」
lines.translated: "...I'll figure it out after I open it."

lines.content: 開封しようと手をかけ――
lines.translated: I reached for the envelope to open it --

lines.content: 姉さんがやってくるので、慌ててポケットにしまう。
lines.translated: Sis came walking over, so I hurriedly stuffed it into my pocket.
"Oh, uh... just, like... soaking up some sun...?"

lines.content: まずい……長年の付き合いだ。
lines.translated: This is bad... we've known each other for years.

lines.content: 俺がごまかしたり、隠し事をしても姉さんはすぐに勘づく。
lines.translated: Even when I try to play it off or hide something, sis sees right through me.

lines.content: 「何か、心配事？　お姉ちゃんに相談してくれていいのよ」
lines.translated: "Is something bothering you? You can talk to your big sis, you know."

lines.content: 「むぅ……悩んでるの抱え込んだら良くないよ」\@
lines.translated: "Hmm... it's not good to bottle things up when you're worried."\@
She's got me completely figured out.

lines.content: 「えーっと……姉さんは、誰かに手紙を書くとしたら
lines.translated: "Well... if you were going to write a letter to someone,
\nwhat kind of occasion would it be for?"

lines.content: それならばとぼかして質問することにした。

lines.content: うーん……それってたぶん、
「うん、メールやチャットでも伝えられる時代だもの」
lines.translated: "I mean, we live in an age where you can say anything over email or chat."

lines.content: 「手間を掛けてお手紙を書くってことは、それだけ
lines.translated: "Taking the trouble to write a letter means it's that much

lines.content: \n特別なことなんだと思うの」

lines.translated: "Well... it does stick in your memory."

lines.content: 「だから手紙を書くとしたら、大事な人に向けて、
lines.translated: "So if I were to write a letter, it would be to someone important,

lines.content: そっか……やっぱり誠実に対応しないとダメだよな。
lines.translated: Right... I really do need to handle this sincerely.

lines.content: 伝えたい想いを勇気を出して綴ってくれたんだ。
lines.translated: She worked up the courage to put her feelings into words and send them to me.

lines.content: \n俺も真剣に向き合わないと。
lines.translated: \nI have to face that seriously too.

lines.content: 「それで、誰かにお手紙を書くの？」
lines.translated: "So, are you writing a letter to someone?"

lines.content: 「いや、ちょっと気になっただけ。
「ふふふ、そのくらいなら任せて」
「そろそろ５時限目が始まるから行くよ」
lines.translated: "Fifth period's about to start, so I'm heading out."

lines.content: 姉さんの前で開くわけにもいかないし、場所を変えよう。
lines.translated: I can't open it in front of sis anyway -- I should find somewhere else.

lines.content: 姉さんに軽く手を振ってその場を離れた。
lines.translated: I gave sis a little wave and walked away.

lines.content: 「手紙なんて急にどうしたのかしら……\@
lines.translated: "A letter, out of nowhere... I wonder what that was about...\@

lines.content: 駅から出た姉さんが辺りの山々を見渡して、開口一番、

lines.translated: What hit my eyes first was a vivid red.
\nAnd yet, it was easy on the eyes.

lines.content: すっかり色づいた紅葉が俺たちを迎えてくれる。
lines.translated: The fully-colored autumn leaves welcomed us.

lines.content: 「ねっ、ねっ！　早く狩りに行きましょう！」\@

"The way you say it makes it sound dangerous."

lines.content: いつも優しい姉さんが言うから、迫力も２割増。
lines.translated: Coming from Sis, usually so gentle, it had about twenty percent more impact.

lines.content: ――なんて笑顔は優しいままだけど。
lines.translated: -- Though her smile was just as soft as ever.

lines.content: 「でも、紅葉『狩り』でしょ……さっ、行こー♪」\@
lines.translated: "But it's called leaf 'hunting'... now come on, let's go!♪"\@

lines.content: 姉さんが俺の手を引く。\@
lines.translated: Chitose pulled me along by the hand.\@

lines.translated: The two of us had ridden the train together to get here --

lines.translated: A hot spring resort nestled in the mountains, not far from Shirasagi City.

lines.content: \nこの時期は紅葉も楽しめる。
lines.translated: \nThis time of year, you can enjoy the autumn foliage too.

lines.content: 川沿いの山道は、紅葉に彩られている。
lines.translated: The mountain path along the river was painted in autumn colors.

lines.content: 「ちょうどいい時期ね。蓮池園も綺麗だったけど、
lines.translated: "Perfect timing. Renchien was beautiful too, but
\nthis place is gorgeous -- definitely the right call!"

lines.content: 「でも、どうして急に黒瀬温泉？」
lines.translated: "But why Kurose Onsen all of a sudden?"

lines.content: 今日の朝、突然誘われそのままここに来たので聞いてみる。
lines.translated: I asked, since she'd invited me out of nowhere this morning and we'd come straight here.

lines.content: 「ここ最近、色々迷惑かけたからお礼代わりにね。
lines.translated: "I've caused you a lot of trouble lately, so think of this as my way of saying thanks.

lines.content: \n玲ちゃんも一緒にって思ったんだけど」
lines.translated: \nI thought about inviting Rei-chan too, but..."

lines.content: 玲は朝から街の散策に出かけたらしく、
lines.translated: Apparently Rei had gone out to explore the town since early morning,

lines.content: \n姉さんが誘ってきた時には家にいなかった。
lines.translated: \nand wasn't home when Chitose came to invite us.

lines.content: 「姉さんが迷惑かけたなんてないと思うなぁ」
lines.translated: "I don't think you've caused me any trouble at all, Sis."

lines.content: 「でもほら、ラブレターとか夜の学校のこととか……ねぇ？」
lines.translated: "But you know, the love letter thing, and that night at the school... right?"

lines.content: ラブレターの件では、手紙を拾ってくれたから、
lines.translated: With the love letter, she was the one who picked it up for me,
\nso if anything, I was the one who should be grateful.

lines.content: ……手紙の内容を、すごく気にしてたみたいだけど。
lines.translated: Though she did seem really bothered by what was written in it.
And the night at the school --

lines.translated: I found myself remembering Chitose, scared on Kurayami Slope

lines.content: （なんで[過去のこと/そっち]を思い出すんだ……）

lines.content: 姉さんらしくない思い出を――
どうして俺は、ことさら『姉らしくないこと』を
lines.translated: Why was I going out of my way to recall things

考えを紛らわせるために、辺りの紅葉を

lines.translated: \nso maybe they can't help but smile a little?"
"That's one way to look at it."

lines.translated: \nbut over here, we get snow, so..."

lines.content: \n紅葉の季節が終われば、雪景色だ。
lines.translated: \nOnce the autumn leaves are gone, it'll be a world of white.

lines.content: 「寒いのは困るけど、雪が降らないよりいいかな」
lines.translated: "The cold is a bit rough, but I'd rather have snow than not."

lines.content: 雪が降らないと冬が来たって感じがしない。
lines.translated: Without snow, it just doesn't feel like winter has arrived.

lines.content: ウインクした姉さんが少し先を歩く。
lines.translated: Chitose winked and walked a little ahead of me.

lines.content: そよ風が吹くと、はらはらと色づいた葉が舞い落ちる。
lines.translated: When a gentle breeze blew through, colorful leaves fluttered down around us.

lines.content: 桜のような花びらの奔流とはいかないが、
lines.translated: It wasn't quite the torrent of petals you'd get with cherry blossoms,

lines.content: \nひらりはらりと落ちていく紅葉も風情がある。
lines.translated: \nbut the autumn leaves drifting softly down had their own quiet charm.

lines.content: 真っ赤に色づいてる……綺麗」

lines.translated: The memory of her small smile when I patted her on the head comes back to me.

lines.translated: Had I patted her head that night at the school

lines.content: 過去や夜の校舎での姉さんを思い出すと、

普段と違う姉さんを見て守りたいという
