"I'll press this into a bookmark later."

lines.content: ティッシュを取り出し、丁寧に包むと、
lines.translated: She took out a tissue and wrapped the leaf carefully,
\nthen tucked it between the pages of a small notepad.

lines.content: その笑顔にも、嬉しさと一緒に気恥ずかしさを
lines.translated: Even that smile of hers made me feel a warmth mixed with

lines.content: 川沿いの山道を歩いていけば、視界が開ける。
lines.translated: We followed the mountain path along the river, and the view opened up before us.

lines.content: 「はぁ……♪　今年も変わらず、ここは素敵ね」
lines.translated: "Ahh...♪ Just as lovely as ever, every year."

lines.content: 川の上に設けられた台と、大きな番傘が特徴的な場所
lines.translated: A platform built out over the river, shaded by large traditional parasols --
\na kawadoko, in the truest sense of the word.

lines.content: 「黒瀬温泉に来たら、ここは外せないよ」
lines.translated: "You can't come to Kurose Onsen and skip this place."

lines.content: 店員さんに案内され川床の一角に腰を下ろす。
lines.translated: A clerk showed us to a spot on the platform and we settled in.

lines.content: 「ふぅ。歩いてきたから、風が涼しくて気持ちいいね……」
lines.translated: "Ahh. After all that walking, the breeze feels so nice and cool..."

lines.content: まさしく紅葉狩り日和だ。
「今日は、お姉ちゃんが好きなものごちそうしちゃおう！」\@
lines.translated: "Today, big sis is treating you to whatever you want!"\@

lines.content: 「いいのいいの、どーんと[方舟/はこぶね]に
lines.translated: "Of course, of course -- you're as safe with me as on Noah's

lines.content: 「そりゃ、乗らないと助かりそうにないね」
lines.translated: "Well, then I'd better get on board, or I'll never survive the flood."

lines.content: 「紅葉、すごい綺麗だったから今の時期おすすめよ。
lines.translated: "The autumn leaves were absolutely gorgeous, so I'd definitely recommend going this time of year.
\nHere, I brought you back a souvenir."

lines.content: 放課後、文化祭の準備ということで家庭科室へ。
lines.translated: After school, we headed to the home economics room to work on preparations for the cultural festival.

lines.content: 副部長の[茉莉/まり]に話すのは、
lines.translated: What I'm telling the vice president, Mari, about is, of course,

lines.content: \n当然、先日行った紅葉狩りのことだ。
lines.translated: \nthe autumn leaf viewing trip I went on the other day.

lines.content: 「なるほど、デートだったのね」
lines.translated: "I see, so it was a date."

lines.content: 「デートなんて……そんなことあるかなぁ♪」
lines.translated: "A date... I wonder if you could really call it that~♪"

lines.content: そう言われると嬉しい気がする。
lines.translated: Hearing that makes me feel kind of happy.

lines.content: \n一緒に出かけるなんていつものことなのに。
lines.translated: \nEven though going out together is nothing out of the ordinary for us.

lines.content: 「相変わらずねぇ、あんたたちって
lines.translated: "You two are always like this, aren't you --

lines.content: \nずっとそんな感じなのかしら」
lines.translated: \nI wonder if you'll just stay that way forever."

lines.content: 「そりゃ、長年の付き合いだもの。
lines.translated: "Well, we've known each other for years.

lines.content: \nそうそう変わることなんてないと思うけど」
lines.translated: \nI don't think that's going to change anytime soon."

lines.content: でも、紅葉狩りを思い出すと、少しばかり自分の言葉に
lines.translated: But when I think back on the leaf viewing trip, my own words leave me feeling

lines.content: 紅葉狩りの時、何度も『変な』感覚があった。
lines.translated: During the trip, I had that strange feeling more than once.

lines.content: （――恋なんて、考えたことなかった）
lines.translated: (-- I had never thought about love before.)

lines.content: でも、この世の中には家族や友達。姉弟がいる。
lines.translated: But in this world, there are families and friends. Siblings.

lines.content: \n私は両親が愛し合ったから生まれた。
lines.translated: \nI was born because my parents loved each other.

lines.content: 男女の違いだって知っているし、恋物語だって知っている。
lines.translated: I know the difference between men and women, and I know love stories.

lines.content: 物語を紐解けば、白雪姫は王子さまと結ばれたし、
lines.translated: If you look through stories, Snow White ended up with her prince,

lines.content: \nロミオとジュリエットは結ばれたけど亡くなってしまった。
lines.translated: \nand Romeo and Juliet found each other, but they both died.

lines.content: 漫画だってドラマだって恋は物語の基本だ。
lines.translated: Whether it's manga or dramas, love is the foundation of every story.
But that's all just in stories.

lines.content: \n私の中では実感のわかないものだった。
lines.translated: \nFor me, it was something I couldn't really feel.

lines.content: 他の人の好きと、誰か一人の好きは何が違うのか。
lines.translated: What's the difference between loving others and loving one special person?

lines.content: もちろん、お父さんお母さん、玲ちゃんや友を愛する気持ちは、
lines.translated: Of course, the feelings I have for Mom and Dad, for Rei-chan and my friends --

lines.content: \n見知らぬ人たちを想う気持ちとは違う。
lines.translated: \nthose are different from the feelings I have for strangers.
It's a feeling of holding someone dear.

lines.content: 朝――今日も感じる、このぬくもりと香り。
lines.translated: Morning -- I feel it again today, that warmth and scent.

lines.content: このところ、何度か続いているだけに、
lines.translated: It's happened a few times lately, so

lines.content: \n驚きよりも妙な納得をしてしまう。
lines.translated: \nrather than surprise, I find myself oddly accepting it.

lines.content: 「姉さん、また布団に入ってきて――」
lines.translated: "Sis, you crawled into my futon again--"

lines.content: 目を開け、姉さんを見れば――
lines.translated: I open my eyes and look at her--

lines.content: 予想通り、姉さんが布団に入ってきている。
lines.translated: Sure enough, she's climbed into my futon.

lines.content: でも、その表情は毎度の笑顔でなく
lines.translated: But her expression isn't her usual carefree smile --

lines.content: \n顔を真っ赤に染めた恥じらいに満ちたもの。
lines.translated: \nit's full of embarrassment, her face flushed bright red.

lines.content: そんな顔をされてしまうと、
lines.translated: When she makes a face like that,

lines.content: \nこちらもどうすればいいかわからない。
lines.translated: \nI don't know what to do with myself either.

lines.content: 「ほら、あったかいし……ついつい、入っちゃうよね！」
lines.translated: "I mean, it's warm, so... I just can't help crawling in!"

lines.content: 「添い寝したら……うれ、嬉しいでしょ？」
lines.translated: "You're... hap-happy I'm sleeping next to you, right?"

lines.content: 布団に姉さんが入ってくるのは、正直俺も恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: Honestly, having Sis climb into my futon is embarrassing for me too.

lines.content: でも今までは、姉さんがあっけらかんとしていたから、
lines.translated: But up until now, she'd always been so breezy about it,

lines.content: \n『まぁ、しかたないか』で済ませていた。
lines.translated: \nso I'd just let it slide with a "well, whatever."

lines.content: だからこの反応は困る。
lines.translated: So this reaction is throwing me off.

lines.content: \nドキドキしてしまっている自分がいる。
「ど……どうしたの？　いつもと反応違うよ」
lines.translated: "Wh... what's wrong? You're acting different than usual."

lines.content: 「姉さんがいつもと違うから」
「えっ、違うところなんて、無いと思う……なぁ！」
lines.translated: "Huh? I don't think anything's different... at all!"

lines.content: それでも自覚はあるのか目をそらされた。
lines.translated: She looked away, so she must have some awareness of it.

lines.content: 「ほら、いつも通りだし……ぜんぶっ」
lines.translated: "See, it's just like always... all of it!"

lines.content: いつものように抱きついてくる。
lines.translated: She hugs me like she always does.

lines.content: だけど、そのまま姉さんが固まる。
lines.translated: But then she freezes up right there.

lines.content: 押し付けられた胸の柔らかさの奥から、
lines.translated: From beneath the softness of her chest pressed against me,

lines.content: \n激しいほど高鳴る鼓動を感じてしまう。
lines.translated: \nI can feel a heartbeat pounding almost violently.

lines.content: それとも、このドキドキは俺のものなのか。
lines.translated: Or maybe this pounding heart is my own.

lines.content: これは、どうすれば良いんだ。
lines.translated: What am I supposed to do here.

lines.content: 言った姉さんの身体は緊張で強張っている。
lines.translated: Sis's body is stiff with tension as she says it.

lines.content: \nあたたかさよりも、身体の奥が熱くなってくる。
lines.translated: \nMore than warmth, something deep inside me is burning hot.

lines.content: やはりというか、起きた玲が俺たちを見下ろしていた。
lines.translated: Sure enough, Rei had woken up and was looking down at us.

lines.content: でも、俺たちの空気を察したのか、
lines.translated: But she must have sensed the atmosphere between us,

lines.content: \n玲も少し戸惑っているようだった。
lines.translated: \nbecause Rei looked a little flustered too.
"I'm so hungry I can't take it..."

lines.content: 「２時限目の休み時間に、サンドイッチ食ってたろ？」
lines.translated: "Didn't you eat a sandwich during the break after second period?"

lines.content: 「朝練で使ったカロリーは、パンじゃ
lines.translated: "The calories I burned at morning practice aren't
\neven close to covered by a piece of bread..."

lines.content: 「それなら、さっさと食べようぜ」
ホーセンとフッチーと昼食を食べることにする。
lines.translated: I decide to have lunch with Hosen and Futchi.

lines.content: いつものように朝、隣の家へ向かう。
lines.translated: I head next door like I do every morning.

lines.content: （今は玲ちゃんがいるけど、一人暮らしの男性の家に行く。
lines.translated: (Rei-chan is there now, but still... going into a single man's house.

lines.content: \nこんなに無警戒に入っていいのかしら……？）
lines.translated: \nIs it really okay to just walk in like this without a second thought...?)

lines.content: ふと、自分のやってきたことを振り返ってしまう。
lines.translated: I find myself looking back on everything I've been doing.

lines.content: まずは家に入る……まぁ、これは家族付き合い的なものだし、
lines.translated: First, I let myself in... well, that's just the kind of neighborly family thing we do,

lines.content: \nダメッ！　というほどでもない。
田舎なんかだと、インターホンもなく普通に戸を開けて
lines.translated: In rural areas, I've heard some people just open the door and call out a greeting

lines.content: \n挨拶するようなところもあるらしいから、問題はないはず。
lines.translated: \nwithout even ringing a doorbell, so it should be fine.

lines.content: 朝食の準備をするために、勝手に台所に入る。
lines.translated: I head straight into the kitchen to start making breakfast without asking.

lines.content: でも、これはご両親から姉代わりとして任せられた誇りだ。
lines.translated: But this is a duty I was entrusted with by his parents -- to be like an older sister to him.

lines.content: 二人を起こしに向かう。
lines.translated: I go to wake the two of them up.

lines.content: 男の人の部屋に、無断で入る……これはいいのかしら？
lines.translated: Walking into a man's room without permission... is that okay?

lines.content: ギリギリセーフ？　アウト？
lines.translated: Barely acceptable? Or out of bounds?

lines.content: 二人ともまだ眠っている。昨日は――
lines.translated: They're both still asleep. Last night--

lines.content: どう考えても、同衾なんてどうかしている。
lines.translated: No matter how you look at it, sharing a bed is just not normal.

lines.content: （え？　その『どうかしてる』ことを、私、してたの？）
lines.translated: (Wait? I was actually doing that 'not normal' thing?)

lines.content: 同じ布団に入るだけじゃなくて、抱きついたり
lines.translated: Not just getting into the same futon, but clinging to him
\nand letting him use my lap as a pillow...

lines.content: 挙句の果てに胸に手が当たっても気にしなかったり……。
lines.translated: And on top of that, not even minding when his hand touched my chest...

lines.content: \n抱きしめた時、彼の顔を胸に押し付けたり……。
lines.translated: \nAnd when I hugged him, pressing his face into my chest...

lines.content: 「あうぅ……わ……私は……なんてことを……！」\@
lines.translated: "Auu... w-what... what have I been doing...!"\@

lines.content: 冷静に見れば、どう考えてもエッチな女の子だ。
lines.translated: Looking at it objectively, there's no way around it -- I've been acting like a total flirt.

lines.content: （あわわ……私、なんてことをしてたのーーー！！！）\@
lines.translated: (Oh no oh no... what on earth have I been DOING--!!!)\@

lines.content: 思わず叫びそうになるけど、心の中での大絶叫に留める。
lines.translated: I almost cry out loud, but I manage to keep it as a silent scream inside my head.

lines.content: （でもそれは、幼馴染的な、姉弟なやつ！　だから！）\@
lines.translated: (But it's all in a childhood-friends kind of way! Like siblings! That's why it's okay!)\@

lines.content: 言い訳してみても、恥ずかしさはひとつも消せない。
lines.translated: No matter how I try to justify it, not a single drop of embarrassment goes away.

lines.content: 挨拶をしてから、私をじっと見ている。
lines.translated: She greets me, then just stares at me.

lines.content: 「え？　ど、どうしたの、玲ちゃん？」\@
（何か変な……いや、変なことはしてたんだけど、
lines.translated: (Is something weird... well, I mean, I *was* doing weird things,

lines.content: \n今も私、玲ちゃんが疑問に思う行動をとってる……？）
lines.translated: \nbut am I doing something right now that's making Rei-chan suspicious...?)

lines.content: 「今日は、布団には入らないんですか？」
lines.translated: "Are you not going to get in the futon today?"

lines.content: 「入り！？　えっと、きょ、今日はもう時間ないし、
lines.translated: "Get in!? Um, t-today I don't really have time,

lines.content: 「んん……ふぁ……あ、姉さん、玲、おはよう」
lines.translated: "Mmm... haaah... oh, good morning, sis. Morning, Rei."

lines.content: 組んだテントの骨組みをクラスメートたちと持ち上げる。
lines.translated: I lift the tent frame we assembled together with my classmates.
"Now we just need to bring the tables over--"

lines.content: 「おーい、こっちの荷物はどこにおくー？」
lines.translated: "Hey, where do we put the stuff over here?"

lines.content: 「看板はまだもってくるなよー！」
「ラップー、ラップは[何処/いずこ]にー！」
文化祭が明日に迫り、準備でてんやわんや。
lines.translated: With the culture festival tomorrow, preparations are in full swing.

lines.content: 俺は、交渉関係が終われば、残りの仕事は手伝いが中心だ。
lines.translated: Now that the negotiations are done, my remaining job is mostly helping out.

lines.content: 「俺のシフトってどうなってたっけ？」
「表作ってるから確認してくれ。クレープづくりの
lines.translated: "I made a schedule, so go check it. Since you've got

lines.content: \n経験者だから、色々頼まれてもらうぞ」
lines.translated: \nexperience making crepes, I'm gonna be counting on you a lot."

lines.content: 「そういうこと。クレープ作りに関しちゃ、
lines.translated: "Exactly. When it comes to making crepes,
\nyou're the best one for the job."

lines.content: 「おーい、こっち手伝っておくれー」
lines.translated: "Hey, give me a hand over here!"

lines.content: 会話を打ち切り、手伝いへと向かう。
lines.translated: I cut the conversation short and head over to help.

lines.content: 無事に準備も終わり、解散。
lines.translated: Preparations finish without a hitch, and we're dismissed.

lines.content: 校門を出たところで、姉さんが待っていた。
lines.translated: Sis was waiting for me just outside the school gate.

lines.content: 「あれ、姉さんもこの時間までかかったの？」
lines.translated: "Oh, did you end up staying this late too?"

lines.content: 「中庭見たら、もうちょっとで終わりそうだったから
lines.translated: "I peeked into the courtyard and it looked like you were
"No problems -- I do need to get there early tomorrow

lines.content: \nお菓子の準備をしないといけないけどね」
家庭科部は喫茶店をやるので、足の早いケーキ類が多い。
lines.translated: The home ec club is running a cafe, so they have a lot of cakes and things that don't keep well.

lines.content: \nそのため、当日に作らないといけない。
lines.translated: \nThat means they have to be made on the day itself.

lines.content: 「お疲れさま。お夕飯の材料、買って帰ろっか」
lines.translated: "You too. Want to stop and pick up ingredients for dinner on the way home?"

lines.content: 「う～ん。ゲンをかついで、トンカツにしよっか！」\@
姉さんの反応を見る限り、照れた様子はなく
lines.translated: Judging by Sis's reaction, she doesn't seem embarrassed at all --
\nit's like things are back to how they used to be.

lines.content: 姉さんが困っていないのは、良いことだけど……。
lines.translated: It's a good thing she's not uncomfortable, but...

lines.content: 俺たちの関係は、少しずつ変わっている気がする。
lines.translated: I feel like things between us are slowly changing.

lines.content: ――いや、変わっていきたいと思っている。
lines.translated: -- No, I want them to change.

lines.content: （姉さんはどう考えてるんだ……？）
lines.translated: (What does Sis think about all this...?)

lines.content: あの照れ方や反応を見るに、姉さんも変わっている。
lines.translated: Judging by how flustered she gets, Sis is changing too.

lines.content: （俺たちは、どうなっていくんだろう……？）
そんな疑問は湧くものの、俺たちの『変化』は
lines.translated: That question lingers in my mind, but somehow this 'change'

lines.content: \n決して悪いものではないような気がした。
lines.translated: \nbetween us doesn't feel like a bad thing at all.

lines.content: 今日は早めに床につく。
玲も『明日のために』と言って布団に入ったから、
lines.translated: Rei said "for tomorrow" and crawled into her futon too,

lines.content: \n文化祭が楽しみなのかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nso maybe she's looking forward to the culture festival.

lines.content: ウトウトしていたところで聞こえた、その音。
lines.translated: I was just starting to doze off when I heard it -- that sound.

lines.content: 布団から抜け出し、２階へ向かう。
lines.translated: I slip out of my futon and head upstairs.

lines.content: 思った通り、姉さんからの『合図』だった。
lines.translated: Just as I thought -- it was Sis's 'signal'.

lines.content: 「姉さんこそ、明日早いんじゃないの」
lines.translated: "You're the one with an early morning tomorrow, Sis."

lines.content: 「言い忘れてたことがあったから」
lines.translated: "There was something I forgot to tell you."
She fidgets as she says it.

lines.content: ドキリと鼓動が高鳴る。
lines.translated: My heart gives a little jump.

lines.content: 言い忘れていたこと……それって――
lines.translated: Something she forgot to tell me... could it be--
"Do you have some free time at Shiroshiro?"

lines.content: 「あ、ああ、休憩時間はあるけど」
lines.translated: "Oh, uh, yeah, I'll have breaks in between..."
(Well, of course. I was getting ahead of myself.)

lines.content: 「私は割と自由なの……良かったらシロシロ、
lines.translated: "I'm pretty free myself... if you'd like, at Shiroshiro,
\nwould you want to walk around together?"

lines.content: 「午後になるけど、それでよかったら」
lines.translated: "It'd have to be the afternoon, but if that works for you..."

lines.content: 「もちろん、いいよ。まったく問題なし！」
lines.translated: "Of course it does. No problem at all!"

lines.content: 「それじゃ、１３時に家庭科室へ行くよ」
lines.translated: "Alright, I'll come by the home ec room at one o'clock."

lines.content: 「あっ、ねえ、別の場所で待ち合わせしよ？」
lines.translated: "Oh, hey, let's meet up somewhere else instead, okay?"
"Great... ufufu~. I'm so looking forward to it!"

lines.content: 去年も姉さんと文化祭を回った。
lines.translated: I walked around the culture festival with Sis last year too.

lines.content: \nでも、今はその時とは違った高揚感があった。
lines.translated: \nBut right now, there's a different kind of excitement in my chest.
"Well then, see you tomorrow... good night."

lines.content: 「おやすみ……暖かくして寝てね」
lines.translated: "Good night... make sure you stay warm, okay?"

lines.content: 姉さんに見送られて、その場を去る。
lines.translated: Sis sees me off, and I leave.

lines.content: そっか……姉さんとシロシロを回る……。
lines.translated: So... I'm going to walk around Shiroshiro with Sis...

lines.content: （ドキドキ……いや、バクバクかもな……）
lines.translated: (My heart's pounding... no, more like racing...)

lines.content: 彼が窓を閉め、去っていくのを確認してから、
lines.translated: I wait until he closes the window and walks away,

lines.content: 「これで文化祭、一緒に回れる……♪」
lines.translated: "Now we can walk around the culture festival together... ♪"

lines.content: 去年も一緒に回ったけど、今年はまったく違う気持ちだ。
lines.translated: We walked around together last year too, but this year feels completely different.

lines.content: 「あ……でも私のこと、『お姉ちゃん』って見てるよね」
lines.translated: "Ah... but he still sees me as his 'big sister,' doesn't he."

lines.content: 『みなさーん！　準備はＯＫ？　もちろん、
\n売る準備、出し物の準備……色々あるけど』
lines.translated: \nthere's getting your stall set up, your act ready... all sorts of things, but"

lines.content: 『楽しむ準備はできたかーい！』
『わぉっ、いい感じ！　それじゃそろそろシロシロ、
lines.translated: "Wow, looking great! Alright, it's just about time -- Shiroshiro,

lines.content: ――その放送と共に、ついに城白祭が始まる。\@
lines.translated: -- With that announcement, the Jouhaku Festival finally begins.\@

lines.content: 「クレープ、今なら待たずに食べられますよー！」
lines.translated: "Crepes -- no wait required if you come now~!"

lines.content: １日目は一般公開しないため、学生たちが楽しむ日であり、
lines.translated: Since the first day isn't open to the public, it's a day for students to enjoy themselves,

lines.content: \n明日に向けて色々と調整する日でもある。
lines.translated: \nas well as a day to fine-tune everything ahead of tomorrow.

lines.content: クレープを焼く係ということで、手慣らしに焼いてみる。
lines.translated: Since I'm on crepe-making duty, I try my hand at a few to warm up.

lines.content: 「おおー、さすが慣れてんなー、いい感じ」
lines.translated: "Ooh, nice -- you're a natural, looks great."

lines.content: 今回のレシピは、姉さんが監修したレシピだ。
lines.translated: The recipe we're using this time was supervised by Sis.

lines.content: \n家で作ったこともあるから慣れている。
lines.translated: \nSince we've made it at home before, I'm pretty comfortable with it.

lines.content: 「おっ、いらっしゃい。見て回ってるのか？」
せっせと焼いていたら玲が立ち寄ってくれた。
lines.translated: While I was busy cooking away, Rei stopped by.

lines.content: 「はい、これが娑婆での最後の時間ですね」
lines.translated: "Yes. This is my last taste of the living world."

lines.content: 『おばけ役』らしい物言いだった。
lines.translated: Very fitting for someone playing the role of a ghost.
"Can I get a chocolate banana one?"
"Sure thing. I'll have it ready in a sec."

lines.content: 焼いたクレープを包んでもらって玲に渡す。
lines.translated: I have someone wrap up the crepe and hand it over to Rei.

lines.content: 「ダメです。成仏したら化けて出れなくなります」
lines.translated: "I can't. If I pass on, I won't be able to haunt anyone."

lines.content: 「それじゃ、後で遊びに行くよ」
lines.translated: "Well, I'll come check it out later."

lines.content: 「ええ、興味本位で近づいたことを後悔させてあげます」
lines.translated: "Please do. I'll make you regret ever letting your curiosity get the better of you."

lines.content: 物静かなのはいつもの通りだが、お祭りだからか、
lines.translated: She was as quietly composed as ever, but maybe because of the festival,

lines.content: \n話している内容はノリノリだった。
lines.translated: \nthe things she was saying were surprisingly enthusiastic.

lines.content: 休憩に入ったので、待ち合わせ場所に向かう。
lines.translated: With my break starting, I head to the meeting spot.
(The school gate... that was it, right?)

lines.content: 校門に着けば、姉さんがすでに待っていた。
lines.translated: When I reach the school gate, Sis is already there waiting.

lines.content: いそいそと身だしなみを整え、髪やスカートの裾を
lines.translated: She's fussing over her appearance, smoothing her hair and tugging at the hem of her skirt
\nlike she's unusually worried about how she looks.

lines.content: （デートの待ち合わせ……みたいだな）
ふと自分で考えたことにドキリ。
lines.translated: The thought catches me off guard and my heart skips a beat.

lines.content: もしかして、そのために――？
lines.translated: Could it be that she came early for that reason--?

lines.content: 「先に待っててくれたみたいだったけど」
lines.translated: "Looked like you were waiting for me already, though."

lines.content: その笑顔は……いつもの姉さんだ。
lines.translated: That smile... that's the same Sis I've always known.

lines.content: でも『デート』と意識したような言い回しだった。
lines.translated: But the way she phrased it made it sound like she was thinking of it as a "date."

lines.content: 姉さんが俺の手をとる。\@
手を繋ぐのはよくあることだけど、
lines.translated: Holding hands is nothing unusual for us, but
\nshe seems a little flustered about it.

lines.content: 最近の姉さんがよく見せる顔。
lines.translated: It's a look Sis has been showing me a lot lately.

lines.content: \n俺を意識してくれてるんだろうか？
lines.translated: \nCould it be that she's... becoming more aware of me?

lines.content: 「あら……どうしたの？　私、いつもと違う？」
lines.translated: "My, my... what's the matter? Do I look different than usual?"

lines.content: てっきり『そんなことない』と言うのかと思ったら、
lines.translated: I expected her to say "not at all," but instead

lines.content: \n嬉しそうな照れ笑いをされる。
lines.translated: \nshe gives me a happy, bashful smile.

lines.content: 「だってお祭りだもの。いつもと違うほうがいいでしょ！」
lines.translated: "Well, it's a festival! Looking a little different is the whole point, isn't it!"

lines.content: いっそう高鳴る俺の胸の鼓動を知ってからか、
lines.translated: As if she can sense my heart beating faster,

lines.content: \n俺の手を引いて校内へ入っていく。
lines.translated: \nshe pulls my hand and leads me into the school.

lines.content: 「いらっしゃいませー♪　お悩みでしたら、和菓子！
lines.translated: "Welcome♪ If you're having trouble deciding, how about some Japanese sweets!

lines.content: 見慣れない女性が話しかけてくる。
lines.translated: An unfamiliar woman calls out to us.

lines.content: 城白祭では学生の出店だけでなく、外部から
lines.translated: At the Jouhaku Festival, it's not just student stalls --
\nthere are also vendors who come from outside.

lines.content: 業者さんはいろんな地域や地方から来ており、
lines.translated: These vendors come from all kinds of regions and areas,

lines.content: \n地域の名物や名産品を勧めてくれる。
lines.translated: \nand they recommend local specialties and products.

lines.content: この人も、そんな中の一人なのだろう。
lines.translated: She must be one of them.

lines.content: 「はいーっ♪　和菓子のメッカの白鷺市に
lines.translated: "Yes indeed♪ We've come to test our mettle in Shirasagi City,

lines.content: \n胸を借りにきたんですよー」
「それじゃ、遠くから来たんですね」
lines.translated: "So you've come from far away, then."

lines.content: 「新幹線も高速道路もあるから、
lines.translated: "With the bullet train and the highway,

lines.content: \nぴゅーんっとひとっ飛びです！」
lines.translated: \nit's just a quick zip over here!"

lines.content: とても元気のいい店員さんだ。
\n思わず姉さんと顔を見合わせ、頬が緩んでしまう。
lines.translated: \nSis and I can't help but exchange a glance, both of us smiling.

lines.content: 見た目は俺たちより年下に見えるけど、
lines.translated: She looks younger than us at first glance, but

lines.content: \n業者さんということは、歳上なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nbeing a vendor, she might actually be older.

lines.content: 「それじゃ、ここは俺が出すよ」
遠慮というより『お姉ちゃん』的に出したいんだろう。
lines.translated: She's probably less about being modest and more about wanting to treat me like a big sister would.

lines.content: とはいえ、姉さんが『いつもと違う』のなら、
lines.translated: But if Sis is being "different than usual" today,

lines.content: \n俺だって今まで通りの扱いをされたくない。
lines.translated: \nthen I don't want to be treated the same as always either.

lines.content: 「次は、姉さんに出してもらうよ、ちょっと高いのを」
lines.translated: "Next time, you're treating me -- to something a little pricey."

lines.content: 「ふふ……なるほど。わかった。ごちそうさま」\@
lines.translated: "Fufu... fair enough. Alright. Thanks for the treat."\@

lines.content: 財布を出そうと、繋いだ手を離す――
lines.translated: I let go of her hand to reach for my wallet --

lines.content: 姉さんがギュッと握り直してくる。\@
lines.translated: Sis tightens her grip on my hand.\@

lines.content: 「えっと……ほら、この時間はずっと手、
lines.translated: "Um... well, I just... want to keep holding hands
\nthe whole time we're here... is that... okay?"

lines.content: 片手で財布を出し、お金を渡す。
lines.translated: I pull out my wallet with one hand and pay.

lines.content: 俺が財布をしまったところで、店員さんが
lines.translated: Once I put my wallet away, the clerk

lines.content: 「素敵なカップルさんですね♪　文化祭いっぱい
lines.translated: "What a lovely couple♪ Enjoy the festival

lines.content: 学内の人なら俺と姉さんのことは知っているから、
lines.translated: Anyone from school would know who Sis and I are,

lines.content: \n『カップル』なんて思うことはない。
lines.translated: \nso they'd never think of us as a "couple."

lines.content: でも、何も知らない人から見ると
lines.translated: But to someone who doesn't know anything about us,

lines.content: \n『カップル』に見えるということ。
嬉しいやら照れくさいやら。
lines.translated: Part of me is happy, part of me is embarrassed.

lines.content: 二人でその場を離れる。
lines.translated: The two of us walk away.
We look at each other and laugh.

lines.content: 『カップルだって！』と言いたい気もしたが、
lines.translated: I almost said "She called us a couple!" out loud, but

lines.content: \n口にすると何かが崩れそうなので、黙って大福を食べる。
lines.translated: \nit felt like saying it would break the spell, so I just quietly eat my daifuku.

lines.content: 「うん、王道な感じだけど……美味い」
lines.translated: "Yeah, it's pretty classic, but... it's really good."

lines.content: 衝撃的な美味しさと言うより、いつでも食べたい美味しさだ。
lines.translated: It's not a shocking kind of delicious -- more like the kind you'd want to eat any time.

lines.content: 「あっ、どこのお店か聞いておけばよかったね」
lines.translated: "Oh, we should have asked which shop they're from."

lines.content: 胸を借りにきたなんて言ってたけど、
lines.translated: She said she came here to test her mettle,

lines.content: \nこの辺りの和菓子に負けずとも劣らない味だ。
lines.translated: \nbut this is every bit as good as the local sweets around here.
"Want some of mine? The matcha one?"

lines.content: 提案したものの、手を握ってるのでちぎることができない。
lines.translated: I suggested it, but since we're holding hands, I can't break off a piece.

lines.content: 考えていたら、おずおずと姉さんが差し出した。
lines.translated: While I was thinking about it, Sis hesitantly held hers out to me.

lines.content: 言われるまま食べる……甘い。
lines.translated: I eat it as told... it's sweet.

lines.content: \nけど、味がよくわからなくなる。
lines.translated: \nBut somehow I can't quite register the taste.

lines.content: 俺も差し出せば、姉さんもひと口。
lines.translated: I hold mine out, and Sis takes a bite.

lines.content: 姉さんも同じ気分なんだろうか。
lines.translated: I wonder if Sis feels the same way I do.

lines.content: いつもやっていたことだけど、今はすごく気恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: It's something we've always done, but right now it feels incredibly embarrassing.

lines.content: \nでも、なんだか楽しくて繋いだ手に力を込めた。
lines.translated: \nStill, it's somehow fun, and I squeezed her hand a little tighter.

lines.content: 校舎の中に入ってみれば、こちらも盛況だ。
lines.translated: Stepping inside the school building, it's just as lively in here.
"Two whole classrooms -- it's an epic production!!"

lines.content: 吸血鬼とジャック・オー・ランタンの格好をした学生が
lines.translated: Students dressed as a vampire and a jack-o'-lantern

lines.content: 「ふぇっ？　あ、ここって……もしかして」
lines.translated: "Feh!? Oh, this place... could it be..."

lines.content: 一瞬、姉さんは身を[強張/こわば]らせたが、
lines.translated: For a moment, Sis tensed up,

lines.content: \n『扮装』程度なので、すぐ落ち着きを取り戻した。
lines.translated: \nbut since it's just "costumes," she quickly settled down.

lines.content: 握った手に力が込もる。
lines.translated: The hand I'm holding tightens its grip.

lines.content: 玲が頑張っている姿を『姉』として見たいのだろうが、
lines.translated: She probably wants to see Rei doing her best as an "older sister,"

lines.content: \n『お化け屋敷』は間違いなく苦手な部類だ。
lines.translated: \nbut haunted houses are definitely in her list of things she can't handle.

lines.content: 「姉さんは待っててくれてもいいよ」
lines.translated: "You can wait out here if you want, sis."

lines.content: 「玲ちゃんが頑張ってるの、見たいもの！」
lines.translated: "I want to see Rei-chan working hard!"

lines.content: 『お姉ちゃん』としての矜持が勝ったらしい。
lines.translated: Her pride as a big sister won out, it seems.

lines.content: 二人でお化け屋敷へ入っていく。
lines.translated: The two of us head into the haunted house.

lines.content: \nもちろん、手はしっかり握り合ったままだ。
lines.translated: \nOf course, we keep our hands firmly clasped together.

lines.content: お化け屋敷の中に入ると細い道が奥へ伸びている。
lines.translated: Inside the haunted house, a narrow path stretches deep into the darkness.

lines.content: \n洋館の廊下をイメージしているのだろうか。
lines.translated: \nI wonder if they were going for the feel of a Western mansion hallway.

lines.content: 「また、腰抜かしちゃったらおんぶしてね」
lines.translated: "If my legs give out again, you'll carry me on your back, right?"

lines.content: 一応、軽口を叩くぐらいの余裕はまだあるらしい。
lines.translated: She still has enough composure to crack a light joke, at least.

lines.content: 俺が半歩前に出て、姉さんの手を引きながら歩く。
lines.translated: I step half a pace ahead and walk while leading Sis by the hand.

lines.content: どうやら、迷路のような形になっているらしいが――
lines.translated: It seems to be laid out like a maze, but--

lines.content: 急に目の前に手が飛びでてくる。
lines.translated: Suddenly a hand shoots out right in front of us.

lines.content: すぐに引っ込むが、もう一歩進めば。
lines.translated: It pulls back quickly, but one more step and--

lines.content: いくつもの手が、出ては引っ込んでいく。
lines.translated: Hands keep popping out and pulling back, one after another.

lines.content: 姉さんが俺の腕にすがりつく。
腕に胸が押し付けられる。
lines.translated: Her chest presses against my arm.

lines.content: 驚いた女の子が抱きつく――お化け屋敷の醍醐味と
lines.translated: A surprised girl throwing herself at you -- that might be what people call

lines.content: \n一般的にはいうのかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nthe real thrill of a haunted house.

lines.content: ほんの少しだけど『良いかも』と思ってしまった。
lines.translated: Just a tiny bit, I thought, "this isn't so bad."

lines.content: さらに進むと、ドライアイスなのか、
lines.translated: As we go further, what must be dry ice sends

lines.content: \nモヤが足元をゆらゆらと通り過ぎる。
lines.translated: \nwisps of mist drifting past our feet.

lines.content: さらには、しゃがれた高笑いまで。
lines.translated: And then, a raspy, high-pitched cackle on top of it all.

lines.content: 身をこわばらせる姉さん。
胸がますます押し付けられる。
lines.translated: Her chest presses against me even more.

lines.content: やっぱり、すごく柔らかい。
「ま、まだ……このくらい……つ、つくりもの！　だし！」\@
lines.translated: "I-it's fine... something like this... i-it's all fake! So!"\@

lines.content: 声は裏返りかけていたが、必死にそう思い込んで
lines.translated: Her voice was on the verge of cracking, but she was desperately trying to convince herself
That side of her too... is cute.
She'd jump at a skeleton display.

lines.content: 急に動いたミイラにびっくりしたり。
lines.translated: Startle at a mummy that suddenly moved.

lines.content: ゾンビに悲鳴を上げたり。
……ここまで驚いてくれれば、作った人たちも
lines.translated: ...She was scared enough that the people who built this place

lines.content: \n本望に違いないというぐらい怖がる。
lines.translated: \nwould surely feel it was all worthwhile.

lines.content: 「はぁー……はぁー……１年生ながら……すごい気合、
lines.translated: "Haah... haah... for first-years, they really put some serious effort

lines.content: 外観も凝っていたが、内部も手作りながらしっかり作ってある。
lines.translated: The exterior was elaborate, but the interior was solidly built too, even if handmade.

lines.content: \nこのお化け屋敷なら玲がやる気になるのも納得だ。
lines.translated: \nWith a haunted house like this, it made sense that Rei would be motivated to join.

lines.content: 「そういえば、玲をまだ見てないね」
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, we still haven't seen Rei."

lines.content: 「あ、そうか……玲ちゃんなら怖くないのになぁ」
lines.translated: "Oh, right... if it's Rei-chan, at least she won't be scary..."

lines.content: 無意識なのだろうけど、抱きついた腕に力を込める。
lines.translated: She probably didn't realize it, but she tightened her grip on my arm.

lines.content: 暗がりで姉さんが見えない分、豊満で柔らかい感触だけが
lines.translated: Since I couldn't see my sister in the dark, the full, soft sensation pressing against me
\nwas all the more impossible to ignore.
(I need to think about something else...)

lines.content: 助平心を発揮しても、姉さんは嬉しくないだろう。
lines.translated: Sis wouldn't be happy if I let my dirty mind get the better of me.

lines.content: 「前と違って『怖い』ってこと、隠してないね」
lines.translated: "Unlike before, you're not hiding the fact that you're scared."

lines.content: 以前は『情けない』『弱いところを見せたくない』と
lines.translated: She used to say she felt "pathetic" and didn't want to show any weakness,

lines.content: \n言っていたのに、今は素直に怖がっている。
lines.translated: \nbut now she was being honest about being frightened.

lines.content: 「もう知られちゃったから、今さらでしょ」
lines.translated: "You already know, so it's a little late for that now."

lines.content: 無駄な虚勢を張っても意味がないと思ったようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed she'd decided there was no point putting up a needless front.

lines.content: ――２日目は一般開放日なので、父兄や
lines.translated: -- The second day is open to the public, so parents and

lines.translated: \ntourists visiting the castle ruins also come to the culture festival.

lines.content: 「はい、チョコバナナと、アプリコットですね！
lines.translated: "Here you go, one chocolate banana and one apricot!

lines.content: 「クリーム！　追加持ってきたよー！」

lines.translated: And so it went -- we were busy the whole time.

lines.content: おかげさまでクレープ屋は大盛況。
lines.translated: Thanks to that, the crepe stand was a huge hit.

lines.content: 「はーいこちらに、並んでくださいねー！」
lines.translated: "Right this way, please line up here!"

lines.content: 好評で売り切れになるメニューも
lines.translated: Some menu items were so popular they

lines.content: １４時を過ぎたところで、俺は休憩に入らせてもらう。
lines.translated: Once it was past 2 PM, I was finally allowed to take a break.

lines.content: 家庭科部……行ってみようかな。
lines.translated: The home ec club... maybe I'll go check it out.

lines.content: 家庭科室の近くまで行けば、長蛇の列。
lines.translated: When I got close to the home ec room, there was a massive line.

lines.content: 「おっつかれー！　ごめんねー」
lines.translated: "Hey, good work out there! Sorry about this!"

lines.content: 俺を見つけた副部長が声をかけてくる。
lines.translated: The vice president spotted me and called out.

lines.translated: Maybe because of Higoromotei's help, the vice president was also wearing

lines.content: 「いえ、盛況なようで何よりです」
lines.translated: "Not at all -- looks like things are going great."

lines.content: 「ありがたいけどねぇ……予想以上でてんやわんやよ」
lines.translated: "I'm grateful, but... it's way more than we expected and we're running around like crazy."

lines.translated: \nit looks like repeat customers and word of mouth brought a ton of people all at once."

lines.content: 「手が回ってないなら、手伝いましょうか？」
lines.translated: "If you're short on hands, want me to help out?"

lines.content: 「いいの？　あたしは遠慮しないし、
lines.translated: "You sure? I'm not the type to hold back --

lines.content: \n使えるものなら親でも使う女よ」
lines.translated: \nif something's useful, I'll use it, even if it's my own parents."

lines.content: 「わかってますよ。それに待ちぼうけでも
lines.translated: "I know. Besides, standing around with nothing to do

lines.content: 「じゃ、よろしくー。はーい、ちょっと通して下さーい！」
lines.translated: "Then I'm counting on you! Okay, excuse us, coming through!"

lines.content: 副部長が道を空けてくれるので、俺も後に続いた。
lines.translated: The vice president cleared a path, and I followed along behind her.

lines.content: 「援軍？　助かるー！　ありがと――\@

lines.translated: "Lend me an apron. I'll help out."
"But is your class okay with this?"

lines.content: 「シロシロの終わりまで自由時間だから、問題なし」
lines.translated: "I've got free time until Shiroshiro wraps up, so no problem."

lines.content: この忙しさに、姉さんも遠慮は無用と判断したようだ。
lines.translated: Given how hectic things were, it seemed Chitose decided there was no need to hold back.

lines.content: 渡されたのは、緋衣亭の男性用制服。
lines.translated: What she handed me was a Higoromotei male staff uniform.
"...Why do you have one of these?"

lines.content: 「男装したいって子もいるから、予備を持ってきたの」
lines.translated: "Some girls want to cross-dress, so I brought a spare."

lines.content: 実に文化祭らしい理由だった。
lines.translated: That was a very culture-festival kind of reason.

lines.content: 「着替えたら、お菓子や飲み物を出す側に入ってもらえる？」
lines.translated: "Once you're changed, can you come help on the side serving the sweets and drinks?"
"Got it. With this, we'll be unstoppable."

lines.content: 着替えて黒板前に作られた提供エリアに入る。

lines.content: \n場所は違えど、やることは普段のカウンターと同じだ。
lines.translated: \nThe location was different, but the work itself was the same as behind the counter back home.

lines.content: 姉さんが渡してくれたのは、提供する商品の値段表。
lines.translated: What Chitose handed me was a price list for the items we were serving.

lines.content: \nこれを参考にすれば計算もしやすい。
lines.translated: \nHaving this as a reference would make calculating totals a lot easier.

lines.content: 「１番テーブルのショートケーキと、ミルクレープ、

lines.translated: "Table five's black tea and iced coffee, coming right up."

lines.translated: "Okay, that's your bill... including the souvenir cookies,

lines.translated: It's quite interesting how the same outfit can leave such a different impression

She turns her face toward me.

笑顔にはほど遠い、悩み顔になってしまった。

lines.content: 「楽しい時って笑うだろ？　笑わないまでも

lines.translated: \nyour expression will naturally become more relaxed."

lines.translated: "What is it that I find fun?"

俺が答えるより先に、姉さんが帰ってきた。

着替えた姉さんが、早速フロアをチェック。

lines.content: お待たせしました、こちらへどうぞ」
lines.translated: Sorry to keep you waiting -- right this way."

lines.content: \n席に座ったらすぐに注文をくれた。
lines.translated: \nThey placed their order as soon as they sat down.

\nthe table where her customers were seated.

驚いたのは俺と姉さんだけじゃない。
lines.translated: It wasn't just Sis and me who were surprised.

lines.content: その姿を、お客さんたちが引き込まれるように見つめている。
lines.translated: The customers watched her, completely drawn in.

lines.content: いや……お客さんだけじゃない。
lines.translated: No... it wasn't just the customers.

lines.content: \n俺たちも玲から視線を外せない。

lines.content: 「ケーキセットを２つ。モンブランにはブレンド。
lines.translated: "Two cake sets. The Mont Blanc comes with a blend,

lines.translated: \nand the cheese tart with jasmine tea."

lines.translated: \nto wait for the ordered sets to be ready.

姉さんと俺の注目点はややズレていたけど、
lines.translated: Sis and I were focused on slightly different things,

lines.translated: \nbut we were both equally surprised by that smile.

lines.content: 秋も深まり、布団の暖かさがありがたくなり始める時期だ。

lines.content: まどろみに浸っていたい気持ちになるが、
lines.translated: I wanted to stay lost in that drowsy haze,

lines.content: \nまぶたに感じる明るさが朝を告げている。

I forced my heavy eyelids open--

lines.content: 眠気なんて一気に吹っ飛んだ。
lines.translated: Any trace of sleepiness vanished in an instant.

lines.content: 玲は普段どおり、クールな調子で挨拶してくる。

lines.content: 俺の言葉に玲が小さく頷くと、そのまま外へと出ていく。
lines.translated: Rei gave a small nod at my words, then headed outside just like that.
Was she trying to wake me up?

lines.content: \n俺に声をかけた様子はなかったけど。

lines.content: \n普通は緊張しそうなものだが、玲はいつもの調子だ。
lines.translated: \nNormally that would be nerve-wracking, but Rei was as composed as ever.

lines.content: 急な申し出に、ただ頷くしかない。
lines.translated: All I could do was nod at the sudden invitation.

lines.content: 口には出してなかったが、言外に言ったのはわかった。
lines.translated: She hadn't said it out loud, but I understood what she meant without words.

lines.content: 玲がスタスタと去っていく。
lines.translated: Rei walked away at a brisk, steady pace.

lines.content: 涼やかで落ち着いた様子なのに。
lines.translated: She was so cool and unhurried about it, and yet--

lines.content: そう言ってしまえそうなほど、鮮烈な後ろ姿だった。
lines.translated: That was the only word for it -- her retreating figure left a striking impression.

lines.content: 「タイの色１年だよな……１年なのか、アレ」
lines.translated: "Her tie's the first-year color, right...? She's really a first-year?"

lines.content: あの態度だと先輩だと思ってもおかしくない。
lines.translated: With that attitude, it wouldn't be strange to mistake her for an upperclassman.

lines.content: 「イトコ！？　あんな従妹が学園にいるなんて初耳だぞ！」
lines.translated: "Your COUSIN!? This is the first I'm hearing that you have a cousin like that at this school!"

lines.content: 「はー……言われてみれば、君と似てる気もするね」
lines.translated: "Hm... now that you mention it, I can kind of see the resemblance."

lines.content: 「ごめん。待たせてるし、詳しいことは後で話すよ」
lines.translated: "Sorry. I'm keeping her waiting, so I'll fill you in later."
"I'll be looking forward to hearing about it."

lines.content: 興味津々な様子だったけど、ちゃんと
lines.translated: They were clearly dying to know more, but I was grateful

lines.translated: \nthat my friends still respected my wishes.

"Well then, I'll take you up on that."

lines.content: 隣に座る。一畳分しかないので、かなり近い。

lines.translated: "No, it's just -- you invited me to lunch so suddenly,

lines.content: 「ああ、突然でしたのでご迷惑でしたか？」\@

嬉しさを覚えながら、俺も弁当を食べ始める。

\nIt felt similar to the way she'd been looking at me this morning.
"Do I have something on my face?"

lines.translated: "Eyes, a nose, a mouth... it's your face, Nii-san.
\nI'm looking because I want to look at your face."

lines.translated: It was a simple, straightforward reason,
\nbut coming from Rei, it was still surprising.
Why would she want to look at my face...?

lines.translated: \nBut she was here eating with me now, so she must have meant it.

lines.translated: \nHer hair hid them, but Rei's eyes held a sharp, strong-willed light.

lines.content: \n俺は、焼きの担当でせっせとクレープを焼く。
lines.translated: \nI was on cooking duty, busily grilling crepes one after another.

lines.content: 「クレープ、いかがでしょうかー！」
「美味しいですよー！　寄ってってくださーい！」
黒姫さんや他のクラスメートたちが看板を掲げて、
lines.translated: Kurohime-san and the other classmates were holding up signs,

lines.content: こちらもせっせとクレープの準備だ。
lines.translated: I kept myself busy prepping crepes on my end.

lines.content: 「ありがとうございまーす！　１名さま来ましたよー」
lines.translated: "Thank you very much~! One customer coming your way~!"

lines.content: 「いらっしゃいませー、何にいたしましょう」
lines.translated: "Welcome~, what can I get for you?"

lines.content: 黒姫さんがお客さんを連れてくるので、こちらも誘導。
lines.translated: Kurohime-san was bringing customers over, so I guided them along too.

lines.content: 「す、すみませーん！　こちらに一列で並んでくださーい！」\@
lines.translated: "E-excuse me~! Please line up in a single file here~!"\@

lines.content: 列ができると、歩いてる人たちの目にもとまりやすくなり、
lines.translated: Once a line formed, it caught the eye of people passing by,

lines.content: そのため一気に人が並んで列が長くなっていく。
lines.translated: Because of that, people started lining up all at once and the queue grew long.

lines.content: 「おーい、ストック足りなくなってるぞー！」
「もうちょっと待ってくれー！　焼いてるからー！」
lines.translated: "Just a little longer~! I'm still cooking~!"

lines.content: \nでも、ダッシュで行ってきてくれ！」
そのおかげもあって出だしから、好評だ。
lines.translated: Thanks to all that, we were off to a great start right from the beginning.

lines.content: 「おつかれさま。交代の時間だから休憩行ってきたら？」
lines.translated: "Good work. It's time for your break -- why don't you head out and rest?"

lines.content: 先に休憩していたフッチーと交代するように
lines.translated: I stepped out of the tent to swap with Futchi,

lines.content: 「黒姫さーん、トッピングお願い！」
「おお～……なかなか良い手さばき……♪」
lines.translated: "Ooh~... she's got some pretty nice technique... ♪"

lines.content: ふと黒姫さんを見れば、クラスメートたちとわいわい
lines.translated: I glanced over at Kurohime-san and saw her cheerfully

lines.content: \nクレープ屋を切り盛りしている。
lines.translated: \nrunning the crepe stand together with our classmates.

lines.content: 中間テストの前に、黒姫さんは勉強ができないことを
lines.translated: Before the midterm exams, Kurohime-san had honestly told everyone

lines.content: そのおかげか、より親しみやすい子として
lines.translated: Maybe because of that, she seemed to have grown closer to everyone

lines.content: \n皆と仲良くなっているようだ。
lines.translated: \nas someone more easy to relate to.

lines.content: （すっかり黒姫さん、馴染んだなぁ……）
lines.translated: (She's really settled in, hasn't she, Kurohime-san...)

lines.content: パンフレットを見ながら、玲のクラスの
lines.translated: I checked the pamphlet and headed toward

lines.content: 外を見ただけでもわかるが、かなり大規模なものだ。
lines.translated: Even just from the outside, you could tell it was quite a large-scale setup.

lines.content: 隣り合った教室同士を、ベニヤ板の壁で繋げてある。
lines.translated: Two adjacent classrooms had been connected with plywood walls.

lines.content: \n教室を２つ使ったお化け屋敷のようだ。
lines.translated: \nIt looked like a haunted house using two classrooms.

lines.content: 吸血鬼に仮装した学生が、誘ってくる。
lines.translated: A student dressed as a vampire beckoned me over.

lines.content: 『おばけ役の玲』を見たいので、
lines.translated: I wanted to see "Rei in her ghost role,"

lines.content: \nさっそくお邪魔することにする。
lines.translated: \nso I decided to head right in.

lines.content: お化け屋敷に入ると、暗く細長い通路が出迎える。
lines.translated: Stepping inside the haunted house, a dark, narrow corridor greeted me.

lines.content: 洋館をイメージしているのか、なかなか凝った作りだ。
lines.translated: It seemed to be going for a Western mansion vibe -- quite an elaborate setup.
A hand shot out at me.

lines.content: 単純だが、ずっと静かだったから、かなり効果的だ。
lines.translated: Simple, but since it had been so quiet the whole time, it was pretty effective.

lines.content: 足元にも伸びてきた手をジャンプで避ける。
lines.translated: I jumped to dodge a hand reaching up from the floor.

lines.content: 上が来たら間髪入れず下も来る。
lines.translated: If something comes from above, something from below follows right after.

lines.content: 残念そうに虚空を彷徨う手に謝ってさらに奥へ。
lines.translated: I apologized to the hand as it wandered aimlessly through the air in disappointment, then moved deeper in.

lines.content: ゾンビが走ってきて、そのまま走って帰るを繰り返す。
lines.translated: A zombie came running at me, then turned around and ran back -- over and over.

lines.content: 最近のゾンビは走るんだな……。
さらに移動すれば、ジャック・オー・ランタンやら、
lines.translated: Moving further along, there were jack-o'-lanterns,
\nand a vampire with wings spread wide.

lines.content: 人魂なんかも浮かんでくる。
１年生というだけでなく、学生が作っているというものとして
lines.translated: Not just for first-years, but even considering

lines.content: \n考えても、かなりしっかりした作りだ。
lines.translated: \nthat students made this, it was seriously well put together.

lines.content: 怖さよりも感心してしまう。
lines.translated: I was more impressed than scared.

lines.content: 今まであった“おばけ”たちの中に玲はいなかった。
lines.translated: Rei wasn't among any of the "ghosts" I'd seen so far.

lines.content: ベニヤ板で作った細い通路を使って隣の教室へと向かえば、
lines.translated: Following the narrow plywood corridor into the adjacent classroom,

lines.content: \n今までと打って変わってひらけていた。
lines.translated: \nit suddenly opened up into a wide space.

lines.content: 墓が並んでおりその奥に井戸がある。
lines.translated: Gravestones were lined up, with a well sitting beyond them.

lines.content: へぇ……この場所は今までの細い通路にあった
lines.translated: Huh... this place had a different feel from the eerie,

lines.content: \nおどろおどろしさとは違った寂寥感があるな。
lines.translated: \nclaustrophobic atmosphere of the narrow corridor before -- more of a lonely desolation.

lines.content: 急にピアノの音が鳴り、その不協和音に立ち止まる。\@
lines.translated: A piano suddenly rang out, and I stopped in my tracks at the dissonant notes.\@

lines.content: 鳴り終わると、また静かになる。
今の……井戸から聞こえた？
lines.translated: Just now... did that come from the well?

lines.content: （ピアノってことは……もしかして、玲？）
井戸を注視していると、長い黒髪で顔を隠した女の幽霊が
lines.translated: As I stared at the well, a female ghost with long black hair covering her face

lines.content: 死装束を身にまとった姿はまさしく『おばけ』だ。
lines.translated: Dressed in burial white, she looked every bit the part of a "ghost."

lines.content: 髪の隙間から覗く鋭い眼光が、俺を射抜く。
lines.translated: A sharp, piercing gaze cut through the gaps in her hair and fixed on me.

lines.content: 怖さよりも、シュールな状況に立ち尽くす。
lines.translated: I stood frozen -- not so much from fear as from the sheer surreal absurdity of it all.

lines.content: もしかして……『一枚足りないうらめしや』の怪談
lines.translated: Could she be referencing the ghost story about a missing plate --

lines.content: \n――『皿屋敷』を意識しているんだろうか。
「――七枚……音が足りない、うらめしや」
lines.translated: "-- Seven... not enough notes. Woe is me..."

lines.content: 「ドレミファソラシ……ああ、そうか」
lines.translated: "Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti... oh, I see."

lines.content: 指折り数えて思わず納得。
lines.translated: I counted on my fingers and couldn't help but nod in understanding.

lines.content: 『皿屋敷』は『十枚あるはずの皿が一枚足りないことを
lines.translated: "Sarayashiki" is the tale of a ghost who laments that one of ten plates

lines.content: \nうらめしいと嘆く幽霊』の話だ。
ドレミファソラシだと、７枚止まりでぜんぜん足りない。
lines.translated: With do-re-mi-fa-sol-la-ti, you stop at 7 -- nowhere near enough.

lines.content: 「……もうちょっと怖がって良いんですよ」
lines.translated: "...You could stand to be a little more scared, you know."

lines.content: 俺の反応に、玲が素の声を出す。
lines.translated: My reaction prompted Rei to drop her act and speak in her normal voice.

lines.content: 「怖いと言うより……まぁ、怖いか」
lines.translated: "Scared might not be the right word... well, I guess it is scary."

lines.content: とはいえシュールな方向での怖さだが。
lines.translated: Just in a surreal kind of way, though.

lines.content: 「今までのお客さんは、顔を出しただけで、
lines.translated: "The other customers who came through got pretty scared

lines.content: \nけっこう怖がってくれたんですけどね」
lines.translated: \njust from me showing my face, though."

lines.content: 急に髪で顔を隠した死装束の女が井戸から出れば、
lines.translated: I suppose if a woman in burial whites suddenly emerged from a well\nwith her face hidden behind her hair,

lines.content: \n確かに怖いかもしれないが……。
「俺は玲だってすぐにわかっちゃったからな」
lines.translated: "I figured out it was you right away, Rei."

lines.content: 「薄幸さが出ていると言うか、儚げな雰囲気が出て綺麗だ」
lines.translated: "It brings out a kind of tragic fragility -- you look beautiful with that ephemeral air about you."

lines.content: 髪の隙間から、じっと見つめられる。
lines.translated: She stared at me through the gaps in her hair.

lines.content: \nいつもの鋭さは消えているように思えた。
lines.translated: \nThe usual sharpness in her eyes seemed to have faded.

lines.content: 物寂しい曲を奏でながら、玲が井戸の中に戻っていく。
lines.translated: Playing a lonely, melancholic melody, Rei retreated back into the well.

lines.content: 「……演目は終わりなので、先へどうぞ」
lines.translated: "...The performance is over, so please move along."

lines.content: もう少し見ていたかったが、後の人もいるだろうし、
lines.translated: I wanted to watch a little longer, but there were others behind me,
\nso I had no choice but to move on.

lines.content: 「……『綺麗』だなんて、急に言うのは良くないと思います」
lines.translated: "...I don't think it's a good idea to suddenly say things like 'beautiful.'"

lines.content: 「お疲れさまです。怖かったでしょう？」
lines.translated: "Good work out there. Scary, wasn't it?"

lines.content: 外へと出れば、客引きした学生が聞いてくる。
lines.translated: As I stepped outside, the student who had been calling in customers asked me.

lines.content: 「なかなか味のあるお化け屋敷だったよ」
lines.translated: "It was quite a haunted house -- had its own unique charm."

lines.content: そのまま玲を待つため、廊下の隅に移動しつつ、
lines.translated: I moved to a corner of the hallway to wait for Rei,

lines.content: \n先ほどの『おばけ』姿の玲を思い出す。
lines.translated: \nrecalling the image of her in that "ghost" costume from moments ago.

lines.content: ふと思い出す、雨に濡れた玲。
lines.translated: My mind drifted to the memory of Rei, soaked in the rain.

lines.content: 触れた肌の感触や、濡れて艷やかだった髪。
lines.translated: The feel of her skin when I touched her, and her hair -- wet and lustrous.

lines.content: \nそんな彼女とかぶったからだろうか。
lines.translated: \nMaybe it was because she overlapped with that image of her.

lines.content: 思わず『綺麗』と伝えてしまった。
lines.translated: I'd let slip the word "beautiful" without even thinking.

lines.content: 「……俺ももう少し、素直になっていいのかもな」
lines.translated: "...Maybe I'm allowed to be a little more honest with myself."

lines.content: 制服姿に着替えた玲がやってくる。
lines.translated: Rei came over, having changed back into her uniform.

lines.content: 「幽霊姿の方が良かったですか？」
lines.translated: "Would you have preferred the ghost look?"

lines.content: \n動きやすさなら制服の方かな」
lines.translated: \nbut for ease of movement, the uniform wins."

lines.content: 視線をそらした玲は、照れているようだ。
lines.translated: Rei looked away -- she seemed embarrassed.

lines.content: ……この反応を見られるのなら『素直』はありだな。
lines.translated: ...If I get to see reactions like that, being honest with myself isn't so bad.

lines.content: 「どこか行きたいところあるか？」
lines.translated: "Is there anywhere you want to go?"

lines.content: 「お腹が空きました。焼きそば食べたいです」
lines.translated: "I'm hungry. I want to eat yakisoba."

lines.content: 「了解。焼きそばなら中庭にあったな」
lines.translated: "Got it. There was a yakisoba stand in the courtyard."

lines.content: 中庭にて、焼きそばを購入。
lines.translated: We headed to the courtyard and bought yakisoba.

lines.content: 「バイト代が入ったので、私が出します」
lines.translated: "I got my pay from work, so let me cover it."

lines.content: 「玲は玲の欲しいものを買えばいい。
lines.translated: "You should spend that on things you want, Rei.

lines.content: \nそのためのバイトなんだし」
「ですので、兄さんへのお礼に使います。
lines.translated: "That's exactly why I'm using it to treat you, Nii-san.

lines.content: 素直な言葉が嬉しくも照れくさい。
lines.translated: Her straightforward words made me happy, but also a little flustered.

lines.content: 「それじゃ、買うのは交代交代にしよう。

lines.translated: \nI want to treat you to things too."

lines.content: 「一緒に生活してくれたり、緋衣亭で頑張ってくれたり、
lines.translated: "For living with me, for working hard at Higoromotei,

lines.content: \n屋上の秘密を教えてくれたり、色々のお礼だ」
lines.translated: \nfor showing me the secret on the rooftop -- all of that."

lines.content: 「どれも私がお世話になったことばかりです」
lines.translated: "Every one of those things is something I benefited from."

lines.content: 「けど買う時、一緒に払った方が手間がかからないから
lines.translated: "But it's less hassle if we just split it when we buy things,

lines.content: 俺の意図を察してくれたのか、それともあまり断っても
lines.translated: Whether she picked up on my real intention, or just decided

lines.content: \n良くないと思ったのか、玲も頷いてくれた。
lines.translated: \nthat pushing back too much wasn't worth it, Rei gave a nod.

lines.content: 近くのベンチに腰を下ろして、焼きそばを食べる。
lines.translated: We sat down on a nearby bench and ate our yakisoba.

lines.content: 「はむ……はむ……うん、ソースの味で
\nごまかされていい感じです」\@
lines.translated: \njust kind of covers everything up in the best way."\@
"You like that just-right junk food feeling?"

lines.content: 「ええ、お祭り感がありますよね」
lines.translated: "Yes, it has that festival atmosphere to it."

lines.content: 「美味しいというより、こう……不思議な味わいがあるよな」
lines.translated: "It's less about being delicious and more like... it has this strange appeal to it."

lines.content: なんと言えば良いのか、ソースの味が強くて、
lines.translated: I wasn't sure how to put it -- the sauce flavor is strong,

lines.content: \n美味しいわけじゃないけど『いい感じ』だ。
lines.translated: \nit's not exactly delicious, but it just feels right.

lines.content: 焼きそばを啜るというより、はむはむと、
lines.translated: Rather than slurping the yakisoba, Rei ate slowly,

lines.content: \nゆっくり食べつつ玲が中庭を見る。
lines.translated: \ntaking small bites while gazing out at the courtyard.

lines.content: 露天が並んだ中庭は普段の静かな雰囲気は欠片もなく
lines.translated: The courtyard, lined with food stalls, had none of its usual quiet atmosphere --

lines.content: 玲は、騒がしいところでも興味があれば問題ない。
lines.translated: Rei was fine even in noisy places, as long as something caught her interest.
\nShe was enjoying herself in her own way.

lines.content: 「こんにちはー。しょっぱいものの後には甘い物、
lines.translated: "Hello there~ After something salty, how about

lines.content: 食べ終わったところで、黒姫さんが声を掛けてくる。
lines.translated: Just as we finished eating, Kurohime-san called out to us.

lines.content: \nこの時間も呼び込み係らしい。
lines.translated: \nIt seems she's on crowd-calling duty during this time slot too.
"That's what she said. What do you want to do, Rei?"

lines.content: 「いいですね。いただきます。兄さんもお化け屋敷に
lines.translated: "That sounds nice. I'll take one. You came to our haunted house,

lines.content: \n来たんですから、私も兄さんのクラスにお返しします」
lines.translated: \nso let me return the favor by visiting your class's stall."

lines.content: 「蔦町先輩監修ですから、味に自信ありですよ」
lines.translated: "It's supervised by Tsutamachi-senpai, so we're confident in the taste."

lines.content: クレープ屋のテントに移動する。
lines.translated: We moved over to the crepe stand tent.

lines.content: 「おっ、なんだご両人、従兄妹同士で仲のいいこった」
lines.translated: "Oh, look at you two -- cousins getting along so well."

lines.content: 「はいよーっと。焼いてるところだから、
lines.translated: "Coming right up. I'm in the middle of cooking one,

lines.content: \n少し時間かかるけどいいか？」
lines.translated: \nso it'll take a little while -- that okay?"

lines.content: 「玲。好きなの選んで。払うのは俺の番だ」
lines.translated: "Rei. Pick whatever you want. It's my turn to pay."

lines.content: 「わかりました……では、王道のチョコバナナを」
lines.translated: "Understood... In that case, the classic chocolate banana."

lines.content: 「それじゃ、俺は……抹茶あずきクリーム」
lines.translated: "Then I'll have... matcha red bean cream."

lines.content: さっそくホーセンが焼き始めてくれる。
lines.translated: Hosen gets right to work cooking them.

lines.content: 興味があるのか、焼いているところを玲が眺めている。
lines.translated: Rei watches with interest as he cooks.

lines.content: 「くすっ、氷見山さん以前よりもずっと、
lines.translated: "Heh... Himiyama-san has become so much more

lines.content: \n穏やかな雰囲気になりましたね」
黒姫さんにお金を渡せば、そんなことを言われる。
lines.translated: When I hand Kurohime-san the money, she says something like that.

lines.content: 「ええ、お店で見た時は接客だから笑顔を見せたのかと
lines.translated: "Yes. When I saw her at the shop, I thought she was only smiling

lines.content: \n思いましたけど……今も笑ってます」
lines.translated: \nbecause it was customer service... but she's smiling now too."

lines.content: 「バイトが良い影響になったのかも」
lines.translated: "Maybe the part-time job has been a good influence."

lines.content: 「もうっ、バイトじゃないですよ」
「あなたの影響だと思います。いいですね。
lines.translated: "I think it's your influence. It's a wonderful thing,

lines.content: 玲を見つめながら、そんな優しい笑みを見せる。
lines.translated: She gives a gentle smile, gazing at Rei as she says it.

lines.content: ……その瞳に、寂しさみたいなものを感じたのは
lines.translated: Was it just my imagination, or did I sense something

lines.content: 玲がクレープを２つ、掲げている。
lines.translated: Rei is holding up two crepes.

lines.content: 黒姫さんにお礼を伝えて、玲からクレープを受け取る。
lines.translated: I thank Kurohime-san and take the crepe from Rei.

lines.content: 「それじゃ、もうちょっと回ってくるよ」
lines.translated: "Alright, we're going to walk around a bit more."

lines.content: 「おー、休憩なんだから行って来い行って来い」
lines.translated: "Sure, sure, go on, go on -- you're on break after all."

lines.content: 「はい、おふたりともシロシロ、楽しんで下さいね！」
lines.translated: "Yes, you two go on and enjoy yourselves!"

lines.content: 仲間たちに笑顔で見送られ、また玲と二人で歩き出す。
lines.translated: Seen off with smiles from our friends, Rei and I set off walking together again.

lines.content: 「クリームも生地もふわふわで、美味しいですね」
lines.translated: "The cream and the batter are both so fluffy -- it's delicious."

lines.content: 俺もひと口……うん、美味い。
lines.translated: I take a bite too... yeah, it's great.
\nJust as you'd expect from a recipe supervised by sis.

lines.content: 「しょっぱいものの後に甘いもの。
\nやはりこの順番は合理的です……」\@
lines.translated: \nThis order really is the most logical..."\@

lines.content: 玲も満足気に食べている。
lines.translated: Rei is eating with a satisfied look on her face.

lines.content: 「……そういえば玲の弾くピアノ、初めて聞いたな」
lines.translated: "...Come to think of it, that was the first time I heard you play piano."

lines.content: 「ちゃんと怖さも出てたし綺麗な音だったよ」
lines.translated: "You really nailed the eerie atmosphere, and the tone was beautiful."

lines.content: 「ピアノは誰が弾いても同じ音です。
lines.translated: "A piano sounds the same no matter who plays it.

lines.content: \nそれに大した演奏はしていません」
lines.translated: \nBesides, it wasn't much of a performance."

lines.content: そう言いつつクレープを頬張る玲は、
lines.translated: Even as she says that, Rei stuffs her cheeks with crepe,
\nand she looks happy, if I'm reading her right.

lines.content: 以前より、玲の感情を理解できるようになったことが嬉しい。
lines.translated: I'm glad that I've gotten better at understanding Rei's feelings compared to before.

lines.content: 俺の視線に気付いたのか玲が首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Maybe she noticed me staring, because Rei tilts her head.
"No, I was just wondering -- how's your crepe?"

lines.content: 「美味しいですよ。味、気になるんですか？」
lines.translated: "It's delicious. Are you curious about the taste?"

lines.content: 玲がクレープを差し出す。
lines.translated: Rei holds her crepe out toward me.
"Huh, doing the 'say ahh' thing between siblings is a bit..."

lines.content: 前に『姉さんしかしない』と伝えた――ということは。
lines.translated: I told her before that it was something only sis did -- which means.

lines.content: 「知ってます。私がしたいだけです。
lines.translated: "I know. I just want to do it myself.

lines.content: \n兄さんのクレープも味見したいですし」

lines.content: なのに、ポロポロと溢れる涙は止まらない。
lines.translated: But the tears keep spilling out, one after another, refusing to stop.

lines.content: 俺から目をそらすと、慌てたようにピアノを片付ける。
lines.translated: She averts her eyes from me and hurriedly starts packing up the piano.
And just like that, she's gone.

lines.content: 重い屋上の扉が、鈍く鳴り響く。
lines.translated: The heavy rooftop door shuts with a dull, echoing thud.

lines.content: でも、俺は足に根が生えたように動けない。
lines.translated: But I can't move -- it's as if my feet have taken root in the ground.

lines.content: 玲がどうして泣いたのか。
拒絶なのか、他の感情なのか。
lines.translated: Was it rejection? Or some other emotion entirely?

lines.content: わからない――わからない。
lines.translated: I don't know -- I just don't know.

lines.content: どうして良いかわからず、立ち尽くすしかできなかった。
lines.translated: Not knowing what to do, all I could do was stand there, frozen in place.

lines.content: 無事、赤点もなくパスしたので、
lines.translated: I passed without any failing grades,

lines.content: \nいよいよ文化祭の準備が本格化する。
lines.translated: \nso preparations for the culture festival were finally kicking into high gear.

lines.content: １１月頭にある文化祭まであと２週間ほど。
lines.translated: There were about two weeks left until the culture festival at the start of November.

lines.content: 放課後になるとクラスメートたちが残って、
\nテントにつける装飾や看板を作り始める。
lines.translated: \nand started making decorations and signs for the booth.

lines.content: 今日は渉外の仕事があるけど、
lines.translated: I had some liaison work to take care of today,

lines.content: \n俺も時間まで看板作りの手伝いをする。
lines.translated: \nbut I helped out with the sign-making until it was time to go.
"Wow, Kurohime-san, your handwriting is so pretty!"

lines.content: 「昔、習字をやってましたので」
「いいねぇ！　それ終わったら、こっちもお願いできる？」
lines.translated: "Nice! When you're done with that, could you do this one too?"

lines.content: 黒姫さんもメニュー表作りの手伝いをしている。
lines.translated: Kurohime-san was helping out with making the menu boards too.

lines.content: 楽しげにクラスメートたちと話しながら、作業に勤しむ。
lines.translated: She chatted cheerfully with our classmates as she worked away.

lines.content: 積極的な……いつも通りの黒姫さんだ。
lines.translated: Outgoing, sociable -- the same Kurohime-san as always.

lines.content: 中間テストの前に『何もない』と言った黒姫さんからは
lines.translated: It was hard to imagine this was the same Kurohime-san who had said "there was nothing"

lines.content: テスト週間に入ってしまったために、
lines.translated: With the exam period coming right after,
\nthe whole thing had become kind of hazy.

lines.content: あの時の黒姫さんは明らかに普段と違った。
lines.translated: Kurohime-san back then was clearly different from her usual self.

lines.content: だが、黒姫さんをどれだけ知っているのかと言えば、
lines.translated: But when it came to how well I actually knew her,
\nthe honest answer was -- barely at all.

lines.content: 新幹線で出会った少女。
lines.translated: A girl I met on the bullet train.

lines.content: 一期一会の出会いだと思った。
lines.translated: I thought it was a chance encounter, a one-time thing.

lines.content: でも、偶然に再会してクラスメートになった。
lines.translated: But we ran into each other again by coincidence and ended up as classmates.

lines.content: コーヒーをごちそうしたり文化祭の交渉へ行ったり、
lines.translated: Treating her to coffee, going to negotiate for the culture festival together --

lines.content: \n短い時間ながら共に過ごしてきた。
lines.translated: \nwe'd spent time together, even if only briefly.

lines.content: 穏やかで優しく茶目っ気もある少女――
lines.translated: A calm, gentle girl with a playful streak --

lines.content: 俺の知る黒姫さんは、それだけ。
lines.translated: That was all I knew of Kurohime-san.

lines.content: （俺は彼女のことを、何も知らないんだ）
lines.translated: (I don't really know anything about her.)

lines.content: だとしたら『何もない』と言った黒姫さんは、
lines.translated: If that's the case, then the Kurohime-san who said "there was nothing"

lines.content: \n俺の知らない『黒姫さんの一面』なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: \nmight just be a side of her I've never seen before.

lines.content: 「なぁ、当日のシフト表の案を作ったけど、
lines.translated: "Hey, I put together a draft of the shift schedule for the day --

lines.content: 「俺は、空いたところに入れてくれればいいぞ」
lines.translated: "Just stick me wherever there's an opening, that works for me."

lines.content: 当日、クラスメートが持ち回りでクレープを焼いたり、
lines.translated: On the day of the festival, classmates would take turns making crepes

lines.content: \n呼び込みをしたりすることになっている。
「お、そいつはありがたい……っと、
\nこの後、打ち合わせだったっけ？」
lines.translated: \ndidn't you have a meeting after this?"

lines.content: 「ああ、そろそろ時間か。行くよ」
lines.translated: "Yeah, it's about that time. I'm heading out."

lines.content: きりの良いところまでやったら行こう。
lines.translated: I'd go once I reached a good stopping point.

lines.content: 「商店さんに行くんでしたら、わたしも行ったほうが
lines.translated: "If you're going to the shops, should I

lines.content: 会話を聞きつけたのか、黒姫さんが声を掛けてくる。
lines.translated: She must have overheard us -- Kurohime-san spoke up.

lines.content: 「今日はレンタル品についての相談だから大丈夫」
lines.translated: "Today's just about discussing the rental items, so you're fine."

lines.content: 見送られてタテマチへ向かった。
lines.translated: I headed off to Tatemachi as they saw me off.

lines.content: レンタル業者さんは、ながれ茶屋街の店と付き合いがあり、
lines.translated: The rental company had ties with the shops in Nagare Chayagai,
\nand we were going through that connection.

lines.content: 向こうからすれば子どもの頃から知っているので、
lines.translated: From their side, they'd known me since I was a kid,

lines.content: \n最近のことをあれこれと聞かれてしまった。
lines.translated: \nso they ended up asking me all sorts of questions about how things had been lately.

lines.content: 話し合い自体は、とてもうまく行ったのだから、
lines.translated: The meeting itself went really well,

lines.content: （早く戻って、作業の手伝いをしようと思ってたんだけどな）
lines.translated: (I was hoping to get back early and help out with the work.)

lines.content: 予想通り、教室へ向かう廊下は静かだった。
lines.translated: Just as I expected, the hallway leading to the classroom was quiet.

lines.content: \nどのクラスも、すでに帰ってしまったのだろう。
lines.translated: \nEvery class had probably already gone home.

lines.content: まだ文化祭まで時間はあるし、遅くまで残っているクラスは、
lines.translated: There's still time before the festival, and any class that stays too late

lines.content: \n文化祭実行委員会に目をつけられる。
だから、今の時期は早々に帰るクラスが多い。
lines.translated: So most classes tend to head home early at this point.

lines.content: （また、黒姫さんが寝てたりして……）
lines.translated: (Knowing my luck, Kurohime-san's probably asleep in there again...)

lines.content: この静かさに、そんなことを思いながら歩いていく。
lines.translated: I walked on, that thought drifting through my mind in the quiet.

lines.content: 教室の中から聞こえた声に、足を止める。
lines.translated: A voice from inside the classroom made me stop in my tracks.

lines.content: ウチの教室じゃなくて隣の教室だ。
lines.translated: Not our classroom -- the one next door.
Why would Kurohime-san be in there...?

lines.content: わずかにドアが開いているので、覗いてみれば、
lines.translated: The door was open just a crack, so I peeked inside --

lines.content: \n黒姫さんと、男子学生が向き合っている。
lines.translated: \nKurohime-san and a male student were facing each other.

lines.content: あいつは……隣のクラスのやつだったと思う。
lines.translated: That guy... I think he's from the class next door.
"What did you want to talk about?"

lines.content: 恋愛には疎いが、それでも一瞬でわかる雰囲気。
lines.translated: I'm not exactly well-versed in romance, but even I could read the atmosphere in an instant.

lines.content: 「黒姫さん、今、付き合ってるヤツっているのか？」
lines.translated: "Kurohime-san, are you seeing anyone right now?"

lines.content: 「え？　いいえ。引っ越してきたばかりですし」
lines.translated: "Hm? No. I only just moved here, after all."

lines.content: 緊張した男子学生の言葉とは裏腹に、
lines.translated: In contrast to the male student's nervous words,

lines.content: \n黒姫さんは、きょとんとしている。
もしかして黒姫さん、状況がわかってない……？
lines.translated: Does she... not realize what's going on here?

lines.content: 「あ……それなら、オレにもチャンスは有るのかな」
lines.translated: "Oh... then maybe I've got a shot."

lines.content: なかなか攻める言い方だ。
\n他人事ながら、緊張してくる。
lines.translated: \nEven as an outsider, I could feel the tension.

lines.content: もっと慌てたり、恥ずかしがるのかと思ったけど、
lines.translated: I thought she'd be more flustered or embarrassed, but

lines.content: 「わたしとあなたは、ほとんど面識ありませんよね？
lines.translated: "We barely know each other, you and I.

lines.content: 「まぁ……一目惚れっていうのもあるけど、廊下とかで
lines.translated: "Well... part of it is love at first sight, but I also saw you talking in the hallway and

lines.content: \n話してるの見て、すごく明るい子だなぁって思ったし」
lines.translated: \nthought you seemed like a really cheerful person."

lines.content: 「そっちのクラスのヤツも言ってたけど、
lines.translated: "Some people from your class mentioned it too --

lines.content: \n積極的に色々と手伝ってくれる優しい子って話だし」
lines.translated: \nthat you're a kind girl who's always eager to help out."

lines.content: 「黒姫さんのこと、もっと知りたくなったっていうか。
lines.translated: "I guess I just want to get to know you better, Kurohime-san.
\nSo... I want to go out with you."

lines.content: 黒姫さんに対する認識は間違っていない気がする。
lines.translated: His impression of Kurohime-san didn't seem wrong to me.

lines.content: \n彼の言う通り、明るく優しいいい子だ。
lines.translated: \nJust like he said, she's a bright, kind, wonderful girl.

lines.content: 告白する動機としては十分すぎる。
lines.translated: That's more than enough reason to confess to someone.

lines.content: 熱っぽい告白に対して、黒姫さんはどこまでも静かだった。
lines.translated: Against his heartfelt confession, Kurohime-san remained completely calm.

lines.content: 少しだけ笑みを見せ――はっきりと断る。
lines.translated: She gave a small smile -- and turned him down clearly.

lines.content: なんとも言えない笑みだった。
\n告白に感謝した笑みにも見えるし、作り笑いにも見える。
lines.translated: \nIt could have been a smile of gratitude for the confession, or it could have been a forced one.
A smile with no emotion behind it -- just a "smile."

lines.content: 「そっかー……友だちからとか言ったほうが、
lines.translated: "I see... I guess I should've asked
\nif we could start as friends first..."

lines.content: 残念そうだが、ある程度予想していたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: He seemed disappointed, but maybe he'd seen it coming to some degree.

lines.content: 「いや無理か……やっぱり$str10のことが好きなのか？」
lines.translated: "No, that probably wouldn't have worked either... Is it because you like $str10 after all?"

lines.content: 「今日も文化祭の準備で遅くなりそう？」
lines.translated: "You think you'll be late again today with the culture festival prep?"

lines.content: 姉さんと玲と三人で登校途中に、姉さんが聞いてくる。
lines.translated: Sis asks as the three of us -- Sis, Rei and I -- walk to school together.

lines.content: 「私もそんな感じ。部員の子たちに、
lines.translated: "Same here. I've been asking the club members

lines.content: \n色々お願いしてるんだけどね」
lines.translated: \nto take care of a bunch of things."

lines.content: 家庭科部部長とはいえ、引き継ぎを考えて
lines.translated: Even as the home ec club president, it seems she's been

lines.content: \n仕事を振り分けているらしい。
lines.translated: \ndelegating tasks with the handover in mind.

lines.content: 「姉さんは、面倒見たがるから」
lines.translated: "You've always liked looking after people, Sis."

lines.content: 「見たがるっていうか……まぁ、そうかも」\@
lines.translated: "I wouldn't say I 'like' it... well, maybe."\@

lines.content: 反論しかけたけどあっさり認める。
lines.translated: She started to push back, then just let it go.
\nSeems like she's aware of it herself.
"We've both got to do our best with the prep."

lines.content: 今日の放課後も、看板作りの手伝いをしてたら、
lines.translated: After school today, I was helping make the sign again,

lines.content: 「悪いけど、買い出しに行ってきてくれねぇか？」
lines.translated: "Sorry, but could you go do a supply run?"

lines.content: 「いいけど……別に渉外の仕事じゃないだろ」
lines.translated: "Sure, but... that's not really the liaison's job, is it?"

lines.content: 「このクラスのお財布を握ってんのは、お前だし頼む！
lines.translated: "You're the one holding the class wallet, so I'm counting on you!

lines.content: \nオレこの後、文実の会議なんだ！」
lines.translated: \nI've got a festival committee meeting after this!"

lines.content: 渉外ということで、外部への支払いのために、
lines.translated: Since I'm the class liaison, I've also been put in charge of

lines.content: \nクラスの会計も預かっている。
lines.translated: \nthe class funds to handle payments to outside vendors.

lines.content: 現在の俺は、渉外兼会計という状態だ。
lines.translated: So right now I'm serving as both liaison and treasurer.

lines.content: \n苦労してるわけじゃないから別に構わないけど。
lines.translated: \nIt's not like it's that much trouble, so I don't really mind.

lines.content: 「まぁ、買い物ぐらい、引き受けるぞ」
lines.translated: "Well, a little shopping trip is no big deal. I'll handle it."

lines.content: 「おー、助かるわー！　これ買ってくるリストな」
lines.translated: "Oh, nice, you're a lifesaver! Here's the list of what to get."

lines.content: 「皆の衆ー。今から買い出し行ってもらうけど、
lines.translated: "Hey everyone! We're sending someone out for supplies --

lines.content: \n他に必要なもんってあるかー？」
lines.translated: \nanything else you need while they're at it?"

lines.content: 買い物ならまとめてした方がいい。
lines.translated: Better to get everything in one trip.

lines.content: \nホーセンがクラスメートたちに声をかける。
lines.translated: \nHosen called out to the rest of the class.

lines.content: 「はいはーい！　黒姫さんと一緒に行ってきてー！」
女子の一人が手を上げて――え、黒姫さん？
lines.translated: One of the girls raised her hand -- wait, Kurohime-san?

lines.content: 「あっ、はい……よろしくお願いします」\@
lines.translated: "Ah, okay... I'll be counting on you."\@

lines.content: クラスメートの声に黒姫さんを見れば、
lines.translated: I looked over at Kurohime-san at the sound of our classmate's voice,

lines.content: \n苦笑いで行く準備をしていた。
lines.translated: \nand she was getting ready to go with a wry smile.

lines.content: 「メニュー表に使う墨汁とか紙とか、
lines.translated: "We've run out of ink and paper for the menu boards

lines.content: 「じゃ、じゃんけんで負けただけなんですよ？
二人で歩きながら、頭をかく。
lines.translated: I scratched my head as we walked together.

lines.content: 「……なんだか、一緒になること多いな」
lines.translated: "...We end up together a lot, don't we?"

lines.content: 「そこは本当に。わたしたちの偶然……すごいです」
lines.translated: "We really do. Our coincidences... are something else."

lines.content: 意図したわけでもないのに、俺たちは一緒にいることが多い。
lines.translated: Without either of us trying, we always seem to end up together.

lines.content: それこそ黒姫さんに告白した学生が
lines.translated: Enough so that the student who confessed to Kurohime-san

lines.content: \n『付き合ってる？』と勘違いするぐらいには。
「新幹線で会ってから、ずっとですからね」
lines.translated: "It's been like this ever since we met on the bullet train."

lines.content: 新幹線で出会った時は、本当に『偶然』だった。
lines.translated: When we first met on the bullet train, it really was just a coincidence.

lines.content: なのに偶然『再会』して、今も二人で歩いている。
lines.translated: And yet we coincidentally ran into each other again, and here we are, walking side by side.

lines.content: \nもしかしたら必然なのかもしれません」
「ええ、何かあるのかも……いいえ、きっとあります」
lines.translated: "Yes, maybe there's something to it... no, I'm sure there is."

lines.content: 急にどうしたんだろう、この物言い。
lines.translated: What's gotten into her all of a sudden, talking like this?

lines.content: 偶然――いや、必然の理由があるということか？
lines.translated: Coincidence -- or rather, is she saying there's a reason it's fate?

lines.content: まさか、意図的に俺と一緒になるようにしている？
lines.translated: Could it be that she's been deliberately putting herself in situations where we end up together?

lines.content: \nだとしたら、その真意は一体――？
lines.translated: \nIf so, what could her real intention possibly be --?

lines.content: 「――生き別れの兄妹とか。ねぇ、お兄ちゃん♪」
「前世の因縁、ぐらいに信じられない話だ」
lines.translated: "That's about as believable as a past-life connection."

lines.content: 「ふふ、わたしも全面的に同意します」
真面目そうに見えても、こうやってからかってくる。
lines.translated: Even though she seems so serious, she teases me like this.

lines.content: \nこういう部分は、黒姫さんの『素』なんだろうか。
lines.translated: \nIs this side of her Kurohime-san's true self?

lines.content: だとしたら、俺に気を許しているわけだから、
lines.translated: If so, it means she's let her guard down around me,
\nso maybe I should be happy about it...

lines.content: 「あはっ、ちょっと極端すぎる話でしたね、
lines.translated: "Ahaha, that was a bit too far-fetched, wasn't it?

lines.content: 『告白事件』であったり『恋とは』と話し合ったり
lines.translated: Whether it was the confession incident or our talk about what love is,

lines.content: \nしても、黒姫さんは変わらない。
だとしたら、俺の『違和感』もただの勘違いなのだろうか。
lines.translated: If that's the case, maybe my "unease" is just me overthinking things.

lines.content: リストのものは買い終わったはずだし、
lines.translated: We should have everything on the list by now,

lines.content: \n黒姫さんが頼まれた買い物も完了だ。
「はい。お疲れさまです。安いお店、よく知ってますね」
lines.translated: "Yes. Good work out there. You really know the cheapest shops around."

lines.content: 和菓子屋から玲が出てくる。
lines.translated: Rei comes out of the Japanese sweets shop.

lines.content: \n生姜せんべいを買っていたのだろうか。
「だとしたら、買ってるものがあまりにも色気ない」
lines.translated: "If we were, what we're carrying is way too unromantic for that."

lines.content: 「なるほど、男女で商店街へ来る理由を考えましたが、
lines.translated: "I see. I was trying to think of a reason a boy and girl would come to the shopping street together,

lines.content: \n文化祭の買い物の方が合理的ですね」
lines.translated: \nbut shopping for the culture festival makes more sense."

lines.content: 「玲のクラス、文化祭はどうするんだ？」
lines.translated: "What's your class doing for the culture festival, Rei?"

lines.content: 「お化け屋敷をやります。私はおばけです」
lines.translated: "We're doing a haunted house. I'm going to be a ghost."

lines.content: お化け屋敷の『おばけ』といえば花形だ。
lines.translated: The ghost is the star role in any haunted house.

lines.content: \nマイペースな玲が、それをやるなんて。
lines.translated: \nI didn't expect Rei, of all people, to take that on.

lines.content: 「文化祭の準備を免除して貰う代わりに、
lines.translated: "In exchange for being excused from the culture festival prep work,

lines.content: \nおばけ役をすることにしました」
その方が拘束時間が短いから、玲にとっては楽なんだろう。
lines.translated: It means less time tied up with obligations, so it's the easier option for Rei.

lines.content: 「超怖がらせるので、お暇があったらどうぞ」
lines.translated: "I'll scare you out of your mind, so stop by if you have time."

lines.content: いや……単におばけ役に興味があるだけかもしれない。
lines.translated: Well... maybe she just finds the ghost role interesting.

lines.content: 本人は『ぼっち』と言っていたが、
lines.translated: She called herself a loner, but

lines.content: \nクラスで孤立してるというわけではないらしい。
lines.translated: \nit doesn't seem like she's actually isolated in her class.

lines.content: 兄としては、ひと安心だった。
lines.translated: As her older brother, that was a relief to hear.

lines.content: その場で玲と別れ、学園へと戻る。
lines.translated: We said goodbye to Rei there and headed back to school.

lines.content: 「素敵？　おばけ役、やりたかった？」
lines.translated: "Wonderful? Did you want to play the ghost too?"

lines.content: 「そうじゃなくて、自分の考えをしっかり持ってます」
lines.translated: "That's not what I mean -- she has such a clear sense of who she is."

lines.content: 「その強い心がとても魅力です」
lines.translated: "That strong will of hers is really charming."
"There are times I envy her for it."

lines.content: 何にも流されず、自分の意志を大事にする……
lines.translated: Not being swayed by anything, staying true to your own will...

lines.content: \n簡単にできるように見えて難しい。
lines.translated: \nIt looks easy, but it's actually hard.

lines.content: たいてい他の人の意見に流されてしまったり、
lines.translated: Most people end up getting swept along by others' opinions,

lines.content: \n途中で諦めたりするものだ。
「でしょう？　あなたの周りって素敵な人が多いですよね」
lines.translated: "Right? You really are surrounded by wonderful people."

lines.content: 「氷見山さんはもちろんですけど、蔦町先輩だって、
\nとても優しくて人当たりもいいし、他の方を思いやれる」
lines.translated: \nshe's so kind and easy to get along with, and she really cares about others."

lines.content: 「接客も上手ですし皆に好かれて……本当に尊敬です。
lines.translated: "She's great with customers, everyone loves her... I truly admire her.

lines.translated: \nthe fallen leaves had formed a crimson carpet below.

lines.translated: Shirasagi Academy students can get in for free

lines.translated: \ncan be used even during class hours.

lines.translated: \nto students who've slipped out of school.
